text: We were in the midst of the greatest economic crisis since the Great Depression,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: the previous administration had put two wars on our nation’s credit card,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and the American Dream had slipped out of reach for too many.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Today, our economy is growing again,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: al-Qaeda is weaker than at any point since 9/11,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and our manufacturing sector is growing for the first time in more than a decade.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We gather to reclaim the basic bargain that built the largest middle class and the most prosperous nation on Earth –
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: the simple principle that in America, hard work should pay off,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: responsibility should be rewarded,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and each one of us should be able to go as far as our talent and drive take us.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We Democrats offer America the opportunity to move our country forward by creating an economy built to last and built from the middle out.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Mitt Romney and the Republican Party have a drastically different vision.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: They still believe the best way to grow the economy is from the top down
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: – the same approach that benefited the wealthy few but crashed the economy and crushed the middle class.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Democrats see a young country continually made stronger by the greatest diversity of talent and ingenuity in the world,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and a nation of people drawn to our shores from every corner of the globe.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We believe America can succeed because the American people have never failed
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and there is nothing that together we cannot accomplish.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Reclaiming the economic security of the middle class is the challenge we must overcome today.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That begins by restoring the basic values that made our country great,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and restoring for everyone who works hard and plays by the rules the opportunity to find a job that pays the bills, turn an idea into a profitable business, care for your family, afford a home you call your own and health care you can count on, retire with dignity and respect,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and, most of all, give your children the kind of education that allows them to dream even bigger and go even further than you ever imagined.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: This has to be our North Star – an economy that’s built not from the top down, but from a growing middle class,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and that provides ladders of opportunity for those working hard to join the middle class.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: It’s the defining issue of our time and at the core of the American Dream.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The Republican Party has turned its back on the middle class Americans who built this country.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Our opponents believe we should go back to the top-down economic policies of the last decade.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: They think that if we simply eliminate protections for families and consumers, let Wall Street write its own rules again, and cut taxes for the wealthiest, the market will solve all our problems on its own.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: They argue that if we help corporations and wealthy investors maximize their profits by whatever means necessary, whether through layoffs or outsourcing, it will automatically translate into jobs and prosperity that benefits us all.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: They would repeal health reform,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and follow the same path of fiscal irresponsibility of the past administration – giving trillions of dollars in tax cuts weighted towards millionaires and billionaires while sticking the middle class with the bill.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: But we’ve tried their policies – and we’ve all suffered when they failed.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: It is not enough to go back to where the country was before the crisis.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We must rebuild a strong foundation that ensures it never happens again.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Democrats know that America prospers when we’re all in it together.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We see an America where everyone has a fair shot, does their fair share, and plays by the same rules.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We see an America that out-educates, out-builds, and out-innovates the rest of the world.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We see an America with greater economic security and opportunity, driven by education, energy, innovation and infrastructure, and a tax code that helps to create American jobs
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and bring down the debt in a balanced way.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We believe in deficit reduction not by placing the burden on the middle class and the poor, but by cutting out programs we can’t afford
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and asking the wealthiest to again contribute their fair share.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: These values are why we enacted historic health care reform that provides economic security for families
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and enacted sweeping financial reform legislation that will prevent the recklessness that cost so many their jobs, homes, and savings.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: They’re why we rescued the auto industry
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and revived our manufacturing supply chain.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: They’re why we helped American families who are working multiple jobs and struggling to pay the bills save a little extra money through tax cuts, lower health care costs, and affordable student loans.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: They’re why we fought to reclaim the value of treating all Americans with dignity and respect.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And they’re why President Barack Obama has ended one war and is responsibly drawing down another.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: They’re why we’re restoring our alliances and image around the world
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and pursuing a foreign policy that’s making us safer.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We knew that renewing the American Dream wouldn’t be easy – we knew it would take more than one year, or one term, or even one president.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We are the party of inclusion and respect differences of perspective and belief.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And so, even when we disagree, we work together to move this country forward.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: But what is holding our nation back is a stalemate in Washington between two fundamentally different views of which direction America should take.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We must keep moving forward and doing the hard work of rebuilding a strong economy
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: by betting on the American worker
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and investing in a growing middle class.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We need a government that stands up for the hopes, values, and interests of working people,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and gives everyone willing to work hard the chance to make the most of their God-given potential.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We’ve come a long way since 2008.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President took office in the middle of the worst economic downturn since the Great Depression; that month 800,000 Americans lost their jobs – more than in any single month in the previous 60 years.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: On Day One, he took immediate action to stop the free fall and put Americans back to work. In the midst of the crisis,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama knew what Democrats have always known: that American workers are tougher than tough times.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Since early 2010, the private sector has created 4.5 million jobs,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and American manufacturing is growing for the first time since the 1990s.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President knew from the start that to rebuild true middle class security, we can’t just cut our way to prosperity.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We need an economy that creates the jobs of the future and makes things the rest of the world buys –
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: not one built on outsourcing, loopholes, or risky financial deals that jeopardize everyone, especially the middle class.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We’ve already made historic progress.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: States have more flexibility to raise standards and reform schools,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: more students are receiving grants and scholarships,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and young adults can stay on their parents’ health insurance plans as they finish their education and enter the workforce.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: More working families than ever before have received tax cuts,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and fuel-efficiency standards are doubling.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President cracked down on Wall Street recklessness
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and abuses by health insurance, credit card, and mortgage companies.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: A crisis this deep didn’t happen overnight and it won’t be solved overnight.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Too many parents sit around their kitchen tables at night after they’ve put their kids to bed, worrying about how they will make a mortgage payment or pay the rent, or how they will put their children through college.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We now stand at a make-or-break moment for families,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and America faces a clear choice in this election: move forward toward a nation built from the middle class out where everyone has the chance to get ahead,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: or go back to the same failed ideas that created the crisis in the first place.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The Republicans in Congress and Mitt Romney have a very different idea about where they want to take this country.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: To pay for their trillions in additional tax cuts weighted towards millionaires and billionaires, they’ll raise taxes on the middle class
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and gut our investments in education, research and technology, and new roads, bridges, and airports.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: They’ll end Medicare as we know it.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: They want to let Wall Street write its own rules again
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and allow insurance companies to once again deny health care to working families.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Their troubling and familiar economic scheme doubles down on the same bad ideas of the last decade while arguing that, somehow, this time, they’ll lead to a different result.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We have to move forward.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: When President Obama took office, the economy was in the deepest economic crisis since the Great Depression.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: His Recovery Act represented the largest education investment since President Johnson,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: the largest infrastructure investment since President Eisenhower,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: the single largest clean energy investment ever,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and the broadest tax cut in American history.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: It helped keep teachers, police officers, nurses, and firefighters on the job.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: It ensured that as we re-built our country, we bought American-made iron, steel, and manufactured goods wherever feasible, consistent with our international obligations.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: It helped the President stop the bleeding and reverse the free fall.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: But just as the recession was not created overnight, we knew it would take time to recover from the crisis – and more needs to be done.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Last September, President Obama put forward the American Jobs Act to provide an immediate boost to the economy and strengthen the recovery.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We have already enacted key parts of the American Jobs Act – payroll tax relief, tax credits for businesses that hire veterans,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and an extension of unemployment insurance that also included reforms like work-sharing,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: a “Bridge to Work” to help the long-term unemployed reconnect with the labor force,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and support for unemployed workers looking to become entrepreneurs.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: But Republicans in Congress blocked other provisions that independent analysis said could create one million jobs.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Even as President Obama remains committed to working with both parties, he and his cabinet pursued a series of executive actions to help spark economic growth and job creation,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: including expanding access to refinancing for families who have stayed current on their mortgages,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: challenging Community Health Centers to hire veterans,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: accelerating permitting for transportation projects,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: cutting waste and reducing improper payments,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and enabling student loan borrowers to cap their payments at a percentage of income.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That’s why President Obama and the Democratic Party have cut taxes on American workers and businesses
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and made sweeping reforms to the unemployment system to help get people back to work.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we continue to fight for measures that would strengthen the recovery and create jobs now,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: including keeping teachers and first responders on the job, putting construction workers back to work by investing in our roads, bridges, schools, and water supply, helping families refinance their mortgages and save hundreds of dollars a month, cutting taxes for small businesses that invest and hire, and putting veterans back to work.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That’s why we continue to fight for relief for the long-term unemployed,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: including a ban on hiring discrimination against the unemployed
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and a reformed and expanded universal worker training proposal to provide more training and job search assistance to all displaced workers regardless of how they lost their job.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President’s plan includes many measures that have long had bipartisan support.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Middle Class Tax Cuts. President Obama and Democrats in Congress cut taxes for every working family, putting more money in the pockets of Americans who need it most.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: A typical family has saved $3,600 during his first term.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Now he’s fighting to stop middle class families and those aspiring to join the middle class from seeing their taxes go up
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and to extend key tax relief for working families and those paying for college,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: while asking the wealthiest and corporations to pay their fair share.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That is why we will always vigorously oppose the type of tax reform supported by Mitt Romney which independent experts have found would require raising taxes on typical families with children by at least $2,000 if it were paid for.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: At the same time, Mitt Romney’s plan would cut taxes for those making over $3 million by an average of $250,000
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and would create incentives that will lead to hundreds of thousands of jobs going overseas at the expense of American workers.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Health Care. We believe accessible, affordable, high quality health care is part of the American promise,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: that Americans should have the security that comes with good health care,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and that no one should go broke because they get sick.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Over the determined opposition of Republicans, we enacted landmark reforms that are already helping millions of Americans, and more benefits will come soon.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: As a result of our efforts, today, young Americans entering the workforce can stay on their parents’ plans.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Insurers can no longer refuse to cover kids with pre-existing medical conditions.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Insurance companies will no longer be able to arbitrarily cap and cancel coverage,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: or charge women more simply because of their gender.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: People with private insurance are getting preventive services like cancer screenings, annual well-woman visits, and FDA-approved contraception with no out-of-pocket costs.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We’ve established new Offices of Minority Health,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and are helping state Medicaid programs fund home and community-based services.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Small businesses are receiving tax credits to help them cover their workers,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and businesses and families are receiving rebates from insurers who overcharged them.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Soon, working families will finally have the security of knowing they won’t lose health care or be forced into bankruptcy if a family member gets sick or loses their job.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And soon, insurance companies will no longer be able to deny coverage based on pre-existing conditions.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Medicaid will cover more working families.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Those who don’t get insurance at work will be able to shop in new exchanges and will be eligible for new tax credits.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: As a result, all Americans will have access to health care.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Mitt Romney and the Republican Party would repeal health reform.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: They are more concerned with playing politics than supporting families in this country.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: No law is perfect and Democrats stand willing to work with anyone to improve the law where necessary, but we are committed to moving forward.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will continue to stand up to Republicans working to take away the benefits and protections that are already helping millions of Americans every day.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We refuse to go back to the days when health insurance companies had unchecked power to cancel your health policy, deny you coverage, or charge women more than men.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: At the same time, the Affordable Care Act is not the end of efforts to improve health care for all Americans.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Democrats will continue to fight for a strong health care workforce with an emphasis on primary care.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We remain committed to eliminating disparities in health
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and will continue to make sure families have access to mental health and substance abuse services.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will strengthen Medicaid
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and oppose efforts to block grant the program, slash its funding, and leave millions more without health insurance.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will continue to invest in our public health infrastructure – ensuring that we are able to respond to emergencies and support community-based efforts to prevent disease.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The Recovery Act and the health reform law made historic investments in Community Health Centers,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and Democrats will continue to support these valuable institutions.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We Democrats have increased overall funding to combat HIV/AIDS to record levels and will continue our nation’s fight against HIV/AIDS.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama established the first-ever comprehensive National HIV/AIDS Strategy for responding to the domestic epidemic,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: which calls for reducing HIV incidence, increasing access to care, optimizing health outcomes, and reducing HIV-related health disparities.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: This is an evidence-based plan that is guided by science and seeks to direct resources to the communities at greatest risk, including gay men, black and Latino Americans, substance users, and others at high risk of infection.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we will continue to support America’s groundbreaking biomedical researchers in their lifesaving work.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Stabilizing the Housing Market and Hard-Hit Communities. For more than a decade, irresponsible lenders tricked buyers into signing subprime loans while too many homeowners got in over their heads by buying homes they couldn’t afford.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: But when the housing bubble burst, it hurt everyone, including responsible homeowners who played by the rules, but saw their home values decline and their neighbors’ houses sit vacant.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The housing market’s dramatic collapse did more than punish millions of innocent Americans; it also triggered the economy’s downward spiral into recession.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama took swift action to stabilize a housing market in crisis,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: helping five million families restructure their loans to help them stay in their homes,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: making it easier for families to refinance their mortgages and save hundreds of dollars a month,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and giving tax credits to first-time home buyers.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: He also cracked down on fraudulent mortgage lenders and other abuses that contributed to the housing crisis.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Democrats have held the largest financial institutions accountable by requiring them to provide relief for homeowners still struggling to pay their mortgages
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and to change practices that took advantage of homeowners.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Democrats also understand the importance of helping communities fight back against the foreclosures that threaten entire neighborhoods,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: which is why the President proposed to expand the successful neighborhood stabilization efforts in his American Jobs Act.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Too many people still owe more on their homes than they are worth.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That is why Democrats are fighting to give every responsible homeowner the chance to refinance their home, spurring investment in communities that have been hit hardest by foreclosure, and taking whatever steps we can to avoid more foreclosures.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President remains committed to creating an economy that’s built to last,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: where home ownership is an achievable dream for all Americans.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Social Security and Medicare. We believe every American deserves a secure, healthy, and dignified retirement.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: America’s seniors have earned their Medicare and Social Security through a lifetime of hard work and personal responsibility.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama is committed to preserving that promise for this and future generations.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: During their working years, Americans contribute to Social Security in exchange for a promise that they will receive an income in retirement.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Unlike those in the other party, we will find a solution to protect Social Security for future generations.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will block Republican efforts to subject Americans’ guaranteed retirement income to the whims of the stock market through privatization.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We reject approaches that insist that cutting benefits is the only answer.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama will also make it easier for Americans to save on their own for retirement and prepare for unforeseen expenses by participating in retirement accounts at work.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The Republican budget plan would end Medicare as we know it.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Democrats adamantly oppose any efforts to privatize or voucherize Medicare;
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: unlike our opponents we will not ask seniors to pay thousands of dollars more every year while they watch the value of their Medicare benefits evaporate.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Democrats believe that Medicare is a sacred compact with our seniors.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Nearly 50 million older Americans and Americans with disabilities rely on Medicare each year, and the new health care law makes Medicare stronger by adding new benefits,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: fighting fraud,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and improving care for patients.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And, over 10 years, the law will save the average Medicare beneficiary $4,200.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama is already leading the most successful crackdown on health care fraud ever, having already recovered $10 billion from health care scams.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will build on those reforms, not eliminate Medicare’s guarantees.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The health care law is closing the gap in prescription drug coverage known as the “doughnut hole.”
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: More than five million seniors have already saved money – an average of $600 last year – and the doughnut hole will be closed for good by 2020.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: In short, Democrats believe that Social Security and Medicare must be kept strong for seniors, people with disabilities, and future generations.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Our opponents have shown a shocking willingness to gut these programs to pay for tax cuts for the wealthiest, and we fundamentally reject that approach.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: An Economy that Out-Educates the World and Offers Greater Access to Higher Education and Technical Training. Democrats believe that getting an education is the surest path to the middle class,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: giving all students the opportunity to fulfill their dreams and contribute to our economy and democracy.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Public education is one of our critical democratic institutions.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We are committed to ensuring that every child in America has access to a world-class public education so we can out-educate the world and make sure America has the world’s highest proportion of college graduates by 2020.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: This requires excellence at every level of our education system, from early learning through post-secondary education.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: It means we must close the achievement gap in America’s schools
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and ensure that in every neighborhood in the country, children can benefit from high-quality educational opportunities.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: This is why we have helped states and territories develop comprehensive plans to raise standards and improve instruction in their early learning programs
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and invested in expanding and reforming Head Start.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama and the Democrats are committed to working with states and communities so they have the flexibility and resources they need to improve elementary and secondary education in a way that works best for students.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: To that end, the President challenged and encouraged states to raise their standards so students graduate ready for college or career and can succeed in a dynamic global economy.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Forty-six states responded, leading groundbreaking reforms that will deliver better education to millions of American students.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Too many students, particularly students of color and disadvantaged students, drop out of our schools, and Democrats know we must address the dropout crisis with the urgency it deserves.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The Democratic Party understands the importance of turning around struggling public schools.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will continue to strengthen all our schools
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and work to expand public school options for low-income youth, including magnet schools, charter schools, teacher-led schools, and career academies.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Because there is no substitute for a great teacher at the head of a classroom, the President helped school districts save more than 400,000 educator jobs.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We Democrats honor our nation’s teachers, who do a heroic job for their students every day.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: If we want high-quality education for all our kids, we must listen to the people who are on the front lines.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President has laid out a plan to prevent more teacher layoffs while attracting and rewarding great teachers.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: This includes raising standards for the programs that prepare our teachers, recognizing and rewarding good teaching, and retaining good teachers
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: . We also believe in carefully crafted evaluation systems that give struggling teachers a chance to succeed
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and protect due process if another teacher has to be put in the classroom.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We also recognize there is no substitute for a parent’s involvement in their child’s education.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: To help keep college within reach for every student, Democrats took on banks to reform our student loan program, saving more than $60 billion by removing the banks acting as middlemen so we can better and more directly invest in students.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: To make college affordable for students of all backgrounds and confront the loan burden our students shoulder, we doubled our investment in Pell Grant scholarships and created the American Opportunity Tax Credit worth up to $10,000 over four years of college,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and we will work to make it possible for foreign students earning advanced degrees in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics to stay and help create jobs here at home.

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And he supports the radical House Republican budget that would cut financial aid for more than one million students while giving tax cuts to the rich.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We Democrats have focused on making sure that taxpayer dollars support high-quality education programs,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: After the previous administration put two wars and tax cuts weighted towards the wealthy on the nation’s credit card,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and in the wake of the worst recession since the Great Depression,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Democrats took decisive steps to restore fiscal responsibility to Washington.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We reinstated the tough pay-as-you-go budget rules of the 1990s so that all permanent new spending and tax cuts must now be offset by savings or revenue increases.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama has already signed into law $2 trillion in spending reductions as part of a balanced plan to reduce our deficits by over $4 trillion over the next decade
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: while taking immediate steps to strengthen the economy now.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: This approach includes tough spending cuts that will bring annual domestic spending to its lowest level as a share of the economy in 50 years,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: while still allowing us to make investments that benefit the middle class now
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and reduce our deficit over a decade.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We are committed to defeating efforts that would return us to the failed economic policies of the past, in which tax relief for the wealthy explodes the deficit and asks the middle class to shoulder that burden.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: To help spur economic growth, President Obama and the Democratic Party cut taxes for every working family – providing $3,600 in tax relief to the typical family over the President’s first term in office –
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and we are committed to extending the middle class tax cuts for the 98 percent of American families who make less than $250,000 a year,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and we will not raise taxes on them.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The Republican Party has a different vision—instead of asking everyone to do their fair share and making investments we need for an economy built to last, they would slash taxes for corporations and the wealthiest Americans,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: let Wall Street once again write its own rules,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and balance the budget on the backs of the middle class.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: All-of-the-Above Energy Policy. In the last four years, President Obama and the Democratic Party have taken concrete steps to make us more energy independent.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We’ve supported nearly 225,000 clean energy jobs
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and Americans are importing less oil, breathing cleaner air, and saving money on energy costs.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Historic investments in clean energy technologies have helped double the electricity we get from wind and solar.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: New emissions and fuel efficiency standards for American cars are reducing our oil use,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: saving consumers at the pump,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and putting Americans back to work.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Our dependence on foreign oil is now at a 16-year low, and a new era of cheap, abundant natural gas is helping to bring jobs and industry back to the United States.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We can move towards a sustainable energy-independent future if we harness all of America’s great natural resources.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That means an all-of-the-above approach to developing America’s many energy resources, including wind, solar, biofuels, geothermal, hydropower, nuclear, oil, clean coal, and natural gas.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama has encouraged innovation to reach his goal of generating 80 percent of our electricity from clean energy sources by 2035.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Democrats support making America the world’s leader in building a clean energy economy by extending clean energy incentives that support American businesses and American jobs in communities across the country.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: It’s not enough to invent clean energy technologies here; we want to make them here and sell them around the world.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We can further cut our reliance on oil with increased energy efficiency in buildings, industry, and homes,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and through the promotion of advanced vehicles, fuel economy standards, and the greater use of natural gas in transportation.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Harnessing our natural gas resources needs to be done in a safe and responsible manner,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: which is why the Obama administration has proposed a number of safeguards to protect against water contamination and air pollution.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will continue to advocate for the use of this clean fossil fuel,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: while ensuring that public and environmental health and workers’ safety are protected.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We support more infrastructure investment to speed the transition to cleaner fuels in the transportation sector.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we are expediting the approval process to build out critical oil and gas lines essential to transporting our energy for consumers.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Building a clean energy future means that new exploration and production needs to be approached safely and responsibly.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Democrats are committed to balancing environmental protection with development,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and that means preserving sensitive public lands from exploration, like the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge, Pacific West Coast, Gulf of Maine, and other irreplaceable national landscapes.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We are saving consumers money on their energy bills – both at home and at the pump –
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: but Republican energy policy is full of empty rhetoric and bad ideas that would make their Big Oil donors even richer at the expense of the middle class.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Republicans would keep giving billions of taxpayer dollars a year to profitable oil companies and increase costs on consumers.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Democrats will fight to cut tax subsidies for Big Oil while promoting job growth in the clean energy sector,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: so we can cut the deficit and increase jobs and growth in America.

text: Instead of cutting jobs or shipping them abroad, many American companies are now “insourcing,” or bringing overseas jobs back home.

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: saving more than one million jobs,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: preventing the collapse of the industry’s supply chain,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and shoring up countless communities, while revitalizing the backbone of America’s manufacturing sector.

text: Mitt Romney thought the government’s action would destroy the auto industry;
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: he and Republican leaders opposed the support President Obama extended to rescue an iconic industry.

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We want to cut tax breaks for companies that are shipping jobs overseas and for special interests,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and instead offer tax breaks to companies that are investing right here in the United States of America,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: betting on American workers who are making American products we sell to the world that are stamped with three proud words: Made in America.

text: After decades of watching American companies take jobs to other countries, we’re beginning to see entrepreneurs and manufactures make the decision to keep factories and production facilities here in the United States
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and are building a state-of-the-art nationwide, interoperable, public safety network.

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: As technology advances, we will continue to work with all stakeholders to protect the security of the nation and its knowledge assets, U.S. intellectual property, the functioning of fair and competitive markets, and the privacy, free expression, and due process rights of Americans.

text: Standing Up for Workers. When the President took office, the American middle class was under assault.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: From 2001 to 2007, we had the slowest private-sector job growth in an economic expansion since World War II.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The typical family saw its income stall and inequality climb, even as the economy grew.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we had an administration that thought the answer was limiting unions.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Upon taking office, President Obama began the work of restoring an economy built to last that creates good jobs that pay well.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Because the President and the Democratic Party believe in the right to organize and in supporting America’s workers with strong labor laws, the President rolled back harmful labor policies designed to undermine collective bargaining rights.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President appointed members of the National Labor Relations Board and National Mediation Board who understand the importance of standing up for the rights of workers.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: He placed his bet on the American worker when he rescued the auto industry.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: His administration will continue its fight against the exploitative practice of employers fraudulently misclassifying workers as independent contractors or white-collar workers to evade taxes or deny them protections and overtime benefits.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: As new employment relationships evolve away from the traditional employee-employer model, we need to make sure our labor laws are modernized and keep pace with changes in our economy.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The Republican Party would return us to the failed policies of the last administration, vilifying the American worker, undermining unions, and arguing that everyone should fend for themselves.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We oppose the attacks on collective bargaining that Republican governors and state legislatures are mounting in states around the country.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Democrats believe that the right to organize and collectively bargain is a fundamental American value;
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: every American should have a voice on the job and
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: a chance to negotiate for a fair day’s pay after a hard day’s work.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will continue to fight for the right of all workers to organize and join a union.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Unions helped build the greatest middle class the world has ever known.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Their work resulted in the 40-hour workweek and weekends, paid leave and pensions, the minimum wage and health insurance, and Social Security and Medicare – the cornerstones of middle class security.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will fight for labor laws that provide a fair process for workers to choose union representation, that facilitate the collective bargaining process,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and that strengthen remedies for violations of the law.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will fight for collective bargaining rights for police officers, nurses, firefighters, emergency medical technicians, teachers, and other public sector workers – jobs that are a proven path to the middle class for millions of Americans.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will continue to vigorously oppose “Right to Work” and “paycheck protection” efforts, and so-called “Save our Secret Ballot” measures whenever they are proposed.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will raise the minimum wage, and index it to inflation.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We believe in an America where people looking for work can find good jobs,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: where hard work pays,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and where responsibility is rewarded.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Our Occupational Safety and Health Administration will continue to adopt and enforce comprehensive safety standards.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The first bill the President signed was the Lilly Ledbetter Fair Pay Act, we are committed to passing the Paycheck Fairness Act, and we will continue to battle Republican opposition to efforts to stop wage discrimination.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Helping Small Business. Small businesses employ half of all working Americans, and, over the last two decades, have created two out of three net new jobs.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Democrats believe that small businesses are the engine of job growth in America.

text: President Obama signed 18 small-business tax cuts to encourage businesses to hire more workers
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and make job-creating investments in machinery and equipment and proposed significant additional small business tax relief.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Democrats made it easier for small businesses to access the loans they needed to grow and hire.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Small businesses are now once again creating jobs.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We recognize the importance of small business to women, people of color, tribes, and rural America
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and will work to help nurture entrepreneurship.

title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and access the capital they need to grow.

text: This includes tax cuts for small businesses that make new investments, hire more workers, or increase wages.

text: We also understand the indispensable role that the United States must continue to play in promoting international peace and prosperity.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And because of the steps we have taken, the United States is leading once again,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and America is safer, stronger, and more secure than it was four years ago.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Charting a responsible path out of the war in Iraq has been a crucial element of President Obama’s foreign policy and has enabled important shifts in our broader strategy.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Then-Senator Obama pledged during the 2008 campaign to responsibly end the war in Iraq, saying it was imperative to “be as careful getting out as we were careless getting in” – and that is precisely what he has done.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: For over half a decade, our focus on Iraq meant we had taken our eye off of al-Qaeda,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and it had cost us thousands of lives, a trillion dollars, and severely strained our key alliances.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: When President Obama took office, there were over 140,000American troops in harm’s way in Iraq.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Today, all of those forces are out of Iraq, and there are no American bases there either.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The Iraqi people, in continued partnership with the United States, now have the opportunity to build a better future.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: After taking office, President Obama removed our combat brigades and ended our combat mission on a 19-month timetable.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And after an interim period in which we continued to advise Iraqis and conduct counterterrorism operations, we completed the drawdown of all U.S. troops last December.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: This decision was reached after extensive discussions and with the full agreement of the Iraqi government,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and it was determined to be in the best interest of both nations.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Many Republicans, including Mitt Romney, would have preferred to leave tens of thousands of U.S. troops in Iraq in an open-ended commitment,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: against the will of the Iraqi government and people.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Moving forward, President Obama and the Democratic Party are committed to building a robust, long-term strategic partnership with a sovereign, united, and democratic Iraq in all fields – diplomatic, economic, and security – based on mutual interests and mutual respect.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama and the Democratic Party understood that the war in Iraq distracted us from confronting many of the most fundamental national security challenges facing the United States,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: including the danger posed by international terrorist organizations that threaten the American homeland.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: As the Bush administration shifted its focus to Iraq, Osama bin Laden and al-Qaeda established safe havens across the border from Afghanistan, in Pakistan.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama’s decision to end the Iraq war freed up military and intelligence resources to refocus on this fight
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and enabled us to shift to a much more effective approach to counterterrorism.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Importantly, President Obama also shifted away from the Bush administration’s sweeping and internationally-divisive rhetoric of a “global war on terrorism”
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: to a more focused effort against an identifiable network of people: al-Qaeda and its affiliates.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That has allowed us to target force with greater precision against those who want to harm Americans and attack the United States
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and move away from the type of large-scale military deployments characteristic of the previous administration and favored by many Republicans today.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: As a candidate, then-Senator Obama committed to bringing Osama bin Laden to justice, even if that meant crossing the border into Pakistan.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: As a consequence of the President’s decisions and the brave work of our military and intelligence professionals, bin Laden can no longer threaten the United States and al-Qaeda’s senior leadership has been devastated, rendering the group far less capable than it was four years ago.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The al-Qaeda core in Afghanistan and Pakistan has never been weaker.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We have also struck blows against al-Qaeda’s leadership in Yemen and Somalia – with the full support and close cooperation of those governments.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: At the same time, the President and the Democratic Party understand that we must stay vigilant.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The al-Qaeda core may be on the path to defeat, but the organization and its affiliates remain active in Afghanistan, Pakistan, Yemen, Somalia, and elsewhere.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: For that reason, we are committed to an unrelenting pursuit of those who would kill Americans or threaten our homeland, our allies, our partners, and our interests around the world.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The United States went into Afghanistan after 9/11 to bring justice to those who had attacked us and to take away al-Qaeda’s safe haven.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: But by the time President Obama took office, we had lost sight of those goals.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: So the President refocused our efforts there in 2009, setting the clear goal of defeating al-Qaeda and denying it an ability to reestablish a safe haven in Afghanistan.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Because of the deteriorating security situation, he sent additional resources to reverse the Taliban’s momentum and to give the Afghans the time and space to build the capacity of their security forces.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We have accomplished that, and now we have begun the process of bringing our troops home from Afghanistan, including removing 33,000 by September 2012.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And, with the support of our allies, the President has outlined a plan to end the war in Afghanistan in 2014.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Already, the United States and our North Atlantic Treaty Organization allies have begun to transition responsibility to Afghan security forces.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: At the same time, we are keeping up the pressure on the Taliban,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: pursuing the possibility of a political resolution to parts of the conflict,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and continuing our capacity-building efforts.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Beyond 2014, we will continue to provide counterterrorism and training assistance and to build an enduring relationship with Afghanistan, as outlined by the U.S.-Afghanistan Strategic Partnership Agreement concluded in May.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: But we will not build permanent bases in Afghanistan.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: More broadly, we will also continue to support peace and stability in South Asia.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Pakistan can be a partner in that process.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The United States will make clear that we respect Pakistan’s sovereignty and democratic institutions,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and that our interest is in putting an end to al-Qaeda’s safe havens and respecting Afghan sovereignty.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Mitt Romney has been both for and against our timeline to end the war in Afghanistan,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: but he has failed to outline any policy ideas for how he would bring our troops home and, at times, has suggested he would leave them there indefinitely.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: In our continuing efforts to keep America safe, President Obama and the Democratic Party believe we must address the threat that nuclear weapons pose to our security and to peace in the world.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Despite the two decades that have passed since the end of the Cold War, large stockpiles of nuclear weapons persist, and more nations are interested in acquiring them.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Nuclear testing and black-market trade in sensitive nuclear materials continue.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And terrorists remain determined to buy, build, or steal the ultimate weapon.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama and the Democratic Party are committed to preventing the further spread of nuclear weapons
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and to eventually ridding the planet of these catastrophic weapons.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: This goal will not be achieved overnight.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: It will require patience, perseverance, and the steady accumulation of concrete actions.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: But real progress has already been made.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Reducing Nuclear Weapons Stockpiles. The Obama administration has moved away from Cold War thinking by reducing the prominence of nuclear weapons in America’s national security strategy, and it has urged others to do the same.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: As long as these weapons exist, the United States will maintain a safe, secure, and effective arsenal to deter any adversary and guarantee the defense of our allies.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: But President Obama has taken important steps to decrease America’s nuclear arsenal and is committed to further responsible reductions.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: To reduce our warheads and stockpile, lower the threat of a nuclear exchange, and lay the foundation for future progress, President Obama negotiated and signed the landmark New Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty with Russia,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: producing cuts in each side’s deployed nuclear stockpiles and launchers and allowing us to monitor and verify Russia’s arsenal.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Yet despite bipartisan consensus among former National Security Advisors, Secretaries of Defense, and Secretaries of State that New START makes America safer, Mitt Romney strongly objected to the treaty.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Moving forward, the President will work with Russia to achieve additional reductions in stockpiles and nuclear delivery vehicles, including tactical and non-deployed nuclear weapons.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will also work to ratify the Comprehensive Test Ban Treaty
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and seek a new Fissile Material Cut-off Treaty that prohibits the production of fissile materials intended for use in nuclear weapons.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Preventing Nuclear Proliferation. President Obama and the Democratic Party are also committed to strengthening the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty as the bedrock of international efforts to prevent the spread of nuclear weapons to additional countries.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: As we work to uphold our obligations under the treaty by reducing stockpiles and recognizing the rights of all rule-abiding states to peaceful nuclear energy,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: we will insist that countries without nuclear weapons comply with their obligations not to develop them,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and we will ensure that violators face real consequences.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Iran. President Obama, working closely with our international partners and Congress, has put in place unprecedented sanctions against Iran.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Iran has yet to build a nuclear weapon, but has continually failed to meet its obligations under the NPT and several United Nations Security Council resolutions,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and it cannot demonstrate with any credibility that its program is peaceful.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President is committed to using all instruments of national power to prevent Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: When President Obama took office, Iran was ascendant in the region, and the international community was divided over how to address Iran’s nuclear violations.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President’s early offer of engagement with Iran – quickly rebuffed by the regime – allowed the United States to expose Iranian intransigence and rally the international community as never before.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Working with our European allies and with Russia and China, the administration gained unprecedented agreement for the toughest ever UN sanctions against Iran,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: laying the foundation for additional national financial and energy sanctions imposed by the United States and other nations.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: As a result, Iran is now increasingly isolated and the regime faces crippling economic pressure – pressure that will only build over time.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama believes that a diplomatic outcome remains the best and most enduring solution.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: At the same time, he has also made clear that the window for diplomacy will not remain open indefinitely and that all options – including military force – remain on the table.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: But we have an obligation to use the time and space that exists now to put increasing pressure on the Iranian regime to live up to its obligations and rejoin the community of nations, or face the consequences.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: North Korea. President Obama will also continue to confront North Korea, another regime that ignores its international obligations by developing nuclear weapons and missile technology, with a stark choice: take verifiable steps toward denuclearization
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: or face increasing isolation and costs from the United States and the international community.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That is why the administration worked with international partners to impose the harshest multilateral sanctions on North Korea in history.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And it is why the President has made clear that the transfer of nuclear weapons or material by North Korea to states or non-state entities would be considered a grave threat to the United States and our allies, and we would hold North Korea accountable for the consequences of such action.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Securing Loose Nuclear Materials. The President has led a global effort to secure all loose nuclear materials around the world,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: hosting a nuclear security summit in Washington,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and making concrete progress in locking these materials down.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: This is an important goal because the prospect that al-Qaeda or another terrorist organization might acquire a nuclear device represents an immediate and extreme threat to global security.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: At the same time, the United States will continue to work with international partners to break up black markets,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: detect and intercept nuclear materials in transit,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and use financial tools to disrupt this dangerous trade.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Russia. Crucial to achieving all of these objectives has been, and will remain, expanded cooperation with Russia.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The Cold War mentality represented by Mitt Romney’s identification of Russia as “our number one geopolitical foe” ignores the very real common interest we share with Russia in reducing nuclear stockpiles,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: stopping additional proliferation by countries such as Iran and North Korea,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and preventing nuclear materials from falling into the hands of terrorists.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President’s “reset” policy toward Russia has produced significant cooperation in these areas, as well as in Russian support for the Northern Distribution Network that supplies our troops in Afghanistan.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We support establishing permanent, normal trade relations with Russia because it would be good for the U.S. economy, for U.S. businesses, and for U.S. workers if we do.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform
