text: And securing Russia’s accession to the World Trade Organization is an important step toward encouraging Russia to follow a rules-based system
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: , and to protecting the rights of American workers, farmers, ranchers, and firms.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The administration will not put aside our differences but will raise them directly with the Russian government.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we will continue to strongly criticize Russian actions that we oppose, such as their support for the Assad regime in Syria.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: As we have taken decisive steps to address today’s dangers from terrorism and to prevent future nuclear proliferation,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: we have also sought to bolster homeland security and head off emerging challenges, ranging from cyber and biological threats to climate change and transnational crime.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Cybersecurity. Cybersecurity threats represent one of the most serious potential national security, public safety, and economic challenges we face.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The very technologies that empower us to lead and create also empower individual criminal hackers, organized criminal groups, terrorist networks, and other advanced nations to disrupt the critical infrastructure that is vital to our economy, commerce, public safety, and military.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Defending against cyber threats requires networks that are secure, trustworthy, and resilient.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President and the administration have taken unprecedented steps to defend America from cyber attacks,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: including creating the first military command dedicated to cybersecurity
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and conducting a full review of the federal government’s efforts to protect our information and our infrastructure.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will continue to take steps to deter, prevent, detect, and defend against cyber intrusions by investing in cutting-edge research and development,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: promoting cybersecurity awareness and digital literacy,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and strengthening private sector and international partnerships.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama has supported comprehensive cybersecurity legislation that would help business and government protect against risks of cyber attacks while also safeguarding the privacy rights of our citizens.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And, going forward, the President will continue to take executive action to strengthen and update our cyber defenses.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Biological Weapons. Other dangers pose direct and deadly risks to our health and well-being.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The use of a lethal biological agent within a population center would threaten the lives of hundreds of thousands of people.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That’s why President Obama outlined a National Strategy for Countering Biological Threats in 2009 to address the challenges from proliferation of biological weapons or their use by terrorists.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will continue to work at home with first responders and health officials to reduce the risks associated with unintentional or deliberate outbreaks of infectious disease.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will also continue our efforts with domestic and international partners to promote global health security and reinforce norms of safe and responsible conduct; obtain timely and accurate insight on current and emerging risks; take steps to reduce the potential for exploitation; expand our capability to prevent, attribute, and apprehend perpetrators of attacks;  and communicate with all stakeholders.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Climate Change. The national security threat from climate change is real, urgent, and severe.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The change wrought by a warming planet will lead to new conflicts over refugees and resources; new suffering from drought and famine;  catastrophic natural disasters;  and the degradation of vital ecosystems across the globe.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That is why, in addition to undertaking measures to enhance energy independence and promote efficiency, clean energy, and renewable sources of power here at home,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: the President and the Democratic Party have steadily worked to build an international framework to combat climate change.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will seek to implement agreements and build on the progress made during climate talks in Copenhagen, Cancun, and Durban, working to ensure a response to climate change policy that draws upon decisive action by all nations.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Our goal is an effective, international effort in which all major economies commit to reduce their emissions,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: nations meet their commitments in a transparent manner,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and the necessary financing is mobilized so that developing countries can mitigate the effects of climate change and invest in clean energy technologies.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That is why the Obama administration has taken a leadership role in ongoing climate negotiations, working to ensure that other major economies like China and India commit to taking meaningful action.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: It is also why we have worked regionally to build clean energy partnerships in Asia, the Americas, and Africa.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Transnational Crime. Transnational criminal networks also pose significant national security challenges.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: These networks continue to expand dramatically in size and scope, harming people worldwide, posing threats to stability,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and subverting government institutions through corruption.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Transnational criminal organizations have accumulated unprecedented wealth and power through the drug trade, arms smuggling, human trafficking, and other illicit activities, penetrating legitimate financial systems and destabilizing commercial markets.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That’s why, in 2011, the Obama administration released a comprehensive Strategy to Combat Transnational Organized Crime.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We are committed to a multidimensional approach that safeguards citizens,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: breaks the financial strength of criminal and terrorist networks,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: disrupts illicit trafficking networks,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: fights government corruption,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: strengthens the rule of law,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: bolsters judicial systems,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and improves transparency.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We have responded to this threat through aggressive targeting of the illicit financial infrastructure supporting cross-border criminal activity.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we will continue to coordinate with other nations and build their capacity to combat these threats.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The greatest dangers we face – terrorism, nuclear proliferation, cyber and biological attacks, climate change, and transnational crime – cannot be solved by any one nation alone.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Addressing these challenges requires broad and effective global cooperation.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And President Obama and the  Democratic Party understand that this depends on close collaboration with our traditional allies,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: cultivating partnerships with new centers of influence,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and strong U.S. leadership within international institutions.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Europe. The cornerstone of our engagement with the world is our alliances, which had been badly damaged under the Bush administration.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President and the Democratic Party believe the foundation of global security remains our relationships with traditional allies in Europe and Asia, and our enduring commitments to their defense.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That is why President Obama has worked to methodically strengthen our alliances there,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: while pressing our allies to bear a greater share of the burden for tackling regional and global challenges.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President and the Democratic Party recognize America’s enduring interest in supporting peace and prosperity in Europe,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: as well as bolstering the strength and vitality of NATO, which is critical to the security of the continent and beyond.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: A decade of military operations in Afghanistan has strengthened NATO’s fighting skills and enhanced its ability to cooperate at the political level.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: This proved critical to the alliance’s timely, unified, and effective response in Libya.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Going forward, we need to further improve the ability of NATO countries to operate collectively.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Modernizing the alliance will be challenging given fiscal constraints on both sides of the Atlantic.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: But as large-scale military involvement in Afghanistan winds down, NATO has an opportunity to focus on further developing the capabilities required to address 21st century challenges.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Therefore, we will continue to urge our NATO allies to pool, share, and specialize their capabilities,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and to improve their capacity for effective coalition operations.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Meanwhile, even as the presence of U.S. forces in Europe necessarily evolves, the United States will maintain its Article 5 collective security commitments to NATO
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and will continue to leverage America’s comparative advantage in high-end military capabilities to ensure the defense of our allies.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: For example, the President is moving forward with a “phased adaptive approach” to European ballistic-missile defense that will protect both Europe and the United States from missile threats emanating from Iran and elsewhere.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We believe that the United States and Russia can cooperate on missile defense,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: but we have also made clear that we will move forward with our system, beginning with the steps we have taken to deploy it in Poland, Turkey, and Romania.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Asia-Pacific. As we have sought to rebalance our foreign policy, we have also turned greater attention to strengthening our alliances and expanding our partnerships in the Asia-Pacific region.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: In part, this is in recognition that the United States has been, and always will be, a Pacific power.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And, in part, it is a recognition that America’s future security and prosperity will be fundamentally interconnected with Asia given its status as the fastest growing economic region, with most of the world’s nuclear powers and about half of the world’s population.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President has therefore made a deliberate and strategic decision that the United States will play a larger and long-term role in shaping this region and its future.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama has made modernizing America’s defense posture across the Asia-Pacific a top priority.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We remain committed to defending and deepening our partnerships with our allies in the region: Australia, Japan, New Zealand, the Philippines, South Korea, and Thailand.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will maintain a strong presence in Japan and on the Korean Peninsula to deter and defend against provocations by states like North Korea,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: while enhancing our presence in Southeast Asia and in Australia.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will also expand our networks of security cooperation with other emerging partners throughout the region to combat terrorism, counter proliferation, provide disaster relief, fight piracy, and ensure maritime security, including cooperation in the South China Sea.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we will continue to invest in a long-term strategic partnership with India to support its ability to serve as a regional economic anchor and provider of security in the broader Indian Ocean region.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Meanwhile, the President is committed to continuing efforts to build a cooperative relationship with China, while being clear and candid when we have differences.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The world has a profound interest in the rise of a peaceful and prosperous China,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: but China must also understand that it must abide by clear international standards and rules of the road.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: China can be a partner in reducing tensions on the Korean Peninsula, countering proliferation in Iran, confronting climate change, increasing trade, and resolving other global challenges.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama will continue to seek additional opportunities for cooperation with China, including greater communication between our militaries.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will do this even as we continue to be clear about the importance of the Chinese government upholding international economic rules regarding currency, export financing, intellectual property, indigenous innovation, and workers’ rights.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will consistently speak out for the importance of respecting the universal human rights of the Chinese people,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: including the right of the Tibetan people to preserve their cultural and religious identity.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we remain committed to a one China policy, the Taiwan Relations Act, and the peaceful resolution of cross-Strait issues that is consistent with the wishes and best interests of the people of Taiwan.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The Middle East. President Obama and the Democratic Party maintain an unshakable commitment to Israel’s security.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: A strong and secure Israel is vital to the United States not simply because we share strategic interests, but also because we share common values.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: For this reason, despite budgetary constraints, the President has worked with Congress to increase security assistance to Israel every single year since taking office, providing nearly $10 billion in the past three years.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The administration has also worked to ensure Israel’s qualitative military edge in the region.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we have deepened defense cooperation – including funding the Iron Dome system – to help Israel address its most pressing threats, including the growing danger posed by rockets and missiles emanating from the Gaza Strip, Lebanon, Syria, and Iran.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President’s consistent support for Israel’s right to defend itself and his steadfast opposition to any attempt to delegitimize Israel on the world stage are further evidence of our enduring commitment to Israel’s security.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: It is precisely because of this commitment that President Obama and the Democratic Party seek peace between Israelis and Palestinians.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: A just and lasting Israeli-Palestinian accord, producing two states for two peoples, would contribute to regional stability and help sustain Israel’s identity as a Jewish and democratic state.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: At the same time, the President has made clear that there will be no lasting peace unless Israel’s security concerns are met.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama will continue to press Arab states to reach out to Israel.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will continue to support Israel’s peace treaties with Egypt and Jordan, which have been pillars of peace and stability in the region for many years.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And even as the President and the Democratic Party continue to encourage all parties to be resolute in the pursuit of peace,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: we will insist that any Palestinian partner must recognize Israel’s right to exist, reject violence, and adhere to existing agreements.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Elsewhere in the region, President Obama is committed to maintaining robust security cooperation with Gulf Cooperation Council states and our other partners aimed at deterring aggression,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: checking Iran’s destabilizing activities,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: ensuring the free flow of commerce essential to the global economy
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: , and building a regional security architecture to counter terrorism, proliferation, ballistic missiles, piracy, and other common threats.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Jerusalem is and will remain the capital of Israel.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The Americas. In the Americas, we have deepened our economic and security ties with countries throughout the hemisphere, from Canada and Mexico to Brazil and Chile and El Salvador.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We have strengthened cooperation with Mexico, Colombia, and throughout Central America to combat narco-traffickers and criminal gangs that threaten their citizens and ours.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will also work to disrupt organized crime networks seeking to use the Caribbean to smuggle drugs into our country.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: As we collectively confront these challenges, we will continue to support the region’s security forces, border security, and police with the equipment, training, and technologies they need to keep their communities safe.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will improve coordination and share more information so that those who traffic in drugs and in human beings have fewer places to hide.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we will continue to put unprecedented pressure on cartel finances, including in the United States.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Africa. We will continue to partner with African nations to combat al-Qaeda affiliates in places like Somalia and to bring to justice those who commit mass atrocities, like Joseph Kony.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We have made great efforts to reduce the violence in Darfur and built international support for a successful referendum on South Sudan’s future.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And in his first visit as President to the United Nations, President Obama advanced initiatives to strengthen UN peacekeeping capabilities in Africa.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: This includes providing equipment, training, and logistical support for UN and African Union missions in Darfur and Somalia.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President has also worked to help African nations grow their economies, and we have opened trade and investment opportunities across the continent.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The United Nations. International institutions – most prominently the United Nations – have been a centerpiece of international order since the mid-20th century.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And just as American leadership was essential to forging the architecture for international cooperation after World War II, the President and the Democratic Party are committed to modernizing its infrastructure for the 21st century
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: – working to reform international bodies
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and strengthen national and multilateral capabilities to advance peace, security, and opportunity.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We have restored America’s leadership at the UN by cooperating with our partners there when we can and respectfully disagreeing with them when we must, reversing the previous administration’s disdain for the UN.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President’s leadership at the UN has enabled us to make real progress on a number of top national security priorities, including getting Russia and China on board to implement the toughest UN sanctions ever on Iran and North Korea.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: As the United States works with allies and partners to establish an international order that advances peace and prosperity, President Obama and the Democratic Party will continue to build three key pillars of American global leadership: a prosperous and inclusive economy,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: our unsurpassed military strength,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and an enduring commitment to advancing universal values.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: To allow each American to pursue the opportunity upon which our prosperity depends, we are investing in the sources of our long-term economic strength:
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: access to a complete and competitive education for every American;
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: affordable health care so our people, businesses, and government are not constrained by rising costs;
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: training to allow our workers to adapt and win in a rapidly changing global economy;
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: transformations in the way we produce and use energy to reduce our dependence on fossil fuels and create new jobs and industry;
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: infrastructure that fuels commerce;
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: cutting edge developments in science and innovation that support our economy, defense, and technological leadership;
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and making the hard decisions to cut our deficit and put our fiscal house in order.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And, because a growing and open global economy serves as a source of opportunity for the American people and a source of strength for the United States, the President and the Democratic Party have coordinated our economic actions with other countries to address financial crises
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and head off renewed cycles of boom and bust.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We have reformed international institutions to give emerging economies a greater role and more responsibility.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We have promoted trade that is free and fair.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we have supported global economic development.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Abroad, just as we have at home, we have sought to build a new model for 21st century economic growth that is fair and in which every nation plays by the rules
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: – a model where workers’ rights are respected,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: businesses compete on a level playing field,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and intellectual property and new technologies are protected.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Currencies must be market-driven so no nation has an unfair advantage.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Reforms must protect consumers from abuse and reflect a global commitment to end corruption.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we will continue to champion sustainable growth that includes the clean energy that creates green jobs and combats climate change.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Addressing the Global Financial Crisis. Alongside our global partners, we took decisive actions to address the global financial crisis and have worked together to make the global economy and financial system more stable and secure.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: While Europe remains a significant risk to the global economy and while the problems there will not be solved overnight, Europe’s leaders have made clear they will do what is necessary to preserve financial stability in the Eurozone and have the collective ability to address their economic challenges.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We have been and will continue to be in frequent contact with our European allies to discuss best practices and share valuable lessons from our own experience reversing our economic downturn, helping them chart the best way forward.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: As we continue to work with traditional centers of influence, we have also reached out to emerging economies to give them a greater voice and a greater stake in the global economy.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We have made the G-20 the premier forum for international economic coordination in recognition of the fact that 21st century economic discussions must include countries like China, India, Indonesia, and Brazil.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And, together, the nations of the G-20 brought the world economy back from the brink of another depression.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Free and Fair Trade. We have also sought to promote free and fair trade.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Because of the economic dynamism of the Asia-Pacific region, which is already home to more than half the global economy, expanding trade with that region is critical to creating jobs and opportunities for the American people.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Building on the free trade agreement with South Korea that President Obama signed, we are working with our partners in the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Forum to create a seamless regional economy,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: promote green growth,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and coordinate regulatory reform.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Alongside Australia, Brunei Darussalam, Chile, Malaysia, New Zealand, Peru, Singapore, and Vietnam, we are on track to finalize the Trans-Pacific Partnership, a historic high-standard agreement that will address new and emerging trade issues,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: lower barriers to the free flow of trade and investment,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: increase exports,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and create more American jobs.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Exploring opportunities to shape the multilateral trading system to reflect the role and responsibility of major emerging markets in the global economy is a critical part of the President’s trade agenda.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will work to expand free and fair trade in the Americas as well.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We already export more than three times as much to Latin America as we do to China, and we will pursue additional opportunities to expand commerce and promote shared prosperity.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Last year the President signed free trade agreements with Panama and Colombia – agreements that will significantly boost U.S. exports and support thousands of jobs here at home – while protecting labor rights, the environment, and intellectual property.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Because the Caribbean is an important region to our country, we will continue to support robust trade and economic relationships with our partners there.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And, across the region, we are moving ahead with “open skies” agreements to expand opportunities for commercial aviation and to bring our people and businesses closer together.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We have also worked to ensure that American businesses and workers are competing on an even footing with our international competitors, and we have not hesitated to take action.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That’s why the Obama administration has brought trade cases against China at twice the rate of the previous administration
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and recently set up a new Interagency Trade Enforcement Center, which substantially expands our ability to investigate and take action against unfair trade practices around the world.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Advancing Global Development. President Obama recognizes that promoting global development is a strategic, economic, and moral imperative for the United States.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Development expands markets for American products and creates American jobs.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Strong and prosperous regional partners are critical to addressing global challenges,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: ending regional conflicts,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and countering the spread of global criminal networks.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And good governance and stability cannot take root, and basic human dignity cannot be protected, where poverty reigns and people lack access to the food, basic education, clean water, and medicine they need to survive.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: For these reasons, the President this year announced a new strategy toward sub-Saharan Africa that commits to promoting economic growth, including through increased trade and investment.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: They are also why we are providing robust trade and investment support to Africa and building a trade and investment partnership with the countries of East Africa – because we believe that the private sector will be the engine of prosperity in the developing world.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The administration continues to work to promote opportunity and development in sub-Saharan Africa by improving the region’s trade competitiveness, encouraging economic diversification, and ensuring that the benefits from growth are broad-based.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Combating HIV/AIDS and Infectious Disease. Recognizing that health is a prerequisite for development, the President has made unprecedented progress in the global fight against HIV/AIDS and other infectious diseases.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Building on the strong foundation created during the previous administration, the President’s Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief (PEPFAR) has expanded its prevention, care, and treatment programming.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: As a result, PEPFAR now has made significant investments in more than 30 countries, and we set a goal to roughly double the number of lifesaving anti-retroviral treatments we provide by the end of 2013.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: With his latest budget, the President is fulfilling his historic commitment to request $4 billion over three years for the Global Fund,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and the President remains committed to robust funding for PEPFAR and the Global Fund in the future.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And President Obama lifted the 25-year ban that prevented non-citizens living with HIV from entering the United States, allowing the world’s largest group of HIV/AIDS researchers, policymakers, medical professionals, and advocates to convene in Washington to continue their efforts to improve prevention and treatment.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Our efforts to combat HIV/AIDS are part of a broader commitment to address the challenges posed by infectious disease.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Over the past four years, the administration has leveraged billions of dollars in commitments from donors to meet the demand for new vaccines, making it possible to immunize millions of children and prevent premature deaths.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Ensuring Food Security. The President and the Democratic Party believe that true development requires much more than delivering aid – it requires building the capacity of governments and peoples so that assistance is no longer needed.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That is why the administration through its Feed the Future initiative has, with the G-8 and other countries, mobilized more than $22 billion for a global food security effort aimed at building the capacity of nations to feed themselves.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: This year, the President launched the next phase of this global effort – a major new food security partnership to reduce hunger and lift tens of millions of people from poverty across Africa.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: These efforts partner with African countries to improve nutrition for children,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: mitigate risks from volatile food prices,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: increase private capital investments,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: expand access to technologies and information required to boost food production,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and provide greater assistance to countries that implement agricultural reforms.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Responding to Humanitarian Crises. Together with the American people and the international community, we will continue to respond to humanitarian crises around the globe.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will come to the aid of countries during their times of need, just as we did following the 2011 earthquake, tsunami, and Fukushima nuclear disaster in Japan.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And as we did in the aftermath of Haiti’s catastrophic earthquake in January 2010, we will provide critical aid to countries facing devastating circumstances to meet their acute short-term needs and foster long-term recovery.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President led an unprecedented international effort in response to Haiti’s natural disaster, committing over $3.1 billion to relief, reconstruction, and recovery, and launching a multifaceted effort to improve health, promote food security, and strengthen economic security.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: While major challenges remain, President Obama has supported a sustained commitment to Haiti’s reconstruction, and the administration has continued to assist in Haiti’s development.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: America’s unrivaled military capabilities represent a second core pillar of our global leadership.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: After more than a decade of war, we have an opportunity to retool our armed forces and our defense strategy to ensure we both maintain the world’s most capable military and adapt to the challenges of the 21st century.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President and the Democratic Party understand that we have a special obligation to every soldier, sailor, airman, Marine, and Coast Guardsman who puts their life on the line for our nation.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We must send them into harm’s way only when it’s absolutely necessary.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: When we do, we must ensure they have the equipment and the support that they need to get the job done.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we have to take care of our troops, their families, and our veterans when they come home.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Eleven years of continuous military operations and repeated deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan have stretched our forces and strained their families.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Going forward, our troops will face fewer deployments, allowing them more time to train and ensuring that they are ready for the full range of missions they may have to face.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: In our current fiscal environment, we must also make tough budgetary decisions across the board – and that includes within the defense budget.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The Budget Control Act enacted by Congress last year, with the support of Republicans and Democrats alike, mandates reductions in federal spending, including defense spending.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The administration has worked with Congress to make these decisions, which has been a strategy-driven process.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: As we look beyond the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan – and the conclusion of long-term nation-building with large military footprints – we will be able to ensure our security with a more agile and more flexible force.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: At the same time, we will continue to emphasize forward engagement in critical regions,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: while enhancing robust security partnerships to share the burden.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we will continue to get rid of outdated Cold War-era systems so that we can invest in cutting-edge technologies and maintain a versatile set of capabilities required to execute a wide range of military missions.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: America’s leadership extends beyond our economic prosperity and military might – it is also rooted in our enduring commitment to advancing a core set of universal values.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: These include an individual’s freedom to speak their mind, assemble without fear, have access to information, worship as they please, and choose their own leaders.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: They also include dignity, tolerance, and equality among all people, and the fair and equitable administration of justice.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The United States was founded upon a belief in these values, and people of every race, region, and religion around the globe have claimed these principles as their own.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President and the Democratic Party believe that nations that embrace these values for their citizens are ultimately more prosperous, peaceful, and friendly to the United States than those that do not.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Staying True to Our Values at Home. We must always seek to uphold these values at home, not just when it is easy, but, more importantly, when it is hard.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Advancing our interests may involve new actions and policies to confront threats like terrorism, but the President and the Democratic Party believe these practices must always be in line with our Constitution,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: preserve our people’s privacy and civil liberties,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and withstand the checks and balances that have served us so well.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That is why the President banned torture without exception in his first week in office.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That is why we are reforming military commissions to bring them in line with the rule of law.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That is why we are substantially reducing the population at Guantánamo Bay without adding to it.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we remain committed to working with all branches of government to close the prison altogether because it is inconsistent with our national security interests and our values.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Standing With Those Demanding Greater Freedom. As we continue to perfect our union here at home, setting an example for others to follow, we will also continue to champion universal rights abroad.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We recognize that different cultures and traditions give life to these values in distinct ways,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and each country will inevitably chart its own course.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: America will not impose any system of government on another country.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: But we also know that the sovereignty of nations cannot strangle the liberty of individuals.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: So as people around the world yearn for greater freedom, we will continue to support progress toward more accountable, democratic governance
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and the exercise of universal rights.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will do so through a variety of means: by speaking out for universal rights,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: bolstering fragile democracies and civil society,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and supporting the dignity that comes with development.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Across the Middle East and North Africa, we have stood with the people demanding political change and seeking their rights during the Arab Spring.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Since the beginning of the protests in Tunisia, the United States has consistently opposed violence against innocent civilians,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: supported a set of universal rights for the people of the region,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and supported processes of political and economic reform.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: When the Egyptian people flooded Tahrir Square in Cairo demanding democracy, the administration actively engaged the Egyptian government, military, and people in support of a transition away from decades of dictatorship and towards democracy.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: In Libya, we built an international coalition and intervened alongside NATO and other partner nations to protect the Libyan people and support them as they ended Muammar Qadhafi’s brutal reign.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: In Iran, President Obama spoke out in support of the prodemocracy protestors and imposed human rights sanctions on the Iranian government.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: In Yemen, we worked with Gulf Cooperation Council states to facilitate a peaceful transition of power.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And in Syria, we have led the international community to politically and economically isolate the regime, to increase pressure on President Assad to step down,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and to provide assistance to unify the Syrian opposition in order to enable a stable transition.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Moving forward, we will work to hasten the end of the Assad regime and support a political transition to a stable and democratic Syria.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will continue to support the consolidation of democratic transitions in Egypt, Libya, Tunisia, and Yemen.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we will engage governments and civil society across the region on behalf of genuine efforts to promote political and economic reforms that are responsive to the people of the region.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The Arab Spring represents the world’s most sweeping recent movement toward democracy, but it is not an isolated case.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Across the globe, people are demanding more from their governments – and, when they do, they will continue to find support and partnership in the United States.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: For example, in Burma, we successfully employed a combination of sanctions and engagement to encourage the government to open up political space and release political prisoners.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Our historic opening to Burma will continue to incentivize a democratic transition, a deeper engagement with the United States, and national reconciliation among Burma’s many different ethnic groups.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And because human rights violations persist, we will continue to speak clearly about the additional steps that must be taken for the government of Burma to have a better relationship with the United States.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: In Africa, the administration engaged to ensure a legitimate transfer of power in Cote d’Ivoire, supported the independence of South Sudan, and remains actively involved in resolving the issues between Sudan and South Sudan.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: In the Americas, we see vibrant democracies in countries from Mexico to Brazil and Costa Rica to Chile.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We have also seen historic peaceful transfers of power in places like El Salvador and Uruguay.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Yet despite the region’s democratic progress, stark inequalities in political and economic power endure.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will continue to press for more transparent and accountable governance.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we will promote greater freedom in Cuba and Venezuela until all their citizens enjoy the universal rights they deserve.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Under President Obama, we have undertaken the most significant efforts in decades to engage the Cuban people.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We have focused on the importance of the family ties between Cuban Americans and their relatives still living under oppression.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We have taken additional steps to bolster Cuban civil society, expanding purposeful exchanges that bolster independent religious groups on the island and enhancing the free flow of information to, from, and among the Cuban people.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Going forward we will continue to support the Cuban people’s desire to freely determine their own future.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Promoting Transparent, Accountable Governance and the Rule of Law. To promote transparent and accountable government worldwide, we joined with Brazil to launch and co-chair the international Open Government Partnership.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Fifty-five countries now belong to the partnership – representing a quarter of the world’s people – each of which has outlined concrete, credible steps to open the work of government so citizens are empowered, problems are solved, and democracy is strengthened.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President and Democrats know that a commitment to the rule of law and effective judicial institutions are essential to sustainable economic development and must remain a core American value in the years to come.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That is why the Obama administration has successfully pressed for international action against government corruption through the G-20
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and promoted new initiatives to help countries develop stronger judicial institutions.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Because the public’s rights, freedoms, and access to economic opportunity depend on the rule of law, we will continue to work in partnership with our allies to promote this important value around the world.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Standing up for Women’s Rights Around the Globe. As we work to advance universal values and human dignity, the President and the Democratic Party understand the critical importance of expanding protections and opportunities for women and girls around the world.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Ensuring full equality and providing women and girls the opportunity to learn, earn a livable wage, and participate in public decision-making are essential to reduce violence, improve economies, and strengthen democracy.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: To continue to make progress at home and advance women’s rights and opportunities abroad, we will urge ratification of the Convention for the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination Against Women.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama, Secretary of State Hillary Rodham Clinton, and the State Department are committed to advancing the rights of women and girls as a central focus of U.S. diplomatic, development, and defense interests.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will continue to promote the full engagement of women in the political and economic spheres.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: We will work to address underlying socio-economic problems, including women’s access to health, education, and food security.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And we will ensure that women are equal participants in reconciliation and development in areas affected by conflict.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: President Obama and the Democratic Party are committed to supporting family planning around the globe to help women care for their families, support their communities, and lead their countries to be healthier and more productive.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: That’s why, in his first month in office, President Obama overturned the “global gag rule,” a ban on federal funds to foreign family planning organizations that provided information about, counseling on, or offered abortions.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And that is why the administration has supported lifesaving family planning health information and services.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The President and the Democratic Party believe that trafficking in persons is both an affront to our fundamental values and,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: as a source of funds for transnational criminals and terrorist organization, a threat to national and international security.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The Obama administration has used bilateral and multilateral diplomacy, targeted foreign assistance, training programs, public outreach, and law enforcement to combat trafficking in persons across the globe.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The administration has continued to provide annual assessments of the strengths and weaknesses of foreign governments’ efforts to address the issue, encouraging all countries to do more and calling out countries that have failed to do enough.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And the administration has provided technical assistance to improve law enforcement and grants to support grassroots prevention efforts around the world targeting sex and labor trafficking, child sex tourism, forced child labor, and other abuses.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The administration is also committed to taking action at home to fight trafficking, including the sex trafficking of young girls.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Gay Rights as Human Rights. Recognizing that gay rights are human rights, the President and his administration have vowed to actively combat efforts by other nations that criminalize homosexual conduct or ignore abuse.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Under the Obama administration, American diplomats must raise the issue wherever harassment or abuse arises, and they are required to record it in the State Department’s annual report on human rights.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: And the State Department is funding a program that finances gay rights organizations to combat discrimination, violence, and other abuses.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: Internet Freedom. The Obama administration has led the world to recognize and defend Internet freedom – the freedom of expression, assembly, and association online for people everywhere – through coalitions of countries and by empowering individuals with innovative technologies.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: The administration has built partnerships to support an Internet that is secure and reliable and that is respectful of U.S. intellectual property, free flow of information, and privacy.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: To preserve the Internet as a platform for commerce, debate, learning, and innovation in the 21st century, we successfully negotiated international Internet policymaking principles,
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform

text: and oppose the extension of intergovernmental controls over the Internet.
title: Moving America Forward. 2012 Democratic National Platform
