title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats support ambitious public and private investments in science, technology, and research.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We are focused on creating good jobs in communities across America.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Entrepreneurship and innovation are fundamental to our future economic growth—in the information technology (IT) industry as well as energy, manufacturing, transportation, health, retail, services, and countless other sectors.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will nurture the next generation of scientists, engineers, and entrepreneurs,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: especially women and people of color,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: to make sure America continues to out-compete and out-innovate the rest of the world with our bold innovation agenda.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: New technologies are already transforming our economy, and they have the power to generate trillions in economic output.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We must harness these forces so that they create higher-paying jobs across the country,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: bring more people into the workforce,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and reduce inequality.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: To do this, we need to educate our people
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and train our workforce;
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: support entrepreneurship
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and promote inclusion in the digital economy;
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: attract and retain talented people from all over the world;
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and invest in research and development, innovation hubs, as well as in getting ideas to market.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We also need to ensure that all students have the opportunity to learn computer science by the time they graduate from high school.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe we must harness the promise of technological innovation to promote community participation
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and enhance opportunities to achieve greater economic self-sufficiency for people with disabilities.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will encourage technology transfer, entrepreneurship, and small business creation throughout the country and in all types of innovation sectors.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: High-speed internet connectivity is not a luxury; it is a necessity for 21st century economic success, social mobility, education, health care, and public safety.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Despite considerable progress and private investment in the last eight years to close the digital divide, there is more work to do.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will finish the job of connecting every household in America to high-speed broadband, increase internet adoption, and help hook up anchor institutions so they can offer free WiFi to the public.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will take action to help America widely deploy 5G technology—the next generation wireless service that will not only bring faster internet connections to underserved areas, but will enable the Internet of Things and a host of transformative technologies.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats support a free and open internet at home and abroad, and will oppose any effort by Republicans to roll back the historic net neutrality rules that the Federal Communications Commission enacted last year.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats value American innovation and believe it is one of our country’s great strengths.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will protect the intellectual property rights of artists, creators, and inventors at home and abroad.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The entire nation prospers when we promote the unique and original artistic and cultural contributions of the women and men who create and preserve our nation’s heritage.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will fight against unfair theft of intellectual property and trade secrets.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will increase access to global markets for American intellectual property and other digital trade by opposing quotas, discriminatory measures, and data localization requirements.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Pushing beyond the boundaries of what we know is core to who we are as Americans.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats are immensely proud of all that the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) has done—through its achievements in science, technology and exploration—to better understand our place in the universe
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and inspire and educate generations of young people in this country to pursue careers in science.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Space exploration is a reminder that our capacity for curiosity is limitless, and may be matched only by our ability to achieve great things if we work together.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe in continuing the spirit of discovery that has animated NASA’s exploration of space over the last half century.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will strengthen support for NASA and work in partnership with the international scientific community to launch new missions to space.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The Democratic Party will make it easier to start and grow a small business in America,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: unlike Donald Trump, who has often stiffed small businesses—nearly bankrupting some—with his deceptive and reckless corporate practices.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: By supporting small business and entrepreneurship, we can grow jobs faster in America.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will cut the red tape that holds back small businesses and entrepreneurs.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will open up access to credit because we know that small businesses are some of the best job creators in our country.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will provide tax relief and tax simplification.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: And we will expand access to new markets because every American small business should be able to tap new markets — whether across their city, across their state, or around the world.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will provide targeted funding and support for entrepreneurship and small business growth in underserved communities.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats also realize the critical importance of small businesses as engines of opportunity for women, people of color, tribes, and people in rural America, and will work to nurture entrepreneurship.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will make investments to spur the creation of millions of jobs for our young people.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Roughly one in ten Americans between the ages of 16 and 24 is unemployed, more than twice the national average.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The unemployment rates for African American, Latino, Asian American and Pacific Islander (AAPI), and American Indian teenager sand youth with disabilities are far too high.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: That is why Democrats will provide direct federal funding for a range of local programs that will put young people to work and create new career opportunities.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe that today’s extreme levels of income and wealth inequality are bad for our people, bad for our businesses, and bad for our economy.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Our country depends on a thriving middle class to drive economic growth, but the middle class is shrinking.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Meanwhile, the top one-tenth of one percent of Americans now own almost as much wealth as the bottom 90 percent combined.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: These trends create problems beyond insulting our sense of basic fairness.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Social mobility is far lower than most believe it to be.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Children who are born to families in the lowest fifth of earnings are more than 10 times more likely to remain there as adults than they are to earn as much as those in the top fifth.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Unless we invest in building a level playing field, we all lose.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: To restore economic fairness, Democrats will fight against the greed and recklessness of Wall Street.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Wall Street cannot be an island unto itself, gambling trillions in risky financial instruments and making huge profits, all the while thinking that taxpayers will be there to bail them out again.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We must tackle dangerous risks in big banks and elsewhere in the financial system.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We must make Wall Street work for the job-creating, productive economy—including by making loans more affordable for small- and medium-sized businesses.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We need to prohibit Wall Street from picking and choosing which credit agency will rate its products as well as from imposing excessive fees on consumers.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: And we must hold both individuals and corporations accountable when they break the law.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe that no bank can be too big to fail and no executive too powerful to jail.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will support stronger criminal laws and civil penalties for Wall Street criminals who prey on the public trust.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We also support extending the statute of limitations for prosecuting major financial fraud, and providing the Department of Justice, the Securities and Exchange Commission, and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission more resources to prosecute wrongdoing.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: “Equal Justice Under Law” will not just be words engraved on the entrance of the Supreme Court.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: It will be the standard that applies to Wall Street and all Americans.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will also vigorously implement, enforce, and build on President Obama’s landmark Dodd-Frank financial reform law, and we will stop dead in its tracks every Republican effort to weaken it.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will stop Republican efforts to hamstring our regulators through budget cuts,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and we will ensure they have the resources and independence to fully enforce the law and hold both individuals and corporations accountable when they break the rules.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will also continue to protect consumers and defend the CFPB from Republican attacks.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We oppose any efforts to change the CFPB’s structure from a single director to a partisan, gridlocked Commission and likewise oppose any efforts to remove the Bureau’s independent funding and subject it to the appropriations process.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will also continue to support the CFPB in enforcing foundational civil rights laws protecting against discrimination in consumer lending.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats condemn predatory payday lending, and will protect consumers by defending the CFPB and implementing strong new regulations.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Our goal must be to create a financial system and an economy that works for all Americans, not just a handful of billionaires.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We support a financial transactions tax on Wall Street to curb excessive speculation and high-frequency trading, which has threatened financial markets.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We acknowledge that there is room within our party for a diversity of views on a broader financial transactions tax.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will not hesitate to use and expand existing authorities as well as empower regulators to downsize or break apart financial institutions when necessary to protect the public and safeguard financial stability, including new authorities to go after risky shadow-banking activities.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Banks should not be able to gamble with taxpayers’ deposits or pose an undue risk to Main Street.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats support a variety of ways to stop this from happening, including an updated and modernized version of Glass-Steagall as well as breaking up too-big-to-fail financial institutions that pose a systemic risk to the stability of our economy.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We believe that personnel is policy.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will nominate and appoint regulators and officials who are not beholden to the industries they regulate—people with a track record of standing up to power and safeguarding the public trust.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will crack down on the revolving door between the private sector—particularly Wall Street—and the federal government.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will ban golden parachutes for those taking government jobs.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will limit conflicts of interest by requiring bank and corporate regulators to recuse themselves from official work on particular matters that would directly benefit their former employers.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: And we will bar financial service regulators from lobbying their former colleagues for at least two years.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will protect and defend the Federal Reserve’s independence to carry out the dual mandate assigned to it by Congress—for both full employment and low inflation—against threats from new legislation.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will also reform the Federal Reserve to make it more representative of America as a whole,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and we will fight to enhance its independence by ensuring that executives of financial institutions are not allowed to serve on the boards of regional Federal Reserve banks or to select members of those boards.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: At a time when many of the largest banks have shunned communities across America, Democrats believe that we need to give Americans affordable banking options, including by empowering the United States Postal Service to facilitate the delivery of basic banking services.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Large corporations have concentrated their control over markets to a greater degree than Americans have seen in decades
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: —further evidence that the deck is stacked for those at the top.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will take steps to stop corporate concentration in any industry where it is unfairly limiting competition.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will make competition policy and antitrust stronger and more responsive to our economy today,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: enhance the antitrust enforcement arms of the Department of Justice (DOJ) and the Federal Trade Commission (FTC),
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and encourage other agencies to police anti-competitive practices in their areas of jurisdiction.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We support the historic purpose of the antitrust laws to protect competition and prevent excessively consolidated economic and political power,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: which can be corrosive to a healthy democracy.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We support reinvigorating DOJ and FTC enforcement of antitrust laws to prevent abusive behavior by dominant companies,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and protecting the public interest against abusive, discriminatory, and unfair methods of commerce.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We support President Obama’s recent Executive Order, directing all agencies to identify specific actions they can take in their areas of jurisdiction to detect anticompetitive practices—such as tying arrangements, price fixing, and exclusionary conduct
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: —and to refer practices that appear to violate federal antitrust law to the DOJ and FTC.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: At a time of massive income and wealth inequality,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: we believe the wealthiest Americans and largest corporations must pay their fair share of taxes.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will claw back tax breaks for companies that ship jobs overseas,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: eliminate tax breaks for big oil and gas companies,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and crack down on inversions and other methods companies use to dodge their tax responsibilities.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will make sure that our tax code rewards businesses that make investments and provide good-paying jobs here in the United States, not businesses that walk out on America.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will end deferrals so that American corporations pay United States taxes immediately on foreign profits and can no longer escape paying their fair share of U.S. taxes by stashing profits abroad.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will then use the revenue raised from fixing the corporate tax code to reinvest in rebuilding America
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and ensuring economic growth
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: that will lead to millions of good-paying jobs.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will ensure those at the top contribute to our country’s future by establishing a multimillionaire surtax to ensure millionaires and billionaires pay their fair share.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: In addition, we will shut down the “private tax system” for those at the top,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: immediately close egregious loopholes like those enjoyed by hedge fund managers, restore fair taxation on multimillion dollar estates,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and ensure millionaires can no longer pay a lower rate than their secretaries.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: At a time of near-record corporate profits, slow wage growth, and rising costs,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: we need to offer tax relief to middle-class families
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: —not those at the top.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe that no one should be able avoid paying their fair share by hiding money abroad,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and that corrupt leaders and terrorists should not be able to use the system of international finance to their advantage.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will work to crack down on tax evasion
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and promote transparency to fight corruption and terrorism.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: And we will make sure that law-abiding Americans living abroad are not unfairly penalized by finding the right solutions for them to the requirements under the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) and Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR).
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will offer tax relief to hard working, middle-class families for the cost squeeze they have faced for years from rising health care, childcare, education, and other expenses.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Donald Trump and the Republican Party would do the opposite and provide trillions in tax cuts for millionaires, billionaires, and corporations
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: at the expense of working families, seniors, and the health of our economy.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats acknowledge that for millions of Americans, global trade has failed to live up to its promise
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: —with too many countries breaking the rules
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and too many corporations outsourcing jobs at the expense of American workers and communities.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Over the past three decades, America has signed too many trade deals that have not lived up to the hype.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Trade deals often boosted the profits of large corporations,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: while at the same time failing to protect workers’ rights, labor standards,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: the environment,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and public health.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We need to end the race to the bottom and develop trade policies that support jobs in America.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: That is why Democrats believe we should review agreements negotiated years ago to update them to reflect these principles.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Any future trade agreements must make sure our trading partners cannot undercut American workers by taking shortcuts on labor policy
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: or the environment.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: They must not undermine democratic decision-making through special privileges and private courts for corporations,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and trade negotiations must be transparent and inclusive.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats’ priority is to significantly strengthen enforcement of existing trade rules and the tools we have, including by holding countries accountable on currency manipulation and significantly expanding enforcement resources.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: China and other countries are using unfair trade practices to tilt the playing field against American workers and businesses.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: When they dump cheap products into our markets, subsidize state-owned enterprises, devalue currencies, and discriminate against American companies, our middle class pays the price.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: That has to stop.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will use all our trade enforcement tools to hold China and other trading partners accountable—because no country should be able to manipulate their currencies to gain a competitive advantage.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: While we believe that openness to the world economy is an important source of American leadership and dynamism,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: we will oppose trade agreements that do not support good American jobs, raise wages,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and improve our national security.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We believe any new trade agreements must include strong and enforceable labor and environmental standards in their core text with streamlined and effective enforcement mechanisms.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Trade agreements should crack down on the unfair and illegal subsidies other countries grant their businesses at the expense of ours.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: It should promote innovation of and access to lifesaving medicines.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: And it should protect a free and open internet.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We should never enter into a trade agreement that prevents our government, or other governments, from putting in place rules that protect the environment, food safety, or the health of American citizens or others around the world.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: These are the standards Democrats believe must be applied to all trade agreements, including the Trans-Pacific Partnership (TPP).
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe that everyone deserves the chance to live up to his or her God-given potential.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We know that there are barriers standing in the way of that goal,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: from the enduring scourge of systemic racism
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: to our deeply broken immigration system
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: to discrimination against people on the basis of sexual orientation or gender identity
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: —and we are committed to facing those problems and fixing them.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Being stronger together means reaching communities that have been left out and left behind for too long, from coal country to Indian Country to neighborhoods held back by multigenerational poverty.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: In America, we do not tear each other down—we lift each other up.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will fight to end institutional and systemic racism in our society.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will challenge and dismantle the structures that define lasting racial, economic, political, and social inequity.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will promote racial justice through fair, just, and equitable governing of all public-serving institutions and in the formation of public policy.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats support removing the Confederate battle flag from public properties, recognizing that it is a symbol of our nation's racist past that has no place in our present or our future.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will push for a societal transformation to make it clear that black lives matter and that there is no place for racism in our country.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: America’s economic inequality problem is even more pronounced when it comes to racial and ethnic disparities in wealth and income.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: It is unacceptable that the median wealth for African Americans and Latino Americans is roughly one-tenth that of white Americans.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: These disparities are also stark for American Indians and certain Asian American subgroups, and may become even more significant when considering other characteristics such as age, disability status, sexual
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The racial wealth and income gaps are the result of policies that discriminate against people of color
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and constrain their ability to earn income and build assets to the same extent as other Americans.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: It has accumulated over time and is made worse by ongoing policies and practices.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: For example, African Americans and Latinos lost more than half of their net worth as a result of the housing crisis and the Great Recession, because they lost jobs at a much faster rate than white workers and because they were disproportionately targeted for subprime, predatory, and fraudulent mortgages during the run-up to the housing crisis.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe it is long past time to close this racial wealth gap.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Disparities in wealth cannot be solved by the free market alone,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: but instead, the federal government must play a role in eliminating systemic barriers to wealth accumulation for different racial groups
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and improving opportunities for people from all racial and ethnic backgrounds to build wealth.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Federal policies must remove barriers to achieving sustainable homeownership,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: provide for greater diversity in federal and state contracting practices,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: incentivize and expand access to retirement investment programs,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: increase opportunities for quality jobs and education,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and challenge the deeply rooted structures that perpetuate and exacerbate current disparities and ultimately stagnate the nation’s economic growth and security.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats are committed to reforming our criminal justice system and ending mass incarceration.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Something is profoundly wrong when almost a quarter of the world’s prison population is in the United States, even though our country has less than five percent of the world’s population.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will reform mandatory minimum sentences and close private prisons and detention centers.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Research and evidence, rather than slogans and sound bites, must guide criminal justice policies.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will rebuild the bonds of trust between law enforcement and the communities they serve.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Across the country, there are police officers inspiring trust and confidence, honorably doing their duty, deploying creative and effective strategies, and demonstrating that it is possible to prevent crime without relying on unnecessary force.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: They deserve our respect and support, and we should learn from those examples and build on what works.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will work with police chiefs to invest in training for officers on issues such as de-escalation and the creation of national guidelines for the appropriate use of force.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will encourage better police-community relations, require the use of body cameras, and stop the use of weapons of war that have no place in our communities.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will end racial profiling that targets individuals solely on the basis of race, religion, ethnicity, or national origin, which is un-American and counterproductive.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We should report national data on policing strategies and provide greater transparency and accountability.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will require the Department of Justice to investigate all questionable or suspicious police-involved shootings,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and we will support states and localities who help make those investigations and prosecutions more transparent, including through reforming the grand jury process.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will assist states in providing a system of public defense that is adequately resourced and which meets American Bar Association standards.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: And we will reform the civil asset forfeiture system to protect people and remove perverse incentives for law enforcement to “police for a profit.”
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Instead of investing in more jails and incarceration, we need to invest more in jobs and education, and end the school-to-prison pipeline.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will remove barriers to help formerly incarcerated individuals successfully re-enter society by “banning the box,” expanding reentry programs, and restoring voting rights.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We think the next President should take executive action to ban the box for federal employers and contractors, so applicants have an opportunity to demonstrate their qualifications before being asked about their criminal records.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The "war on drugs" has led to the imprisonment of millions of Americans, disproportionately people of color, without reducing drug use.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Whenever possible, Democrats will prioritize prevention and treatment over incarceration when tackling addiction and substance use disorder.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will build on effective models of drug courts, veterans’ courts, and other diversionary programs that seek to give nonviolent offenders opportunities for rehabilitation as opposed to incarceration.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Because of conflicting federal and state laws concerning marijuana, we encourage the federal government to remove marijuana from the list of “Schedule 1" federal controlled substances and to appropriately regulate it, providing a reasoned pathway for future legalization.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We believe that the states should be laboratories of democracy on the issue of marijuana, and those states that want to decriminalize it or provide access to medical marijuana should be able to do so.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We support policies that will allow more research on marijuana, as well as reforming our laws to allow legal marijuana businesses to exist without uncertainty.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: And we recognize our current marijuana laws have had an unacceptable disparate impact in terms of arrest rates for African Americans that far outstrip arrest rates for whites, despite similar usage rates.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will abolish the death penalty, which has proven to be a cruel and unusual form of punishment.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: It has no place in the United States of America.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The application of the death penalty is arbitrary and unjust.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The cost to taxpayers far exceeds those of life imprisonment.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: It does not deter crime.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: And, exonerations show a dangerous lack of reliability for what is an irreversible punishment.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We have been inspired by the movements for criminal justice that directly address the discriminatory treatment of African Americans, Latinos, Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders, and American Indians to rebuild trust in the criminal justice system.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The United States was founded as, and continues to be, a country of immigrants from throughout the world.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: It is no coincidence that the Statue of Liberty is one of our most profound national symbols.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: And that is why Democrats believe immigration is not just a problem to be solved, it is a defining aspect of the American character and our shared history.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The Democratic Party supports legal immigration, within reasonable limits, that meets the needs of families, communities, and the economy
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: as well as maintains the United States’ role as a beacon of hope for people seeking safety, freedom, and security.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: People should come to the United States with visas and not through smugglers.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Yet, we recognize that the current immigration system is broken.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: More than 11 million people are living in the shadows, without proper documentation.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The immigration bureaucracy is full of backlogs that result in U.S. citizens waiting for decades to be reunited with family members, and green card holders waiting for years to be reunited with their spouses and minor children.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The current quota system discriminates against certain immigrants, including immigrants of color, and needs to be reformed to the realities of the 21st century.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: And there are real questions about our detention and deportation policies that must be addressed.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe we need to urgently fix our broken immigration system—which tears families apart and keeps workers in the shadows—
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and create a path to citizenship for law-abiding families who are here, making a better life for their families and contributing to their communities and our country.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We should repeal the 3-year, 10-year and permanent bars, which often force persons in mixed status families into the heartbreaking dilemma of either pursuing a green card by leaving the country and their loved ones behind, or remaining in the shadows.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will work with Congress to end the forced and prolonged expulsion from the country that these immigrants endure when trying to adjust their status.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We must fix family backlogs and defend against those who would exclude or eliminate legal immigration avenues and denigrate immigrants.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Those immigrants already living in the United States, who are assets to their communities and contribute so much to our country, should be incorporated completely into our society through legal processes that give meaning to our national motto: E Pluribus Unum.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: And while we continue to fight for comprehensive immigration reform, we will defend and implement President Obama’s Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals and Deferred Action for Parents of Americans executive actions to help DREAMers, parents of citizens, and lawful permanent residents avoid deportation.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will build on these actions to provide relief for others, such as parents of DREAMers.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will support efforts by states to make DREAMers eligible for driver's licenses and in-state college tuition.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will invest in culturally-appropriate immigrant integration services, expand access to English language education, and promote naturalization to help the millions of people who are eligible for citizenship take that last step.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We believe immigration enforcement must be humane and consistent with our values.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform
