text: Democrats believe that, in general, the most effective way to identify problems facing our country and develop good solutions is by enacting evidence-based public policy.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We recognize the value of data in allowing us to count and carefully consider the needs of different communities.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: That is why we will preserve and enhance the integrity and accuracy of the census and the American Community Survey (ACS).
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will equip the Census Bureau with the resources needed to prepare for and conduct a cost effective, complete and accurate census,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: as well as improve counting segments of the population that are historically and persistently undercounted, specifically communities of color, immigrants, LGBT people, young children, those with disabilities, and rural and low-income populations.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will also maintain the legal requirement for the public to participate and be counted.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats also believe that government services should be culturally and linguistically appropriate and that data should be disaggregated for those communities, like Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders, where it is necessary to fully understand and address their needs.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Finally, Democrats will make government simpler and more user-friendly.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The federal government too often operates with websites designed from another era that are too complicated, too hard to use, and rarely designed for mobile phones or tablets.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will build on the creation of the United States Digital Service (USDS) and give it the resources it needs to transform and digitize the top 25 federal government programs that directly serve citizens.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will eliminate internal barriers to government modernization.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: And we will use technology to improve outcomes and government accountability by embracing prioritized goal setting and performance tracking for the federal government.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Climate change is an urgent threat and a defining challenge of our time.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Fifteen of the 16 hottest years on record have occurred this century.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: While Donald Trump has called climate change a “hoax,”
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: 2016 is on track to break global temperature records once more.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Cities from Miami to Baltimore are already threatened by rising seas.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: California and the West have suffered years of brutal drought.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Alaska has been scorched by wildfire.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: New York has been battered by superstorms, and Texas swamped by flash floods.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The best science tells us that without ambitious, immediate action across our economy to cut carbon pollution and other greenhouse gases, all of these impacts will be far worse in the future.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We cannot leave our children a planet that has been profoundly damaged.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats share a deep commitment to tackling the climate challenge;
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: creating millions of good-paying middle class jobs;
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: reducing greenhouse gas emissions more than 80 percent below 2005 levels by 2050;
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and meeting the pledge President Obama put forward in the landmark Paris Agreement, which aims to keep global temperature increases to “well below” two degrees Celsius and to pursue efforts to limit global temperature increases to 1.5 degrees Celsius.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We believe America must be running entirely on clean energy by mid-century.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will take bold steps to slash carbon pollution and protect clean air at home,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: lead the fight against climate change around the world,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: ensure no Americans are left out or left behind as we accelerate the transition to a clean energy economy,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and be responsible stewards of our natural resources and our public lands and waters.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats reject the notion that we have to choose between protecting our planet and creating good-paying jobs.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We can and we will do both.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We are committed to getting 50 percent of our electricity from clean energy sources within a decade, with half a billion solar panels installed within four years and enough renewable energy to power every home in the country.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will cut energy waste in American homes, schools, hospitals, and offices through energy efficient improvements;
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: modernize our electric grid;
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and make American manufacturing the cleanest and most efficient in the world.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: These efforts will create millions of new jobs
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and save families and businesses money on their monthly energy bills.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will transform American transportation by reducing oil consumption through cleaner fuels, vehicle electrification increasing the fuel efficiency of cars, boilers, ships, and trucks.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will make new investments in public transportation and build bicycle and pedestrian infrastructure across our urban and suburban areas.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe the tax code must reflect our commitment to a clean energy future by eliminating special tax breaks and subsidies for fossil fuel companies
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: as well as defending and extending tax incentives for energy efficiency and clean energy.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe that carbon dioxide, methane, and other greenhouse gases should be priced to reflect their negative externalities,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and to accelerate the transition to a clean energy economy and help meet our climate goals.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe that climate change is too important to wait for climate deniers and defeatists in Congress to start listening to science, and support using every tool available to reduce emissions now.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats are committed to defending, implementing, and extending smart pollution and efficiency standards, including the Clean Power Plan,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: fuel economy standards for automobiles and heavy-duty vehicles, building codes and appliance standards.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We are also committed to expanding clean energy research and development.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats recognize the importance of climate leadership at the local level and know that achieving our national clean energy goals requires an active partnership with states, cities, and rural communities where so much of our country’s energy policy is made.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will ensure that those taking the lead on clean energy and energy efficiency have the tools and resources they need to succeed.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The federal government should lead by example, which is why we support taking steps to power the government with 100 percent clean electricity.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats are committed to closing the Halliburton loophole that stripped the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) of its ability to regulate hydraulic fracturing,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and ensuring tough safeguards are in place, including Safe Drinking Water Act provisions, to protect local water supplies.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We believe hydraulic fracturing should not take place where states and local communities oppose it.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will reduce methane emissions from all oil and gas production and transportation by at least 40 to 45 percent below 2005 levels by 2025 through common-sense standards for both new and existing sources and by repairing and replacing thousands of miles of leaky pipes.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: This will both protect our climate and create thousands of good-paying jobs.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will work to expand access to cost-saving renewable energy by low-income households,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: create good-paying jobs in communities that have struggled with energy poverty,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and oppose efforts by utilities to limit consumer choice or slow clean energy deployment.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will streamline federal permitting to accelerate the construction of new transmission lines to get low-cost renewable energy to market,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and incentivize wind, solar, and other renewable energy over the development of new natural gas power plants.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We support President Obama's decision to reject the Keystone XL pipeline.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: As we continue working to reduce carbon dioxide, methane, and other greenhouse gas emissions, we must ensure federal actions do not “significantly exacerbate” global warming.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We support a comprehensive approach that ensures all federal decisions going forward contribute to solving, not significantly exacerbating, climate change.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe that our commitment to meeting the climate challenge must also be reflected in the infrastructure investments we make.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We need to make our existing infrastructure safer and cleaner and build the new infrastructure necessary to power our clean energy future.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: To create good-paying middle class jobs that cannot be outsourced,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats support high labor standards in clean energy infrastructure and the right to form or join a union,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: whether in renewable power or advanced vehicle manufacturing.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: During the clean energy transition, we will ensure landowners, communities of color, and tribal nations are at the table.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe clean air and clean water are basic rights of all Americans.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Yet as we saw in Flint, Michigan, low-income communities and communities of color are disproportionately home to environmental justice “hot spots,” where air pollution, water pollution, and toxic hazards like lead increase health and economic hardship.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The impacts of climate change will also disproportionately affect low-income and minority communities, tribal nations, and Alaska Native villages—
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: all of which suffer the worst losses during extreme weather and have the fewest resources to prepare.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Simply put, this is environmental racism.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe we must make it a national priority to eradicate lead poisoning, which disproportionately impacts low-income children and children of color and can lead to lifelong health and educational challenges.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will prioritize hiring and training workers from affected communities to clean up toxic brownfields and expand clean energy, energy efficiency, and resilient infrastructure.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The fight against climate change must not leave any community out or behind
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: —including the coal communities who kept America’s lights on for generations.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will fight to make sure these workers and their families get the benefits they have earned and the respect they deserve,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and we will make new investments in energy-producing communities to help create jobs and build a brighter and more resilient economic future.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will also oppose threats to the public health of these communities from harmful and dangerous extraction practices, like mountaintop removal mining operations.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: All corporations owe it to their shareholders to fully analyze and disclose the risks they face, including climate risk.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Those who fail to do so should be held accountable.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats also respectfully request the Department of Justice to investigate allegations of corporate fraud on the part of fossil fuel companies accused of misleading shareholders and the public on the scientific reality of climate change.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe in the conservation and collaborative stewardship of our shared natural heritage: the public lands and waterways, the oceans, Everglades, Great Lakes, the Arctic, and all that makes America’s great outdoors priceless.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: As a nation, we need policies and investments that will keep America’s public lands public,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: strengthen protections for our natural and cultural resources,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: increase access to parks and public lands for all Americans,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: protect native species and wildlife,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and harness the immense economic and social potential of our public lands and waters.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will work to establish an American Parks Trust Fund to help expand local, state, and national recreational opportunities, rehabilitate existing parks, and enhance America's great outdoors—from our forests and coasts to neighborhood parks—
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: so “America’s Best Idea” is held in trust for future generations,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and all Americans can access and enjoy natural spaces.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats are committed to doubling the size of the outdoor economy, creating nearly hundreds of billions of dollars in new economic activity and millions of new jobs.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will approach conservation of our public lands and waters in a way that reflects the diversity of our country, by actively engaging all Americans in the great outdoors and protecting natural landscapes and cultural sites that tell the story of America's complex history.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: To help meet these goals, we will work to build a diverse workforce in agencies that manage America's public lands, waters, and cultural sites.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We oppose drilling in the Arctic and off the Atlantic coast,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and believe we need to reform fossil fuel leasing on public lands.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will phase down extraction of fossil fuels from our public lands, starting with the most polluting sources,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: while making our public lands and waters engines of the clean energy economy and creating jobs across the country.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will work to expand the amount of renewable energy production on federal lands and waters, from wind in Wyoming to solar in Nevada.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats oppose efforts to undermine the effectiveness of the Endangered Species Act to protect threatened and endangered species.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Because the Bristol Bay drainages of Alaska produce the world’s largest salmon fisheries, we support efforts by the EPA under the Clean Water Act to establish proactively science-based restrictions on discharges of dredged or fill material associated with a potential Pebble mine and urge that such restrictions must apply to potential mines at other metallic sulfide deposits in those drainages.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Agricultural lands account for nearly half of the total land area in America and our agricultural practices have a significant impact on our water, land, oceans, and the climate.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Therefore, we believe that in order to be effective in keeping our air and water clean and combating climate change,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: we must enlist farmers as partners in promoting conservation and stewardship.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats know that every child, no matter who they are, how much their families earn, or where they live, should have access to a high-quality education, from preschool through high school and beyond.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: But the United States still lags behind other advanced economies in providing high-quality, universal preschool programs to help all of our kids get a strong start to their educations.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Our schools are more segregated today than they were when Brown v.  Board of Education was decided,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and we see wide disparities in educational outcomes across racial and socioeconomic lines.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: A college degree or another form of post-secondary education is increasingly required for jobs that pay a middle-class wage,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: but graduation rates have stagnated for low-income students.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: And the high cost of college has required too many Americans to take out staggering student loans or put a degree out of reach entirely.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We are selling our children and our young people short.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats are committed to making good public schools available to every child, no matter what zip code they live in, and at last making debt-free college a reality for all Americans.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe that in America, if you want a higher education, you should always be able to get one: money should never stand in the way.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Cost should not be a barrier to getting a degree or credential, and debt should not hold you back after you graduate.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Bold new investments by the federal government,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: coupled with states reinvesting in higher education and colleges holding the line on costs,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: will ensure that Americans of all backgrounds will be prepared for the jobs and economy of the future.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats are unified in their strong belief that every student should be able to go to college debt-free,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and working families should not have to pay any tuition to go to public colleges and universities.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will also make community college free,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: while ensuring the strength of our Historically Black Colleges and Universities and Minority-Serving Institutions.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The federal government will push more colleges and universities to take quantifiable, affirmative steps in increasing the percentages of racial and ethnic minority, low-income, and first-generation students they enroll and graduate.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Achieving these goals depends on state and federal investment in both students and their teachers.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Whether full-time or adjunct, faculty must be supported to make transformative educational experiences possible.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: As we make college affordable for future students,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: we will not forget about the millions of borrowers with unsustainable levels of student debt, who need help right now.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will allow those who currently have student debt to refinance their loans at the lowest rates possible.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will simplify and expand access to income-based repayment so that no student loan borrowers ever have to pay more than they can afford.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: And we will significantly cut interest rates for future undergraduates because we believe that making college more affordable is more important than the federal government making billions of dollars in profit off those loans.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will also fight for a student borrower bill of rights to ensure borrowers get adequate information about options to avoid or get out of delinquency or default.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will hold lenders and loan servicers to high standards to help borrowers in default rehabilitate and repay their debts.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will continue the important Public Service Loan Forgiveness and loan discharge programs begun by the Obama Administration.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Finally, Democrats will restore the prior standard in bankruptcy law to allow borrowers with student loans to be able to discharge their debts in bankruptcy as a measure of last resort.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: To make progress toward these goals, the government should offer a moratorium on student loan payments to all federal loan borrowers so they have the time and get the resources they need to consolidate their loans, enroll in income-based repayment programs, and take advantage of opportunities to reduce monthly payments and fees.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will strengthen our nation’s public and private Historically Black Colleges and Universities, Predominantly Black Institutions, Hispanic-Serving Institutions, Asian American and Native American Pacific Islander-Serving Institutions, Tribal Colleges and Universities, Alaska Native and Native Hawaiian-Serving Institutions, Native American-Serving Nontribal Institutions, and minority-serving institutions.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Many of these schools educate disproportionate percentages of growing populations of Americans: students who are racial and ethnic minorities, low-income students, and first-generation students.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: As the nation is grappling with how to expand educational access and increase success, especially for communities of color and low-income students and families, there is evidence that the nation’s HBCUs and Minority Serving Institutions have honed promising models for educating these students to prepare them for high- and critical-need positions while containing costs.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will create a robust and historic dedicated fund to keep costs down, provide quality education, and ensure dedicated support to improve student outcomes and completion rates.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will provide further assistance to students at these schools, as well as other students across the country,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: by restoring year-round Pell funding so that low- and middle-income students from all backgrounds can get the support they need to make progress toward a college degree throughout the year.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will continue to crack down on for-profit schools that take millions in federal financial aid—often as their principal source of revenue—and then exploit students and burden them with debt rather than educating them.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: That is why we will strengthen the gainful employment rule to ensure that for-profit schools enable students to complete their degrees and prepare them for work.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will go after for-profits that engage in deceptive marketing, fraud, and other illegal practices.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will also exercise our responsibility in oversight over the Department of Education to carry out their obligation to close down those for-profit schools that consistently engage in fraudulent and illegal conduct.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: It is unacceptable that for-profit schools with low graduation rates keep encouraging their students to take out federal loans they will have trouble paying back.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Therefore, to the maximum extent possible, we will also encourage widespread relief and the forgiveness of debt to those students harmed by the practices of fraudulent institutions.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe we must have the best-educated population and workforce in the world.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: That means making early childhood education and universal preschool a priority, especially in light of new research showing how much early learning can impact life-long success.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will invest in early childhood programs like Early Head Start and provide every family in America with access to high-quality childcare and high-quality preschool programs.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We support efforts to raise wages for childcare workers,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and to ensure that early childhood educators are experienced and high-quality.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will ensure there are great schools for every child
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: no matter where they live.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats know the federal government must play a critical role in making sure every child has access to a world-class education.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We believe that a strong public education system is an anchor of our democracy,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: a propeller of the economy,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and the vehicle through which we help all children achieve their dreams.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Public education must engage students to be critical thinkers and civic participants
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: while addressing the wellbeing of the whole child.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We also support increased investments in afterschool and summer learning programs,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: which help working families,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: keep kids safe,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and inspire learning at a time when many students are left unsupervised.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We must find ways to encourage mentoring programs that support students in reaching their full potential.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Mentoring is a strategy to ensure that children living in poverty have the encouragement and support to aim high and enter the middle class.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will focus on group mentoring, which is a low-cost, high-yield investment that offers the benefit of building a supportive network of peers who push one another towards success.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe all students should be taught to high academic standards.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Schools should have adequate resources to provide programs and support to help meet the needs of every child.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will hold schools, districts, communities, and states accountable for raising achievement levels for all students—
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: particularly low-income students, students of color, English Language Learners, and students with disabilities.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We must fulfill our national commitment to provide a meaningful education to students with disabilities, and work towards full funding of the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act so that students with disabilities can receive the extra resources and services they need.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: With an appropriate educational foundation, children with disabilities can thrive and become adults with greater opportunities and more meaningful life experiences.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We are also deeply committed to ensuring that we strike a better balance on testing so that it informs, but does not drive, instruction.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: To that end, we encourage states to develop a multiple measures approach to assessment, and we believe that standardized tests must be reliable and valid.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We oppose high-stakes standardized tests that falsely and unfairly label students of color, students with disabilities and English Language Learners as failing;
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: the use of standardized test scores as basis for refusing to fund schools or to close schools;
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and the use of student test scores in teacher and principal evaluations, a practice which has been repeatedly rejected by researchers.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We support enabling parents to opt their children out of standardized tests without penalty for either the student or their school.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats recognize and honor all the professionals who work in public schools to support students' education—teachers, education support professionals, and specialized staff.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We know that good teachers are essential to improving student learning and helping all students to meet high academic standards.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will launch a national campaign to recruit and retain high-quality teachers.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will ensure that teachers receive the tools and ongoing professional development they need to succeed in the classroom and provide our children with a world-class education.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We also must lift up and trust our educators, continually build their capacity, and ensure that our schools are safe, welcoming, collaborative, and well-resourced places for our students, educators, and communities.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will invest in high-quality STEAM classes, community schools, computer science education, arts education, and expand link learning models and career pathways.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will end the school-to-prison pipeline by opposing discipline policies which disproportionately affect African Americans and Latinos, Native Americans and Alaska Natives, students with disabilities, and youth who identify as LGBT.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will support the use of restorative justice practices that help students and staff resolve conflicts peacefully and respectfully while helping to improve the teaching and learning environment.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: And we will work to improve school culture and combat bullying of all kinds.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: The Democratic Party is committed to eliminating opportunity gaps—particularly those that lead to students from low-income communities arriving on day one of kindergarten several years behind their peers.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: This means advocating for labor and public assistance laws that ensure poor parents can spend time with their children.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: This means raising household incomes in poor communities.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: It means ensuring children have health care, stable housing free of contaminants, and a community free of violence in order to minimize the likelihood of cognitive delays.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: It means enriching early childhood programming to prepare children in areas such as literacy, numeracy, civic engagement, and emotional intelligence.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: It means supporting equitable and adequate state funding for public education,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and expanding Title I funding for schools that serve a large number or high concentration of children in poverty.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: It means ending curriculum gaps that maintain and exacerbate achievement gaps.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We support policies that motivate rather than demoralize our educators.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We are committed to ensuring that schools that educate children in poverty are not treated unfairly, which is why we will end the test-and-punish version of accountability that does no more than reveal the many opportunity gaps facing students from low-income communities.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats are committed to providing parents with high-quality public school options and expanding these options for low-income youth.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We support democratically governed, great neighborhood public schools
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and high-quality public charter schools,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and we will help them disseminate best practices to other school leaders and educators.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats oppose for-profit charter schools focused on making a profit off of public resources.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We believe that high-quality public charter schools should provide options for parents,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: but should not replace or destabilize traditional public schools.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Charter schools must reflect their communities, and thus must accept and retain proportionate numbers of students of color, students with disabilities and English Language Learners in relation to their neighborhood public schools.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We support increased transparency and accountability for all charter schools.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats have been fighting to secure universal health care for the American people for generations, and we are proud to be the party that passed Medicare, Medicaid, and the Affordable Care Act (ACA).
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Being stronger together means finally achieving that goal.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We are going to fight to make sure every American has access to quality, affordable health care.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will tackle the problems that remain in our health care system, including cracking down on runaway prescription drug prices and addressing mental health with the same seriousness that we treat physical health.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will fight Republican efforts to roll back the clock on women’s health and reproductive rights, and stand up for Planned Parenthood.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: And we will tackle the epidemics of substance abuse and gun violence, which each claim tens of thousands of lives every year.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats believe that health care is a right, not a privilege, and our health care system should put people before profits.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Thanks to the hard work of President Obama and Democrats in Congress, we took a critically important step toward the goal of universal health care by passing the Affordable Care Act, which has covered 20 million more Americans and ensured millions more will never be denied coverage because of a pre-existing condition.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will never falter in our generations-long fight to guarantee health care as a fundamental right for every American.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: As part of that guarantee, Americans should be able to access public coverage through a public option,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: and those over 55 should be able to opt in to Medicare.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will empower the states, which are the true laboratories of democracy,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: to use innovation waivers under the ACA to develop unique locally tailored approaches to health coverage.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: This will include removing barriers to states which seek to experiment with plans to ensure universal health care to every person in their state.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: By contrast, Donald Trump wants to repeal the ACA, leaving tens of millions of Americans without coverage.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: For too many of us, health care costs are still too high, even for those with insurance.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: And medical debt is a problem for far too many working families, with one-quarter of Americans reporting that they or someone in their household had problems or an inability to pay medical bills in the past year.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: Democrats will also work to end surprise billing and other practices that lead to out-of-control medical debt that place an unconscionable economic strain on American households.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: We will repeal the excise tax on high-cost health insurance and find revenue to offset it because we need to contain the long-term growth of health care costs,
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: but should not risk passing on too much of the burden to workers.
title: 2016 Democratic Party Platform

text: On September 11, 2001, we saw the cruelty of the terrorists, and we glimpsed the future they intend for us.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: They intend to strike the United States to the limits of their power.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: They seek weapons of mass destruction to kill Americans on an even greater scale.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: This danger is increased when outlaw regimes build or acquire weapons of mass destruction and maintain ties to terrorist groups.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: On September 11, 2001, we saw the spirit of courage and optimism of the American people - that greatest assurance of the ultimate triumph of our cause.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Courage and optimism led colleagues to help each other in escaping from collapsing buildings.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Courage and optimism led policemen, firefighters, emergency medical professionals, public works employees, our men and women in uniform, and selfless volunteers to run into burning buildings to save others and undertake a mammoth rescue and recovery effort.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Courage and optimism led the passengers on Flight 93 to rush their murderers to save lives on the ground.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Courage and optimism led America's parents and teachers to battle their own fears to keep children calm and safe.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In those and countless other acts of heroism on that day, and many times since, terrorists have learned that Americans will not be intimidated.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We will fight them with everything we have - and we will prevail.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush answered the challenge of September 11, 2001, not only with steadfast resolve, but also with vision, optimism, and unshakable confidence in the will and faith of the American people.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: That is what we all saw on September 14, 2001, when our President stood with the brave workers at Ground Zero and resolutely assured our nation amidst our shock, anger, and grief that while the terrorists had struck first, America would have the last word.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President's most solemn duty is to protect our country.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: George W. Bush has kept that charge.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: To protect our people, President Bush is leading America, staying on the offensive against threats within our own country.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: He worked with Congress to establish the Department of Homeland Security in the most significant reorganization of the federal government since 1947.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The PATRIOT Act is being used to track terrorist activity and to break up terror cells.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Now, the FBI can use tools that have been long available to fight organized crime and drug trafficking, but could not be used in the past to fight terrorism.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Intelligence and law enforcement officials are sharing information as never before.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President transformed the mission of the FBI to focus first and foremost on preventing terrorism.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Every element of America's homeland security plan is critical, because the terrorists are ruthless and resourceful - and we know they are preparing to attack us again.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: It is not possible to guarantee perfect security in our vast, free nation.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: But the President and Vice President, along with many fine professionals in intelligence, homeland security, law enforcement, and the military are working tirelessly to protect the country.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are grateful to them all.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush recognized that to overcome the dangers of our time, America would have to take a new approach in the world.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: That approach is marked by a determination to challenge new threats, not ignore them, or simply wait for future tragedy - and by a renewed commitment to building a hopeful future in hopeless places, instead of allowing troubled regions to remain in despair and explode in violence.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Before entering office, President Bush recognized that our age is a time of opportunity for America - opportunity to translate this moment of influence into decades of peace, prosperity, and liberty.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: That conviction is in the finest traditions of the Republican Party.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As our platform said in 1984, during the height of Cold War confrontation: "The supreme purpose of our foreign policy must be to maintain our freedom in a peaceful international environment in which the United States and our allies and friends are secure against military threats, and democratic governments are flourishing in a world of increasing prosperity.”
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The reality of 9/11 does not diminish our generation's opportunity to advance the cause of freedom but in fact makes it all the more important that we take up that challenge.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush has rallied America to its calling - to make the world safer and better.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: This calling is answered by a distinctly American internationalism that reflects the union of our values and our national interests.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Americans everywhere are remaining faithful to that duty.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: By keeping our word and holding firm to our values, this generation is showing the world the power of liberty once again.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans support President Bush's steadfast commitment to the goal of a lasting, democratic peace, in which all nations are free from the threat of sudden terror.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We affirm the three commitments of the President's strategy for peace:
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • Terrorists long ago declared war on America, and now America has declared war against terrorists.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are defending the peace by taking the fight to the enemy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are confronting terrorists overseas so we do not have to confront them here at home.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are destroying the leadership of terrorist networks in sudden raids, disrupting their planning and financing, and keeping them on the run.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Month by month, we are shrinking the space in which they can freely operate, by denying them territory and the support of governments.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Nations that support terrorism are just as dangerous, and just as guilty, as the perpetrators of terrorism.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Every nation must make a choice to support terror or to support America and our coalition to defeat terror.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are preserving the peace by working with more than 80 allied nations, as well as international institutions, to isolate and confront terrorists and outlaw regimes.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: America is leading a broad coalition of nations to disrupt proliferation.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are working with the United Nations, the International Atomic Energy Agency, and other international organizations to take action in our common security.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The global threat of terrorism requires a global response.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: To be effective, that global response requires leadership - and America is leading.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •There is no negotiation with terrorists.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: No form of therapy or coercion will turn them from their murderous ways.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Only total and complete destruction of terrorism will allow freedom to flourish.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We will extend the peace by supporting the rise of democracy, and the hope and progress that democracy brings, as the alternative to hatred and terror in the broader Middle East.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In democratic societies, men and women do not swear allegiance to malcontents and murderers; they turn their hearts and labor to building better lives.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Democratic governments do not shelter terrorist camps or attack their neighbors.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: When justice and democracy advance, so does the hope of lasting peace.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are proud of the President's steady leadership in executing this strategy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are dealing with terrorist threats as they gather, rather than waiting for them to become imminent dangers.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The results are clear to see.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Three years ago, our nation was not on a war footing against al Qaeda - even though Osama bin Laden declared war on the United States in 1996 and again in 1998.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The al Qaeda leadership believed itself to be impervious to any American response, continued to raise funds practically without restriction, and operated in a world in which there was no cohesive global approach to fighting terror.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Today, al Qaeda has been wounded, having lost many of its known leaders and most of its important sanctuaries.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: America and its allies and friends have broken al Qaeda cells here in the United States and overseas.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: A global coalition, led by the United States, has dried up sources of terrorist financing.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Thousands of very skilled and determined military personnel remain on the manhunt, going after the remaining killers who hide in cities and caves.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Today, because of the solidarity of the international coalition in the War on Terror, we are bringing these terrorists to justice, and the American people are safer.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Three years ago, al Qaeda's secure home base was in Afghanistan, a country ruled by the Taliban, one of the most backward and brutal regimes of modern history.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Schooling was denied to girls.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Women were whipped and executed in public.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Millions lived in fear.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: With protection from the Taliban, al Qaeda and its associates trained, indoctrinated, and sent forth thousands of killers to set up terror cells in dozens of countries, including our own.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Today, Afghanistan is a world away from the nightmare of the Taliban.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Twentyeight million people are free.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: That country has a good and just president.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Boys and girls are being educated.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Women are respected.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Many refugees have returned home to rebuild their country, and a presidential election is scheduled for this fall.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The terror camps are closed and the Afghan government is helping us to hunt the Taliban and terrorists in remote regions.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Today, because we acted to liberate Afghanistan, a threat has been removed, and the American people are safer.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Three years ago, Pakistan was one of the few countries in the world that recognized the Taliban regime.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Al Qaeda was active and recruiting in Pakistan.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Pakistan served as a transit point for al Qaeda terrorists leaving Afghanistan on missions of murder.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The United States could not count on the support of Pakistan's military and civilian leaders - the very people we would need to help shut down al Qaeda operations in that part of the world.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Today, the governments of the United States and Pakistan are working closely in the fight against terror.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Pakistan has helped capture Khalid Sheik Mohammed, the operational planner behind the September 11 attacks, and other terrorists.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Pakistani forces are rounding up terrorists along their nation's western border.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Today, because we are working with Pakistani leaders, Pakistan is an ally in the War on Terror, and the American people are safer.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Three years ago, terrorists were well-established in Saudi Arabia.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Inside that country, fundraisers and other facilitators gave al Qaeda financial and logistical help with little scrutiny or opposition.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Today, after the attacks in Riyadh and elsewhere, the Saudi government knows that al Qaeda is its enemy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Saudi Arabia is working hard to shut down the facilitators and financial supporters of terrorism.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The government has captured or killed many first-tier leaders of the al Qaeda organization in Saudi Arabia.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Today, because Saudi Arabia has seen the danger and has joined the War on Terror, the American people are safer.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Three years ago, the ruler of Iraq was a sworn enemy of America who provided safe haven for terrorists, used weapons of mass destruction, and turned his nation into a prison.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Saddam Hussein was not just a dictator; he was a proven mass murderer who refused to account for weapons of mass murder.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: He defied the international community and seventeen United Nations resolutions over the course of twelve years, giving no indication that Iraq would ever disarm and comply with the just demands of the world.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In 2002 - in Resolution 1441 - the United Nations Security Council unanimously voted that Saddam Hussein had one final chance to comply with his obligations to the international community, or there would be serious consequences.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As he had for over a decade, he refused to comply.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Every responsible nation recognized this threat, and knew it could not go on forever.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Today, the dictator who caused decades of death and turmoil, who twice invaded his neighbors, who harbored terrorist leaders, who used chemical weapons on innocent men, women, and children, finally stands before the bar of justice.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Iraq, which once had the worst government in the Middle East, is now becoming an example of reform to the region.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Iraqi security forces are fighting beside coalition troops to defeat the terrorists and foreign fighters who threaten their nation and the world.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Today, because America and our coalition helped to end the violent regime of Saddam Hussein, and because we are helping to raise a peaceful democracy in its place, 25 million Iraqis are free and the American people are safer.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Three years ago, the nation of Libya, a longtime supporter of terror, was spending millions to acquire chemical and nuclear weapons.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Today, thousands of Libya's chemical munitions have been destroyed.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Libya's nuclear equipment that could ultimately have threatened the lives of hundreds of thousands is stored away in the United States.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Today, because the Libyan government saw the seriousness of the civilized world, and correctly judged its own interests, the American people are safer.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Three years ago, a private weapons proliferation network was doing business around the world.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: This network, operated by the Pakistani nuclear scientist A.Q. Khan, was selling nuclear plans and equipment to the highest bidder, and found willing buyers in places like Libya, Iran, and North Korea.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Today, the A.Q. Khan network is out of business.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We have ended one of the most dangerous sources of proliferation in the world, and the American people are safer.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans applaud President Bush, Vice President Cheney, and those who have supported them in the Congress for the steady leadership that led to these successes.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: America must stay the course.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In Afghanistan and Iraq, our enemies have seen the results of what civilized nations can, and will, do against regimes that harbor, support, and use terrorism to achieve their political goals.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans believe that America and the world must keep our commitments to the people of those countries, who are building the world's newest democracies and counting on the world to help.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Delivering these nations from tyranny has required sacrifice and loss.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We must honor that sacrifice by finishing the great work we have begun.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans appreciate the military, financial, and technical assistance provided by the dozens of nations contributing to the reconstruction of Afghanistan and Iraq.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The success of free and stable governments in Afghanistan, Iraq, and elsewhere will further shrink the space in which terrorists can operate.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As the entire region sees the promise of freedom in its midst, the terrorist ideology will become more and more irrelevant, until that day when it is viewed with contempt or ignored altogether.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The forces of many nations are working with Afghans to find and defeat Taliban remnants and eliminate al Qaeda terrorists.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We applaud the work of American forces and coalition partners in helping to build the new Afghan national army and to train new Afghan police and border patrol.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Together, Afghan and international forces will maintain the peace, secure Afghanistan's borders, and deny terrorists any foothold in that country.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We applaud President Bush's announcement of U.S. support for five new initiatives that will help the Afghan people achieve the peace, stability, and prosperity they deserve - through support for the development of democracy, educational assistance, cultural exchanges, enhanced bilateral economic ties, and increased economic opportunity for women.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The road ahead for Afghanistan is still long and difficult.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Yet the Afghan people can know that their country will never be abandoned to terrorists and killers.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The world and the United States look forward to elections this year in Afghanistan and stand with the Afghan people as partners in their quest for peace and prosperity, stability, and democracy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As Republicans, we do not equivocate, as others have done, about whether America should have gone to war in Iraq.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The best intelligence available at the time indicated that Saddam Hussein was a threat.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: On that point, President Bush, members of both parties in Congress, and the United Nations agreed.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: While the stockpiles of weapons of mass destruction we expected to find in Iraq have not yet materialized, we have confirmed that Saddam Hussein had the capability to reconstitute his weapons programs and the desire to do so.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Our nation did the right thing, and the American people are now safer because we and our allies ended the brutal dictatorship of Saddam Hussein, halting his decades-long pursuit of chemical, biological, and nuclear weapons.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush had a choice to make: Trust a madman or defend America.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: He chose defending America.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Supported by brave coalition allies such as the United Kingdom, Australia, Italy, Poland, and Denmark,
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: and displaying courage, skill, and resourcefulness on the battlefield, the men and women of our Armed Forces removed the dictator of Iraq, a declared enemy of America who had the capability and intent to produce weapons of mass murder, and could have passed that capability to terrorists bent on killing Americans.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: That was a risk we could not take.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: America's men and women in uniform have been unrelenting in the performance of their duty.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Our nation has asked much of our military, and there is still much hard work ahead.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are proud of the sacrifice made by all who have served and are serving, and we are immensely grateful for the sacrifices made by their families and loved ones.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Further, we honor the memories of those who have died in combat serving the cause of freedom.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Defending our homeland with their ultimate sacrifice on behalf of all Americans merits our prayers and our thanksgiving.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also commit to continued honor and care for our wounded veterans, and support for all who return home from service.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Together, we look forward to that day when the War on Terror is won and our military can return home, no longer at risk, our world and our country safer.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also salute our coalition allies.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Their efforts with us to shape a world where freedom is honored and liberty is cherished deserves respect and admiration; their sacrifice, too, does not go without notice and appreciation.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are ever mindful that American troops remain on the ground in Iraq, working steadfastly to help the Iraqi people achieve stability and democracy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We therefore welcome declarations from responsible political leaders of both parties that our nation will persevere in our mission there, not cut and run.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The American people need to hear this message.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: People in Baghdad and beyond need to hear it.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The enemy needs to hear it.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Most importantly, American soldiers, sailors, airmen, and Marines risking their lives in Iraq need to hear it.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We condemn inconsistent, ambiguous, and politically expedient statements on that point.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: To the extent such wavering encourages our adversaries to fight harder, our men and women in uniform suffer the consequences.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Their mission is difficult enough.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Uncertainty about America's commitment to that mission makes it immeasurably more difficult.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In Iraq, America is serving the cause of liberty, peace, and our own security.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: America accepted a difficult task in Iraq.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We know that for all these reasons, we will finish that task.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also know that Iraqi sovereignty is a tribute to the will of the Iraqi people and the courage of Iraqi leaders.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: It is a proud moral achievement for members of our coalition.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We have full confidence in the plan for Iraqi self-government that is currently being implemented by Iraq's interim government.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: That government has gained broad international support, and has been endorsed by the United Nations Security Council.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The United States and our coalition partners are helping prepare Iraqis for the defense of their own country, including through the work of the NATO mission to train Iraqi security forces.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are helping Iraqis rebuild their country's infrastructure, and Iraq is continuing to move toward free elections, with important assistance from the United Nations.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We applaud President Bush for establishing a visionary and resolute policy - a Forward Strategy of Freedom in the Middle East - to stand with the people of that region as they seek their future in freedom.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans support President Bush's policy of working with every government in the Middle East dedicated to destroying the terrorist networks, while in the longer term expecting a higher standard of reform and democracy from our friends in the region.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We believe that democracy and reform will make those nations stronger and more stable, and make the world more secure by undermining terrorism at its source.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As a result of President Bush's leadership, G-8 members adopted the Broader Middle East and North Africa Initiative at this year's Sea Island Summit.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We applaud the commitment of the world's leading industrial nations to this historic initiative to support political, economic, and social reform throughout the region.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans agree with the Bush Administration that there is no greater danger to our people than the nexus of terrorists and weapons of mass destruction (WMD).
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: That judgment is shared by leading allies and friends.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As President Bush and his fellow G-8 leaders declared in 2003, the spread of weapons of mass destruction and international terrorism constitute "the pre-eminent threat to international security.”
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The risks posed by this dangerous relationship cannot be contained or deterred by traditional means.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •ensure that international agreements against the proliferation of WMD are observed and enforced;
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • detect, disrupt, and block the spread of dangerous weapons and technology;
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans applaud the strong support President Bush has demonstrated for the people of Haiti and agree that it is essential that Haiti have a hopeful future.

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America
