title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans believe that because Africans and Americans share a belief in the values of liberty and dignity, we must share in the labor of advancing those values.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We endorse President Bush's conviction that in a time of growing commerce across the globe, America must work to ensure that the nations of Africa are full partners in the trade and prosperity of the world.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Under the leadership of President Bush and the Republican Congress, our nation is standing together with leaders in Africa against the tragic violence of civil war and against the merciless terrorists who threaten every nation.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are answering the challenge of desperate hunger with human compassion and the tools of human technology.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In the face of spreading disease, we are joining with courageous people throughout the continent who are turning the tide against HIV/AIDS in Africa.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We applaud the President's leadership in establishing an unprecedented level of engagement with Africa, exemplified by the high priority placed on dialogue between the President and his African counterparts and supported by historic initiatives such as the Millennium Challenge Account (MCA), the President's Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief, and the African Education Initiative.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We further commend President Bush for visiting South Africa, Nigeria, Senegal, Botswana, and Uganda last year - the first Republican President to do so.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans believe that South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, and Ethiopia are leaders for regional engagement and require focused attention.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We applaud the President and the Republican Congress for deepening American engagement with those nations.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans also applaud increased support for African nations that have chosen the path of economic, political, and social reform and are therefore eligible for funding from the MCA: Senegal, Ghana, Benin, Cape Verde, Mali, Mozambique, Madagascar, and Lesotho.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We believe that to be effective, development aid requires pro-growth policies and strong reforms in the nations that receive aid.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We endorse the MCA's direction of resources to countries with governments that rule justly, root out corruption, encourage entrepreneurship, and invest in the health and education of their people.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans also applaud the strong record of President Bush and the Republican Congress in promoting development and economic growth in Africa as a means to eradicating poverty and encouraging the habits of freedom and enterprise.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans believe that the United States must continue to work to complete a free trade agreement with the nations of the Southern African Customs Union to create new opportunities for farmers and workers and entrepreneurs all across Africa.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also applaud the efforts of the Bush Administration to strengthen and broaden capital markets on the continent.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: With the ability to borrow money to buy homes and to start businesses, more Africans will have the tools to achieve their dreams.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans also commend President Bush and the Republican Congress for helping to provide Africa's children with the advantages of literacy and basic education through the Africa Education Initiative.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: This important initiative will provide teacher training, textbooks, and scholarships for girls to improve primary education on the continent.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Many of Africa's leaders are committed to the spread of democratic institutions and democratic values throughout their continent.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Yet those institutions and values are threatened in some parts of Africa by terrorism, chaos, and civil war.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: To extend liberty in Africa, we must help African leaders who seek to achieve security and peace on the continent.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans believe that together with our allies and friends, America must help strengthen Africa's fragile states, help build indigenous capability to secure porous borders, and help build up the law enforcement and intelligence infrastructures to deny havens for terrorists.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: An ever more lethal environment exists in Africa as local civil wars spread beyond borders to create regional war zones.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Forming coalitions and cooperative security arrangements is key to confronting these emerging transnational threats.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans applaud President Bush's strong record of promoting regional peace and stability and helping to end conflict and war on the continent.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Sudan's civil war is one of the worst humanitarian tragedies of our time, responsible for the deaths of two million people over two decades.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Achieving peace, and concluding a just and comprehensive agreement, must be an urgent priority for both sides in Sudan.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President's commitment has paved the way for significant progress and we welcome continued movement this year toward a comprehensive peace agreement that will put an end to 20 years of conflict in southern Sudan.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: American assistance has been provided for famine relief, assistance for refugees, and other humanitarian aid.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Yet no amount of aid can substitute for true and lasting peace.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We continue to hope for peace for the people of Sudan and for normalization of relations between Sudan and the United States.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: However, the Government of Sudan must not remain complicit in the brutalization of Darfur.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: By undertaking a comprehensive approach to the pandemic that involves education, abstinence, prevention, testing, treatment, and care - including advanced antiretroviral drugs - the President's groundbreaking initiative follows in the finest American tradition of harnessing the power of human technology in the service of human compassion.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We applaud the numerous African, American, and other international private organizations - including faith-based groups, hospitals, medical schools, corporations, and philanthropies - that are helping the people of Africa as they fight HIV/AIDS with courage.

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America
