text: The President and Congress have taken action to provide counseling and education to help first-time homebuyers navigate the process of buying a home.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The Administration has also taken steps to alert people to the dangers of predatory lending, in an effort to help Americans maintain a positive credit history.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Affordable housing is in the national interest.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: That is why the mortgage interest deduction for primary residences was put into the federal tax code and why tax reform of any kind should continue to encourage homeownership.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support efforts to enact the Single-Family Affordable Housing Tax Credit.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: At the same time, a balanced national housing policy must recognize that decent housing includes apartments, and addresses the needs of all citizens, including renters.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In many areas, housing prices are higher than they need to be because of regulations that drive up building costs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Some regulation is of course necessary, and so is sensible zoning.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We urge states and localities to work with local builders and lenders to eliminate unnecessary burdens that price many families out of the market.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We see no role for any federal regulation of homebuilding.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We do foresee a larger role for state and local governments in controlling the federally assisted housing that has been so poorly managed from Washington.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also encourage the modification of restrictions that inhibit the rehabilitation of existing distressed properties.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Small businesses are the most potent force of economic growth and job creation in America.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: They generate more than half of our nation's gross domestic product and create seven out of ten new private-sector jobs in America.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Small businesses have been the primary vehicles of economic advance for American women.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans pledged in 2000 to lower tax rates for small business owners and entrepreneurs, end the death tax, cut red tape, reform our liability system, and aggressively expand overseas markets for our goods and services.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Though more work remains to be done, including reauthorizing the Small Business Administration, President Bush and Congressional Republicans have made good on each of those commitments.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Reduced taxes on 25 million small business owners and entrepreneurs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Much of the tax relief came from reductions in individual income tax rates.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Ninety percent of businesses pay income taxes at individual rates, not corporate rates.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: This includes hundreds of thousands of successful small business owners and entrepreneurs who pay taxes in the top tax rates and whose taxes would increase considerably under John Kerry's economic plan.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • Lowered the tax burden on investment in new equipment by quadrupling the limit on small business expensing from $25,000 to $100,000 and allowing additional first-year depreciation of that equipment.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Phased-out the death tax that punishes family-owned small businesses and family farms.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Increased federal contracts to small businesses.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In 2003, small businesses received the largest percentage ever of all federal contracts.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In addition, President Bush developed a strategy to reverse the trend toward bundling of contracts, a practice that has denied small businesses the ability to compete for billions of procurement dollars.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Reduced paperwork.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: For example, 22. 4 million small business taxpayers now have fewer lines to fill out on tax forms, freeing up an estimated 9. 5 million hours previously used for paperwork every year.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • Enacted Health Savings Accounts, which allow individuals to save and pay for their health care tax-free.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Combined with a catastrophic health plan, they are an easier and less costly way for small businesses to provide health insurance for their employees.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • Enacted common sense liability protections in the Terrorism Risk Insurance and SAFETY Acts.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Negotiated agreements to reduce trade barriers and expand access to foreign markets.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: An area in special need of more work is liability reform.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Frivolous lawsuits put more money in the pockets of trial lawyers and leave businesses with less money to create jobs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: They raise health care costs on small businesses, often preventing them from offering health insurance to their employees.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support efforts by President Bush, Congressional Republicans, and Republican governors to curb the burden of frivolous lawsuits.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We recognize that the Democrats' nominees, one of whom made his fortune as a trial lawyer, are beholden to the interests of the trial lawyer lobby and offer no hope for reform of this badly broken system.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Health Savings Accounts allow people to own and control their health care.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: They are an important step toward creating a system of consumer-driven health care that puts patients and doctors at the center of decision-making - not government bureaucrats.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: When consumers make decisions about health care, individuals control their health care dollars and health care decisions.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Health Savings Accounts allow people to save, earn interest, and spend tax free on their health care needs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: HSAs are combined with a lowpremium, high-deductible health insurance plan to offer flexible, affordable insurance options for small businesses and individuals.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Health Savings Accounts are now available to all Americans thanks to the efforts of President Bush and the Republican Congress.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The next step, which our Party endorses, is to extend tax deductibility to the insurance premiums associated with HSAs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also support efforts to expand the use of Health Savings Accounts to help control health care costs and give individuals more power in making important medical decisions.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The core of ownership in America has always been ownership of private property that a citizen can call his or her own.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans respect this tradition.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: For reasons both Constitutional and environmental, therefore, President Bush and the Republican Congress will safeguard private property rights by enforcing the Takings Clause of the Fifth Amendment and by providing just compensation whenever private property is needed to achieve a compelling public purpose.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We oppose efforts to diminish the rights of private citizens to the land they own.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: America's economy is the strongest in the world, and it is getting stronger thanks to lower taxes, fewer burdensome regulations, and a focus on encouraging investment.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Our goal is to make sure America remains the strongest economy in a dynamic world and to make it possible for every American who wants a job to find one.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We must ensure that workers are equipped with the education and training to succeed in the best jobs of the 21st century, and we must encourage the strong spirit of innovation that has put America at the forefront of new technology industries.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Future prosperity demands that we have affordable, cleaner, more independent energy supplies and affordable, high-quality health care.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We must maintain our commitment to free and fair trade, lower taxes, limited regulation, and a limited, efficient government that keeps up with the new realities of a changing world.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: By keeping the costs of running a business low and ensuring that our workers have the skills to compete in a dynamic global economy, President Bush and the Republican Congress will continue to ensure that America is the best nation in the world in which to create jobs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In 2001, President Bush and the Republican Congress worked together to pass the most sweeping tax relief in a generation.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: By letting families, workers, and small business owners keep more of the money they earn, they helped bring America from recession to a steadily expanding economy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Despite enduring the after-effects of the stock market's irrational exuberance in the late 1990s, terrorist attacks on our nation, and corporate scandals that bubbled to the surface after years of inattention, the U.S. economy has now grown for 33 straight months.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: And unlike four years ago, there are no signs of an end to the current economic growth.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The proof is in the numbers, and the numbers prove our economy is strong and growing stronger.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Over the past year, gross domestic product (GDP) grew at one of the fastest rates in two decades.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Without the President's tax relief, real GDP would have been more than 3 percent lower and 2 million fewer Americans would have been working at the end of last year.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • Since last August, 1. 5 million new jobs have been created.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •The unemployment rate has fallen from 6. 3 to 5. 5 percent, which is below the average of the 1970s, 1980s, and 1990s.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • Employment over the last year is up in 46 of the 50 states, and the unemployment rate is down in 49 of the 50 states.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In addition to the official figures, household surveys show that hundreds of thousands of new jobs have been created, unreported, through selfemployment and by small businesses.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • Real after-tax incomes are up by 9. 6 percent since December 2000.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Homeownership rates are at record levels - seven out of ten American families own their own home today.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • Consumer confidence is up from the levels seen at this time last year.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • Inflation remains low by historical standards, as do mortgage rates.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We know what brought us this success - the hard work of the American people and the Republican commitment to low taxes.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Now we must keep our economy on the right path by preventing taxes on families from going up next year, making the tax relief of the last four years permanent, and reforming the tax code to make it simpler, fairer, and more growth-oriented.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In 2000 we rightly declared: "The federal tax code is dysfunctional.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: It penalizes hard work, marriage, thrift, and success - the very factors that are the foundations for lasting prosperity.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: " As noted earlier, from reducing marginal income tax rates to phasing out the death tax, President Bush and the Republican Congress have made great strides in addressing each of these problems.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: However, it is equally obvious that much more remains to be done to reform the federal tax code.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Instead of being simple, the current tax system is needlessly complex, making it susceptible to abusive tax avoidance schemes.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Instead of being efficient, it punishes hard work, discourages savings and investment, and hinders the international competitiveness of U.S. firms.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Instead of being fair, it is out of line with our basic values and undermines our sense of fairness.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Instead of being predictable, it is highly unpredictable and uncertain.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Tax reform is necessary to achieve the simplicity, efficiency, fairness, and predictability that the American people deserve, and to give all Americans the freedom to determine their own spending priorities.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Make the tax relief of 2001 and 2003 permanent.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The various expiring tax relief provisions, ranging from 2005 to 2011, make the tax code confusing for everybody and limits the ability of workers, families, and businesses to plan for the future with confidence.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Nowhere is this more apparent than with the death tax, which is reduced now, disappears in 2010, and then comes fully back to life in 2011.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • Build on efforts to develop a tax code that does not punish taxpayers for saving.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • Replace the tax code with a system that is simpler, provides more freedom to our citizens, is pro-growth, boosts the economy, and encourages savings and investment.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: A code that provides several definitions of a child is a code that needs to be reformed.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support legislation requiring a super-majority vote in both houses of Congress to raise taxes.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We oppose all attempts by the United Nations to impose a global tax and reject any claims of authority by United Nations to do so.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Because of the vital role of religious and fraternal benevolent societies in fostering charity and patriotism, they should not be subject to taxation.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The alternative minimum tax (AMT) represents a second tax system for individuals.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Its stated goal is to insure that high-income taxpayers pay some amount of income tax.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: But due to the lack of indexing, the broad base and reach of the current AMT will make it apply increasingly to middle-income taxpayers.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Millions of additional taxpayers must complete AMT forms just to determine that they are not subject to the tax.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As we look at the broader issue of tax reform, we call upon Congress to address this increasingly unfair second tax system on hardworking Americans.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: To make sure the private sector has the capital it needs to invest, grow the economy, and expand prosperity, our leaders must make sure that the growth of the federal government remains in check.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The challenges America has faced over the last four years have created an unwelcome but manageable budget deficit.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: These deficits are due to a number of factors: the stock market downturn that began in 2000 and the subsequent recession that President Bush inherited when he took office; the terrorist attacks on America and the necessary spending for homeland security and the War on Terror those attacks precipitated; and the crisis in confidence produced by corporate scandals that were years in the making.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: It is important to view the size of the deficit in relation to the size of the nation's economy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: By that measure, today's deficit, although unwelcome, is well within historical ranges.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: A deficit that is 3. 8 percent of GDP, as is now projected for this year, would be smaller than the deficits in nine of the last 25 years, and far below the peak deficit figure of 6 percent of GDP reached in 1983.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: This deficit is also in line with what other industrialized nations are facing today.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The U. S. deficit matches the average deficit within the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development, and is below the levels of France, Germany, and Japan.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Much more importantly, because the President and Congress enacted pro-growth economic policies, the deficit is headed strongly in the right direction.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Next year's projected deficit, at 2. 7 percent of GDP, would be smaller than those in 14 of the last 25 years.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As Republicans in Congress work with the President to restrain spending and strengthen economic growth, the federal deficit will fall to 1. 5 percent of the nation's economic output in 2009 - well below the 2. 2 percent average of the last 40 years.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The events that brought us into deficit are not completely behind us.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The War on Terror goes on.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The recession has passed, but some industries and workers are still feeling its effects.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans are committed to winning the War on Terror and will continue to implement policies that promote jobs, investment, and growth in every region of the country and every sector of our economy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Let us be clear: If government is to meet the most pressing needs of our time and still maintain fiscal discipline, government leaders must set priorities and stick with them.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush has shown genuine leadership in doing just that.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Time and again, he has made difficult decisions and followed through with clear determination.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: He has made it plain that his top budgetary priority is to protect America and win the War on Terror.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: He also remains committed to the education reforms he spearheaded in 2001.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: All discretionary spending must be kept in check and taxes must remain low to stimulate economic growth.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We endorse the President's pro-growth economic policies and his disciplined approach to spending taxpayers' dollars.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: And we applaud the efforts of President Bush and Republicans in Congress to meet our nation's priorities and cut the deficit by more than half within five years.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Tax cuts and spending are not the same.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: They do not have the same effect on the economy or on the federal budget.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Tax cuts allow American workers, families, business owners, and investors to keep more of their own money.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: New spending requires the government to take control of a bigger slice of the economy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We recognize that the problem is not that the American people are taxed too little but that the federal government spends too much.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: To ensure that the federal government respects the burdens on taxpayers and spends only as much as is necessary to accomplish our common goals, we support extending the pay-as-you-go requirement for mandatory spending only.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Spending limits will help Congress restrain the growth of government.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support a cap on discretionary spending that will limit the growth of overall spending while ensuring that priorities such as our nation's security will continue to be met.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We applaud President Bush for submitting a budget for 2005 that provides significant increases in funding to win the War on Terror and protect the homeland, while limiting the growth in all other non-security related discretionary spending to less than one percent.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: To further the goal of respecting taxpayers' dollars and restraining spending, we endorse the creation of a line-item veto, which the President could use consistent with the Constitution to reject new appropriations, new mandatory spending, or limited grants of tax benefits (to 100 or fewer beneficiaries) whenever he determines the spending or tax benefits are not essential priorities.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Under this approach, all savings from the line-item veto would be used for deficit reduction, and could not be applied to other spending.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Governors across the nation already have and use this tool to reduce unnecessary spending.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President should have the same option.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: It is often said that a government program is the closest man has come to achieving immortality.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Government programs are designed with specific purposes, and they ought to be assessed to determine whether they are meeting their goals.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We endorse creating a commission to evaluate discretionary spending on federal agencies and programs to ensure that taxpayer funds are being used for the best, most efficient purposes.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Such a commission would determine whether certain programs are duplicative, wasteful or inefficient, outdated or irrelevant, or failed.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: It would recommend to Congress programs that could be terminated, moved, or restructured to make the government more efficient.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: New government programs are frequently created with little review of programs that already exist to address the same perceived problem.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Over time, numerous programs with overlapping missions and competing agendas grow up alongside one another - wasting money and baffling citizens.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support President Bush's vision for government reform, which is guided by three principles.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Government should be: citizen-centered, not bureaucracy-centered; results-oriented; and market-based, actively promoting rather than stifling innovation through competition.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President's management agenda is an effective tool for making sure government is active but limited, focusing on results and obtaining them efficiently.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The Republican Party respects and appreciates the private sector as the primary creator of jobs, economic growth, opportunity, and prosperity in our society.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The private sector functions most effectively when laws are transparent and people respect them - this includes people in positions of power.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: When corporate leaders break the law, they should be punished.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: After fraudulent corporate practices rooted in the irrational exuberance of the late 1990s began to surface in the closing months of 2001, President Bush worked with the Congress to take decisive action to restore honesty and integrity to America's corporate boardrooms.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In July 2002, President Bush signed the Sarbanes-Oxley Act, the most farreaching reform of American business practices since the 1940s.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Under this new law, CEOs and Chief Financial Officers are required to personally vouch for the truth and fairness of their companies' disclosures; for the first time, an independent board has been established to oversee the accounting profession; investigators have been given new tools to root out corporate fraud; and enhanced penalties are ensuring that dishonest corporate officials do hard time.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We applaud President Bush for vigorously enforcing the law to deter and punish further corporate abuses.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: He established an interagency Corporate Fraud Task Force to investigate and prosecute financial crimes; to recover the proceeds of those crimes; and to hold corporate criminals to account.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Since the Task Force was established two years ago, over 700 violators have been charged and over 300 convictions or guilty pleas secured, including more than 25 former CEOs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: More than $1 billion in forfeited funds has also been recovered from corporate wrongdoers for return to defrauded creditors and investors.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Separately, the enforcement budget of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has more than doubled, and the SEC has issued new rules to ban latetrading and other fraudulent practices engaged in by certain mutual funds.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Thanks to swift and decisive action by President Bush and the Congress, Americans can trust that corporate executives who operate outside the law will be prosecuted.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: International trade has become the world's most powerful economic force, and Americans are seeing great benefits from free and fair trade.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Exports accounted for about 25 percent of the economic growth in the 1990s and supported about 12 million jobs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: An additional 6 million jobs are made possible by companies based in foreign countries investing here in the United States.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Consumers have benefited - recent trade agreements save the average family of four $2000 per year by lowering regulatory barriers, eliminating tariffs, and providing more consumer choices.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Free trade must be fair trade that advances America's economic goals and protects American jobs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: To achieve this goal, we must act globally, regionally, and bilaterally to negotiate new trade agreements and enforce existing trade commitments.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We must be at the table when trade agreements are negotiated, make the interests of American workers and farmers paramount, and ensure that the drive to open new markets is successful.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We reject moves toward economic isolationism.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: America is the best place in the world to do business, and our workers and products are the best in the world.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: On a level playing field we can outmatch any other nation.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We applaud the President's actions to open foreign markets to American manufacturing products, agricultural goods, services, and intellectual property, while ensuring enforcement of trade agreements so that other nations live up to their promises.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In 2000 we resolved to renew Trade Promotion Authority so the President could more easily negotiate trade agreements.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In 2002 President Bush and Republicans in Congress did exactly that.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: After lapsing for eight years, the law now allows President Bush to work with other countries to reduce barriers to our products and services.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • The Bush Administration has negotiated trade agreements with 12 countries.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • They have made progress on agreements with another 10 countries.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •These free trade partners represent $2. 5 trillion in purchasing power - the equivalent of America's third-largest export market.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •The agreements include high levels of protection and strong enforcement measures for intellectual property.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •The Administration has also made significant progress in negotiating multi-lateral trade agreements, having just last month revived World Trade Organization (WTO) negotiations for the final phase of the Doha round.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • The revival of these negotiations opens the door to lower tariffs on consumer and industrial goods, reductions in tariffs and trade-distorting export subsidies on agricultural products, and market access and lower regulatory barriers for services.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The vitality of the U.S. trade agenda depends upon the vigorous enforcement of U.S. trade laws against unfair competition.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We will not tolerate foreign practices, rules, and subsidization that put our exports and manufacturers on an unequal footing.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: It is not enough to secure signatures on a piece of paper; our trading partners must follow through on the promises they make.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As part of its trade enforcement efforts, the Bush Administration has imposed more anti-dumping orders on average each year than the previous Administration.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The United States was the first country in the world to impose a safeguard action against Chinese textile and apparel imports and to file a case against China in the WTO.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: China settled that case, agreeing to repeal its subsidy of semiconductors that was penalizing U.S. manufacturers.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Also this year, through bilateral consultations with China, the United States resolved seven other potential trade disputes over high technology products, agriculture, and intellectual property protection.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We strongly endorse the Bush Administration's unprecedented effort to persuade and encourage China to desist in its policy of manipulating its currency to give Chinese manufacturers an artificial advantage in global markets.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: America's litigation system is broken.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Junk and frivolous lawsuits are driving up the cost of doing business in America by forcing companies to pay excessive legal expenses to fight off or settle often baseless lawsuits.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Those costs are being paid by small business owners, manufacturers, their employees, and consumers.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: A typical small business with $10 million in annual revenue pays about $150,000 a year in tort liability costs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: That is money that could be used to invest and hire new employees.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Inefficiency and waste in the legal system is costing the average American family of four $1,800 every year, equivalent to an extra 3 percent tax on wages.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: And the bulk of jury awards to plaintiffs don't even go to the people who deserve it.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Injured persons on average collect less than 50 cents of every dollar that the legal system costs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Trial lawyers get rich from the misfortune of others.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: If small business is America's economic engine, trial lawyers are the brakes: They cost hundreds of thousands of good jobs, drive honest employers out of business, deprive women of critical medical care - then skip out with fat wallets and nary a thought for the economic havoc and human misery they leave in their wake.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We praise President Bush and Republicans in Congress for their efforts to reform the legal system by passing meaningful class action reform, asbestos reform, and medical liability reform.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: And we call to account Senate Democrats and the powerful trial lawyer lobby, who have shown no shame in utilizing obstructionist tactics to thwart the efforts of majorities in Congress to provide meaningful relief to all Americans.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The Republican Party reaffirms its support for meaningful reform of the legal system, and will continue its fight to guarantee the rights of all plaintiffs to swift and speedy justice.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: A safe and efficient transportation system is essential to keeping people and goods moving and cities and communities prosperous.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Congestion and delay not only waste our time as individuals, they also burden businesses and our entire economy with inefficiency and higher costs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans strongly support a comprehensive transportation policy agenda that enhances safety, reduces congestion, modernizes infrastructure, and promotes economic growth.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Our national railroad network is a crucial component of our public transportation system.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Railroads helped build our country, and our national passenger railroad network plays a key role in transportation and economic growth.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans support, where economically viable, the development of a high-speed passenger railroad system as an instrument of economic development and enhanced mobility.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans support a healthy intercity passenger rail system.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Amtrak provides a valuable service to passengers, especially in the Northeast corridor.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: But we recognize that the goal of establishing a national passenger rail system with modest federal support has failed to materialize.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Clearly the financial problems plaguing Amtrak cannot be solved simply by continued infusions of taxpayer dollars.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Fundamental reforms should be enacted to transition Amtrak into operational self-sufficiency.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: A stable, affordable, more independent energy supply is vital to fueling America's economic growth, increasing prosperity, helping families afford prices at the pump, and making America more secure.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush and Republicans in Congress recognize the need for a balanced energy policy that increases both energy production and conservation.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We need a comprehensive energy policy so that we will no longer lurch from one energy crisis to the next.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Recent electricity blackouts, the California energy crisis, natural gas and oil price spikes, and high gasoline prices remind us that only a comprehensive energy policy will produce energy stability for America's families and businesses.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As one of his first acts in office, President Bush released the National Energy Policy (NEP) report, a comprehensive plan to reduce America's dependence on foreign sources of energy by increasing domestic energy production and supporting conservation and alternative and renewable energy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President's proposal would make America more energy independent while creating jobs and promoting economic growth.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: It includes over 100 recommendations, nearly half of which addressed renewable energy, energy efficiency, and conservation.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush has implemented nearly every nonlegislative recommendation outlined in the NEP report.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans in the House and Senate have stood solidly with the President.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We endorse the President's policy, appreciate the hard work of Congressional Republicans in the face of intractable partisan opposition, and urge final passage of a bill to secure America's energy future.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Republicans support developing new technologies for more efficient generation and use of power.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: New technologies will allow us to create new job-producing industries and save jobs in industries that have long been staples of America's economy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: For instance, working with Congressional Republicans, the President has already committed $2 billion over 10 years for clean coal research and development - which helps keep America's coal industry strong and reduces the emissions associated with coal use.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As part of that commitment, we support FutureGen, an international, public-private initiative to build the world's first integrated sequestration and hydrogen research power plant that would burn coal more cleanly.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush's Clear Skies Initiative would create a $50 billion private market to deploy these clean coal technologies.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •The Republican Party supports research and investment designed to realize the enormous benefits of a hydrogen economy and put the United States on the cutting edge of energy technology.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The FreedomCar Partnership and Hydrogen Fuel Initiative include $1. 7 billion over five years to begin building hydrogen cars and the infrastructure to support them.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Using the most sophisticated technologies, we can explore and develop oil resources here at home with minimal environmental impact.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Our Party continues to support energy development in the coastal plain of the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge (ANWR), which, according to the U.S. Geological Survey, holds as much as 16 billion barrels of oil - enough to replace oil imports from Saudi Arabia for nearly 20 years.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The drilling footprint can be confined to just 2,000 acres (the entire refuge contains 19 million acres), about the size of Washington's Dulles Airport, on ice roads that melt away in the summer, leaving little trace of human intervention.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We have already wasted precious time.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: If the previous Administration had not vetoed the ANWR proposal passed by the Republican Congress in 1995, at this moment ANWR would be producing up to one million barrels of oil a day.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • Republicans strongly support removing unnecessary barriers to domestic natural gas production and expanding environmentally sound production in new areas, such as Alaska and the Rocky Mountains.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Increasing supply, including the construction of a new natural gas pipeline from Alaska to the lower 48, will bring needed relief to consumers and make America's businesses more competitive in the global marketplace.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Last summer, the largest blackout in North American history affected 8 states, leaving more than 50 million Americans without power.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans support measures to modernize the nation's electricity grid to prevent future blackouts and provide American consumers and businesses with more affordable, reliable power.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We will work to unleash innovation so entrepreneurs can develop technologies for a more advanced and robust transmission system that meets our growing energy demands.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also support the establishment of mandatory, enforceable reliability rules for electric utilities to reduce the likelihood of future blackouts.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Republicans will continue to support renewable energy through extension of the production tax credit for wind and biomass, as well as efforts to expand the use of biodiesel and ethanol, which can reduce America's dependence on foreign oil while increasing revenues to farmers.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Nuclear power provides America with affordable, emissions-free energy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We believe nuclear power can help reduce our dependence on foreign energy and play an invaluable role in addressing global climate change.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush supports construction of new nuclear power plants through the Nuclear Power 2010 initiative, and continues to move forward on creating an environmentally sound nuclear waste repository.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Public education, access for every child to an excellent education, is a foundation of a free, civil society.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The children who enter schools today will leave as young adults, full of dreams for the future.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: They will soon become the scientists and researchers who make great discoveries, the engineers and mathematicians who build our communities, the doctors and nurses who heal and comfort the sick, the teachers who will educate the next generation, the leaders who transform government, the poets, artists, and writers who entertain and inspire.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Every child deserves a first-rate education, because every child holds infinite potential, and we should give them every opportunity to reach it.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We believe there is an inseparable link between a vibrant economy and a highquality education system.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: It takes a vibrant economy to provide the tax base necessary to fund a high-quality education system.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Equally, it takes a quality education system to provide the highly skilled labor force necessary to meet the demands of a growing, vibrant economy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Strong schools will also produce a workforce with the skills to compete in the 21st century economy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We must have citizens capable of conceiving the next generation of new technologies and innovations, mastering the art of analyzing problems and crafting their solutions.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Education is the key to prosperity and fulfillment - the foundation on which all other success is built.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: On just his fourth day in office, President Bush presented the No Child Left Behind initiative to Congress.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Less than a year later, he secured an overwhelming bipartisan majority to pass the No Child Left Behind Act of 2001.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: It was the most significant overhaul of federal education policy since 1965.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: And it became a promise kept to parents, students, teachers, and every American.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • Ensuring stronger accountability for student achievement, for all children
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • Encouraging education methods that work
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: • Providing flexibility and control to states and local communities
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •Giving parents more information about the quality of their children's schools and offering them choices and resources for their children's education
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Results are now measured on the basis of student achievement rather than simply dollars spent.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Students are benefiting from education reforms that set high academic standards, encourage strong parental involvement, recognize the role of excellent teachers, foster safe and orderly classrooms, and establish a commitment to teaching the basics of reading and math.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: With this success, Republicans have transformed the debate on education.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are the Party parents can trust to improve schools and provide opportunity for all children, in every neighborhood, regardless of background or income.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are the party willing to embrace new ideas and put them to the test.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Americans agree that the status quo in education is no longer acceptable.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We have challenged low expectations and poor achievement, and we are seeing results.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Now is the time to extend the progress we've made.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The No Child Left Behind Act is already showing gains in elementary school, as student achievement scores for fourth- and eighth-graders have increased in classrooms across America.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Our next mission is to take the reforms that we know are working in elementary schools and apply them up and down the education ladder - starting in early childhood education, so that children enter school ready to learn, and finishing in high school, so that every young adult who graduates has the skills he or she needs to succeed in the 21st century economy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: For too long, the value of a high school diploma has declined as students leave school without even basic skills like reading and math, let alone the advanced math and science skills the modern workforce demands.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We pledge to bring real reform to high schools.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Thanks to President Bush's vision and the success of the No Child Left Behind Act, we have a track record worthy of Americans' trust.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We recognize that under the American Constitutional system, education is a state, local, and family responsibility, not a federal obligation.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Since over 90 percent of public school funding is state and local, not federal, it is obvious that state and local governments must assume most of the responsibility to improve the schools, and the role of the federal government must be limited as we return control to parents, teachers, and local school boards.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush and Congressional Republicans have provided the largest increase in federal education funding in history and the highest percentage gain since the 1960s.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Support for elementary and secondary education has had the largest increase in any single Presidential term since the 1960s - an increase of nearly 50 percent since 2001.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President and Congress are particularly focused on programs for America's neediest students, including minorities and children with special needs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: With this increased funding comes a new focus on achievement and results.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President and Republicans in Congress recognize that states and local communities are most directly responsible for the quality of education in their schools.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: That is why the No Child Left Behind Act stipulates that the states, not the federal government, develop an accountability plan that will work best for them.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Since President Bush signed NCLB into law, all states have developed an accountability plan of assessments, graduation rates, and other key indicators of student achievement for all individual students and groups of students.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Under the No Child Left Behind Act, every child counts.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: No child will be hidden in a maze of numbers.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: If some children are struggling while others succeed, we will praise success and deliver help to students who need it.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Our Party believes, as does the President, that reading is the new civil right.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Every child must be able to read by the end of the third grade.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President and Congressional Republicans have taken important steps to help every student achieve that goal.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The Reading First initiative brings scientifically based reading instruction, including phonics, to children in the early grades.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Over $1. 4 billion in funding for reading programs provides training for teachers and materials for children.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In addition, since the passage of the No Child Left Behind Act, states have received additional funds for early childhood reading efforts.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The Republican Party strongly supports school choice, because choice creates competition and competition puts the focus on quality.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush, Republican governors, and members of Congress have worked to expand parental choice and encourage competition by providing parents with information on their child's school, increasing the number of charter schools, and expanding education savings accounts for use from kindergarten through college.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Under NCLB, states and school districts publish report cards showing how well students are achieving so communities and parents can know how well their schools are doing.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Parents of children in schools identified as needing improvement can choose another public school or get tutoring or other help for their child.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush and the Republican Congress enacted the D.C. School Choice initiative - the first federally funded school choice demonstration program.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We commend the President and Congress for making DC's schoolchildren the most important special interest in education improvement.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: And we support state efforts to expand school choice, as well as the President's call to provide funding for new and existing charter schools, including assistance for school facilities.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We believe that competition between schools is an effective option to improve the educational benefits for our children.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The Republican Party supports the efforts of parents who choose faith-based and other nonpublic school options for their children.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are beginning to see success as a result of the No Child Left Behind Act at the elementary level, and now we must improve our high schools so that every graduate is prepared for the rigors of college, for the best jobs of the 21st century economy, or for military service.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush has proposed a number of initiatives to improve math and science education, help striving readers, and raise standards for high schools.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Research confirms what every parent knows to be true through commonsense and experience - a good teacher makes all the difference in a child's education.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The No Child Left Behind Act set the goal of having a highly qualified teacher in every classroom by the 2005-2006 school year.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: States have been provided flexibility and resources to make sure teachers have the skills and tools to be successful with all children.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: These needed reforms are backed by historic levels of funding for teacher quality initiatives and support for teachers, including training, recruitment incentives, loan forgiveness, and tax relief.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We must also work to reduce the barriers that are keeping qualified professionals from entering the classroom by expanding alternative pathways to teacher certification - programs like Troops to Teachers, which helps former military personnel become classroom teachers; and Transition to Teaching, which provides training for people who want to become teachers and encourages states to develop and expand alternative routes to teacher licensure and certification.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Every teacher and every student deserves a safe classroom in which to work and learn.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The No Child Left Behind Act ensures that teachers and other school professionals can undertake reasonable actions to maintain order and discipline in the classroom without the fear of litigation.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The law provides civil immunity in any state court and limits the financial liability of teachers, instructors, principals, administrators, and other education professionals for actions taken to maintain discipline, order, or control in the school or classroom.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support the President's "Good Start, Grow Smart" initiative, which strengthens Head Start by increasing accountability in the program so that students start kindergarten with the early skills they need.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: It also includes the Early Reading First initiative, designed to improve existing early education programs to prepare young children to succeed in school, especially those from low-income families.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: States should be able to coordinate preschool programs with Head Start programs in exchange for meeting certain accountability requirements.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Community colleges play a vital role in not only cultivating citizens for the 21st century, but also equipping them with the essential skills and training needed for jobs in the new economy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Because they are so adaptable and accessible, community colleges are increasingly critical providers of job training, both for degree-seekers and for workers seeking to retool, refine, and broaden their skills.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support the President's HighGrowth Job Training Initiative, which has provided seed money to fund job training partnerships between community colleges and local high-growth industries.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans are working to ensure that college is affordable and accessible for America's low- and middle-income families through increased funding of grants, lowinterest student loans, and tax breaks for working families.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As a result of Republican leadership, total student aid for higher education has increased to a historic $73 billion proposed for 2005.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Next year, almost 10 million students and parents will receive one or more grants, loans, or work-study awards.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President has requested record levels of Pell Grant funding.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: These grants will help an estimated 5. 3 million low-income students pay for higher education - one million more students than when President Bush and Vice President Cheney came to office.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Under a new Enhanced Pell Grant proposal, low-income students who take a rigorous high school curriculum - the kind of curriculum that will best prepare them for success in college - will be eligible to receive an additional $1,000 per year.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: To ensure that America remains the world leader in the innovation economy - and to ensure that America's graduates have the training they need to compete for the best jobs of the 21st century - President Bush proposes to expand opportunities for math and science education in colleges and universities.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Needy students studying math and science will be eligible to receive additional college aid.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans have made Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) and Hispanic Serving Institutions (HSIs) a priority.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: For more than a century, HBCUs and HSIs have played a vital role in providing opportunities for excellence in higher education to millions of African American and Hispanic students.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Today, their mission continues, and it deserves our support.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We applaud President Bush for fulfilling his pledge to increase funding for HBCUs and HSIs by 30 percent since 2001.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Millions of Americans suffer from problem or pathological gambling that can destroy families.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support legislation prohibiting gambling over the Internet or in student athletics by student athletes who are participating in competitive sports.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As the dynamic global economy forces many workers to consider changing fields or adding new skills, the President and Republican Congress want to make training for new jobs easier to come by and more flexible in providing individualized assistance.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Ensuring that workers have the tools they need to succeed in the 21st Century Economy is a critical step in helping Americans be self-sufficient and successful.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: It is also critical to maintaining our position as the most productive and strongest economy in the world.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support effective and enhanced job training programs that offer states additional flexibility and individuals more choice to design their own workforce training programs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President's Personal Reemployment Accounts would provide unemployed workers flexible support and incentives in finding a job.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: And President Bush and Congressional Republicans are also providing unprecedented assistance for workers adversely affected by foreign trade - including additional training, income support, and health care assistance.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The cost of providing health care for employees is a major burden for American businesses.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Health insurance costs for employers have been rising every year since 1996, causing businesses to hire fewer new employees and too many families to go without insurance.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Studies show that 60 percent of uninsured Americans either work for a small business or are dependent upon someone who does.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The way to alleviate that burden is to bring down the cost of health care in America.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Shifting the cost-burden onto the federal or state governments - costs that will ultimately be borne by the taxpayers - is not an effective solution to the problem.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We must attack the root causes of high health care costs by: aiding small businesses in offering health care to their employees; empowering the self-employed through access to affordable coverage; putting patients and doctors in charge of medical decisions; reducing junk lawsuits and limiting punitive damage awards that raise the cost of health care; and seizing the cost-saving and quality-enhancing potential of emerging health technologies.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: It is also important that we reaffirm our Party's firm rejection of any measure aimed at making health care a government-run enterprise.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Frequent, unwarranted, lawsuits force doctors out of certain specialty areas and geographic regions.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The Republican Party reaffirms its commitment to putting patients and doctors ahead of trial lawyers.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Until that time, beneficiaries have access to immediate and significant savings on prescription drugs through Medicare-approved prescription drug discount cards.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America
