title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Seniors are saving up to 30 percent off the retail price of brand name drugs and up to 60 percent off the price of generic drugs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In addition, more help is available for those who need it most.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Lowincome seniors receive $600 this year and next year to assist them with the costs of their prescriptions.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Under the new drug benefit, seniors who like the coverage they have today can keep it.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The new law will encourage employers to continue their retiree health benefits by offering them subsidies for their current plans and giving them the option to supplement the new Medicare drug benefit in the same way they supplement current Medicare doctor and hospital benefits.

text: The Medicare Prescription Drug and Modernization Act improves many facets of the Medicare program.

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Disparities in health and health care based upon race, ethnicity, socio-economic status, or geography are unacceptable.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Historically, African Americans, Hispanics, Asian Americans, Pacific Islanders, American Indians, and Alaska Natives have experienced poorer health outcomes and received lower-quality care than the majority of Americans.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: For example, infant mortality rates are twice as high among African Americans as whites, and African American children are twice as likely to have asthma and six times as likely to die from asthma as white children.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The prevalence of HIV/AIDS in Latino populations is four times higher than among whites while the prevalence among African Americans is nine times higher than that of whites.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In addition, Hispanics are nearly twice as likely to die from diabetes as whites, and African American adults are almost twice as likely to die from heart disease as whites.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: There is also strong evidence that people living in rural and other non-metropolitan areas, regardless of their race or ethnicity, are more likely to experience access problems and poorer health outcomes.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans are committed to addressing these health and health care disparities.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Progress has been made in recent years in a number of areas, including enhancement of federal research on health disparities, identification of barriers to care for our increasingly diverse population, expansion of the number of health professionals who are committed to serving minority and underserved patients and their communities, and improvement in the quality of care for uninsured and underserved populations.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans believe we must build on this success and increase these efforts.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We strongly support initiatives to improve the quality of care delivered to all Americans.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We applaud President Bush for supporting treatment of mental illness.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Mental and physical illness should be treated equitably and fairly.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In addition, we support improved training for health providers, including efforts to improve communication, collaboration, and understanding between patients and doctors.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are funding research to find cures and treatments for illnesses that disproportionately affect minority populations, as well as targeted, well-coordinated programs to prevent, manage, and treat these diseases.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support efforts to encourage qualified minorities to enter the fields of science and medicine.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: America is the world's leader in developing the medical and pharmaceutical breakthroughs that have revolutionized health care.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush and the Republican Congress recognize and strongly support scientific advancement, especially in the area of biomedical research.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Working together with President Bush, the Republican Congress has fulfilled its pledge to double funding for the National Institutes of Health.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: With increased funding, the NIH is now supporting nearly 40,000 projects, an all-time high.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Government investment in biomedical research yields tangible benefits, resulting in decreased death rates, better access to health care, and a better quality of life for all Americans - especially for underserved and minority populations.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Quality research provides benefits including disease prevention, early detection, and new, more effective treatments for heart disease, stroke, diabetes, cancer, Parkinson's Disease, Alzheimer's, and HIV/AIDS.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans continue to be active leaders in setting sound biomedical research policy and remain committed to placing a high priority on continued world leadership in research, while maintaining accountability for the use of resources and a responsibility to uphold the highest ethical standards.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans have supported, and will continue to support, important scientific research without undermining the fundamental ethical principles that have guided medical research in this country for decades.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We especially welcome and encourage a stronger emphasis on adult stem cell and cord blood stem cell research, which has already provided benefits to hundreds of patients and provides real promise for treatments to help millions of Americans.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We recognize that President Bush made a carefully considered decision to allow federal funding for stem cell research for the first time, and did not affect stem cell research in the private sector.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We strongly support the President's policy that prevents taxpayer dollars from being used to encourage the future destruction of human embryos.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In addition, we applaud the President's call for a comprehensive ban on human cloning and on the creation of human embryos solely for experimentation.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In August 2001, President Bush stated: "[T]he hope [it] offers is amazing….
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Yet the ethics of medicine are not infinitely adaptable.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: There is at least one bright line: We do not end some lives for the medical benefit of others.”
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We wholeheartedly agree.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As Americans live longer, we must consider the costs of spending more years in retirement and the increasing health care needs associated with aging.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: There is a growing need for long-term care and it calls for long-term planning, both by individuals and by government.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We encourage, at all levels of government, regulatory flexibility and sensitivity to individual needs in nursing homes and related facilities.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Sacrifices are being made by millions of men and women to care for their mothers and fathers.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support proposals by President Bush and Republicans in Congress to recognize and reward individual responsibility and compassion by creating an above-the-line tax deduction for premiums of long-term care insurance and allowing an additional personal tax exemption for taking care of an elderly parent at home.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As Americans, we must honor our commitment to the 25 million veterans in the United States.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: America is dedicated to honoring its commitment to these patriots.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Veterans have helped shape the American character, and their service represents the highest form of national service.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush and Congress have increased funding for veterans services, including substantial increases in Veterans' Administration (VA) health care funding.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: This additional funding has made it possible for the VA to improve health care access for veterans who need it most, including low-income veterans, those with service-connected disabilities, and those who need VA's specialized services.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush has twice signed legislation effectively providing "concurrent receipt" of both military retiree pay and VA disability compensation for combat-injured and highlydisabled veterans, thus reversing a century-old law preventing concurrent receipts.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In addition, President Bush has fulfilled his promise to cut the disability claims backlog that existed when he took office and reduce waiting times for veterans seeking initial medical care.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support more care to more veterans in more places where they need it most.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also applaud the President's efforts to maintain and expand our national cemeteries.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: And with World War II veterans dying at the rate of 4,000 a day, we note with great appreciation the opening of the nation's World War II Memorial in Washington, D.C.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Our veterans have fought and defended this country in many wars and proudly raised the American flag on such far-away places as San Juan Hill, Iwo Jima, and Pork Chop Hill, and it has become a symbol of our American spirit and unity.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We, as well as they, deplore the deliberate desecration of our flag and state that its deliberate desecration is not "free speech," but rather an assault against both our proud history and our greatest hopes.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We therefore support a Constitutional amendment that will restore to the people, through their elected representatives, their right to safeguard Old Glory.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans know that economic prosperity is essential to environmental progress.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: That belief is supported by compelling historical evidence.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: For example, over the last 30 years, air pollution from the six major pollutants decreased substantially, even as our population grew, our energy consumption increased, and the economy expanded.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Our Party's environmental policies are geared towards results.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Thanks to President Bush's strong leadership and the commitment of Congressional Republicans to reform and innovation, air pollution has been reduced, water quality has improved, wetlands have been restored, and more than a thousand brownfields sites are being revitalized.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans also acknowledge the progress made by states and local communities in environmental stewardship efforts.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As the laboratories of innovation, they should be given flexibility and authority to address many environmental concerns.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Finally, we link the security of private property to our environmental agenda because environmental stewardship has been best advanced where property is privately held.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: After all, people who live on the land, work the land, and own the land also love the land and protect it.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush and the Republican Congress will safeguard private property rights by enforcing the Takings Clause of the Fifth Amendment and by providing just compensation whenever private property is needed to achieve a compelling public purpose.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support President Bush's Clear Skies proposal, the most aggressive Presidential initiative in history to reduce power plant emissions.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Clear Skies, through a proven cap-and-trade system, will reduce by 70 percent emissions of sulfur dioxide, nitrogen oxides, and mercury.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The market-based policies in Clear Skies, along with a 90 percent cut in pollution from diesel vehicles, will help states meet new, more stringent standards to protect public health.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President's plan also provides regulatory certainty, enabling power plants to install state-of-the-art pollution control technologies.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: These steps will lead to significant environmental improvements while ensuring a reliable, affordable electricity supply and keeping America's coal industry strong.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Two years ago, President Bush fulfilled a campaign promise and signed legislation to clean up more of the abandoned and polluted industrial sites known as brownfields.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: So far, the Bush Administration has restored more than 1,000 brownfields to usable condition, which is more than were restored in the previous seven years.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: And that work continues.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: By prioritizing cleanup of brownfields, we are encouraging growth on existing sites and thus preserving greenfields and undeveloped land.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are also opening usable land for small businesses and residents in hundreds of communities, and creating thousands of jobs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support these efforts to revitalize urban neighborhoods, both aesthetically and economically.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush's commitment to national parks is producing results: parks are better managed, better funded, and better protected.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Over the last four years, President Bush has been fulfilling his campaign promise to address the $4. 9 billion maintenance backlog plaguing the National Park system.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans will continue to support President Bush's approach to improving national parks, and will move forward with common-sense management reforms that maximize visitor satisfaction and protect and conserve the parks' natural resources for future generations.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Our air, land, and water have all become cleaner in the last four years - and this progress can be seen all across America.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The 2002 Farm Bill provided unprecedented levels of funding to enhance conservation efforts by farmers and ranchers.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: And last year President Bush worked with the Republican leadership in Congress to pass the Healthy Forests Restoration Act.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: This law, based on the President's Healthy Forests Initiative, is reducing the risk of catastrophic wildfire, saving lives and property, and improving the health of our forests.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: America's wetlands serve as habitat for thousands of species of wildlife.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: They also help to trap pollution, clean the water, reduce the impact of floods, and stabilize shore areas.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Three decades ago, the United States was losing wetlands at the rate of about 500,000 acres each year.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush is working with the Republican Congress and state and local officials to fulfill his new national goal to increase wetland acres and quality by restoring, improving, and protecting at least three million wetland acres over the next five years.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: To achieve this worthy goal, our Party also will focus on critical resource needs, including implementing a sensible plan to address coastal erosion in the Gulf Coast region.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Chronic water shortages in the West are one of the greatest environmental challenges facing the nation in the coming decades.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support efforts by the Administration to work with states and local communities in the West to expand the use of proven tools like market-based voluntary transfers through water banks and other water-marketing tools.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also endorse the President's efforts to work with the state of Florida to implement the Comprehensive Everglades Restoration Plan.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Our Party reaffirms the traditional primacy of states over water allocation.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We steadfastly oppose diverting water away from the Great Lakes region.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans are committed to developing an integrated, comprehensive national oceans policy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President and Congress have supported the work of the U.S. Oceans Commission, which will offer important recommendations to improve management, observation, and conservation of oceans and coastal resources for future generations.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans are committed to meeting the challenge of long-term global climate change by relying on markets and new technologies to improve energy efficiency.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: These efforts will help reduce emissions over time while allowing the economy to grow.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Our President and our Party strongly oppose the Kyoto Protocol and similar mandatory carbon emissions controls that harm economic growth and destroy American jobs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The Endangered Species Act (ESA) serves a noble purpose, which Americans overwhelmingly support.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Our Party remains committed to the goal of protecting species to enhance their chances for survival.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Over the last 30 years, successes under ESA have been limited due to confrontation and polarization - including an ever-growing barrage of litigation preventing the Fish and Wildlife Service from protecting new species and recovering plants and animals already listed as threatened or endangered.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans believe we can achieve greater progress in protecting species for future generations through results-based cooperative conservation programs and voluntary agreements that encourage private stewardship.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The ESA must be updated to reflect new approaches that focus resources on species in need of recovery, not lawsuits.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As with other major federal environmental laws, ESA should require peer-reviewed science, so resources can be focused on the most pressing recovery efforts.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Just as importantly, the Act should encourage expansion of voluntary agreements with private property owners while ensuring that ESA enforcement respects and upholds private property rights.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: American farm and ranch families embody some of the best values of our nation: hard work and risk-taking, love of the land and love of our country.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Farming is the first industry of America - the industry that feeds us, the industry that clothes us, and the industry that increasingly provides more of our energy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The success of America's farmers and ranchers is essential to the success of the American economy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President put his words into action when he signed the 2002 Farm Bill, passed with strong support from Republicans in Congress.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: And President Bush continues to pursue and enforce international trade agreements that affect farmers and ranchers.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republican policies are working, such as the recently revitalized WTO Doha round negotiations that will create new opportunities for U.S. farmers and ranchers by cutting foreign tariffs, expanding quotas for American products, and eliminating agricultural export subsidies.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Since 2001, the U.S. farm economy has enjoyed tremendous improvement and is today in a position of historic strength.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Farmers' net cash income for 2003 was $63 billion, an 11. 5 percent increase from 2000.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: And farmers' equity reached a record $1. 16 trillion last year, putting American agriculture in its best financial health ever.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: There is much more to rural America than agriculture, ranching, and forestry.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The kind of economic development that generates family-sustaining jobs is critical to small towns and rural communities.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush and the Republican Congress are promoting good schools, accessible health care, decent housing, safe drinking water and waste disposal, and efficient transportation.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: They also are expanding the availability of the Internet and broadband service to allow people in rural America to access world-class technology.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We are proud to meet in a city that enjoyed a new birth of vitality under the leadership of one of America's foremost Republican mayors, Rudy Giuliani.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: New York City evolved from a city plagued by crime, smothered by government, and void of opportunity, into one that attracts both families and young people looking to build careers and enjoy an urban lifestyle.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: New York's turnaround is a testament to the great power of turning Republican ideals into policies and solutions.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: By focusing on economic growth and opportunity, business development, crime control, and the revitalization of urban eyesores, we can inject fresh energy and opportunity into America's urban centers.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Lower taxes, passed by the Republican Congress, are stimulating development and investment in cities around the country.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: New homeownership opportunities are giving residents a stake in urban neighborhoods.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Violent crime rates, including robberies and rapes, were down in 2003.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President's commitment to cleaning up brownfields and making them ready for productive purposes is transforming once-crumbling communities.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: His Faith-Based Initiative is extending the work of religious and charitable groups that operate in cities - serving meals, helping the homeless, and providing mentors for children.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: And the No Child Left Behind law is bringing new hope to parents and students in inner city schools.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush is building on the successes of Republican mayors who bring opportunity to inner cities.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: At the same time, the President is working with mayors and local leaders across America to ensure that the unprecedented homeland security funding provided by the Republican Congress is spent on shoring up the security of major cities and preparing first responders for any potential future attack.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: By making America's cities places of opportunity and safety, attractive to citizens of all backgrounds, we ensure that urban centers remain vital and vibrant communities.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: , is a special responsibility of the federal government and should be a model for urban areas throughout the country.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The city's downhill slide was stopped in the 1990s, both through its own internal efforts and through the active intervention of Congressional Republicans.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The D.C. homebuyer's tax credit helped to revitalize marginal neighborhoods and should be reinstated.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: A landmark tuition assistance act opened the doors of America's public colleges and universities to residents of the District.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: And, thanks to President Bush acting in concert with Republicans in Congress, District elementary and high school students are now benefiting from the $14 million D.C. School Choice initiative - the first federally-funded school choice demonstration program.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Local government reform is an issue of importance to both Congress and residents of the District.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Recent city administrations have made great strides in improving the operations of city government and, as these efforts continue, we support yielding more budgetary and legal autonomy to local elected officials.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As the seat of our federal government and a likely target of the September 11th attacks, Washington, D.C. also plays a critical role in homeland security.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The federal government should continue to work closely with city officials to ensure maximum public safety for both residents of and visitors to the District, and respect the unique budgetary constraints under which the city operates.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support efforts to end chronic homelessness by providing support services and housing for chronically homeless individuals.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Although these individuals comprise roughly ten percent of the homeless population, they consume a disproportionately large share of all homeless emergency services because their housing, health, and other needs have not before been comprehensively addressed.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: By taking on the toughest cases, we can bring help and hope to individuals who may feel that society long ago left them behind.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Republicans and President Bush strongly support an individual right to own guns, which is explicitly protected by the Constitution's Second Amendment.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Our Party honors the great American tradition of hunting and we applaud efforts by the Bush Administration to make more public lands available to hunters, to increase access to hunting clinics and safety programs for children and adults, and to improve opportunities for hunting for Americans with disabilities.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We believe the Second Amendment and all of the rights guaranteed by it should enable law-abiding citizens throughout the country to own firearms in their homes for self-defense.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: To protect the rights and safety of law-abiding citizens, the Congress passed and President Bush signed the Law Enforcement Officers Safety Act, which allows active and retired law enforcement officers to carry concealed guns in public while off-duty.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support efforts by the Administration and Congress to enhance the instant background check system for gun purchases and to ensure that records of lawful transactions are destroyed in a timely manner.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We applaud Congressional Republicans for seeking to stop frivolous lawsuits against firearms manufacturers, which is a transparent attempt to deprive citizens of their Second Amendment rights.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We oppose federal licensing of lawabiding gun owners and national gun registration as a violation of the Second Amendment and an invasion of privacy of honest citizens.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We agree that the best way to deter crime is to enforce existing laws and hand down tough penalties against anyone who commits a crime with a gun.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: This approach is working.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Since Project Safe Neighborhoods was instituted in 2001, hundreds of new federal, state, and local prosecutors have been hired to target criminals who use guns.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Prosecutions are up 68 percent, and the violent crime victimization rate is down 21 percent.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The Republican Party and President Bush support a federal Constitutional amendment for victims of violent crime that would provide specific rights for victims protected under the U.S. Constitution.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support courts having the option to impose the death penalty in capital murder cases.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We praise President Bush and Republicans in Congress for the measures they have taken to protect pregnant women from violent crime by passing Laci and Conner's law, which recognizes the common-sense proposition that when a crime of violence against a pregnant woman kills or injures her unborn child, there are two victims and two offenses that should be punished.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: This year, more than 600,000 inmates will be released from prison.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Studies show that, without intervention, approximately two-thirds will likely be rearrested within three years of their release.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President has proposed a four-year, $300 million initiative to reduce recidivism and help released inmates contribute to their communities.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The initiative will harness the resources and experience of faith-based and community organizations in providing job training and placement services to 50,000 non-violent adult ex-offenders, transitional housing for up to 30,000, and voluntary mentoring support for those desiring it.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Drug abuse and addiction ruin lives.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: There can be no debate about it.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Every adult has a responsibility to teach children about the dangers of drugs - in terms of both physical harm and potential death, as well as lost opportunities for success.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: After witnessing eight years of Presidential inaction on the war against drugs during the prior Administration, we applaud President Bush for his steady commitment to reducing drug use among teens.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The Administration recently exceeded its two-year goal of reducing drug use among young people.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The most recent survey shows an 11 percent drop between 2001 and 2003 in the use of illicit drugs by teenagers.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Among teens, some drugs- such as LSD- have dropped to record-low levels of use.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: For other drugs, we are seeing the lowest levels of use in almost a decade.

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As a result of the President's leadership, the federal government is ending discrimination against faith-based organizations and now welcomes these groups as partners and allies in the effort to deliver social services to people in need.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Faith-based groups must show that their programs are effective at providing help - whether it be serving the needs of the homeless, mentoring children, or helping Americans who battle addiction.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Faith can often be a crucial element in the struggle to overcome personal challenges - and now Americans have the option of receiving treatment that meets their physical as well as spiritual needs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We commend the President for his steadfast support of people and institutions of faith, and we urge the Congress to act on legislative proposals to enhance private-sector works of charity and compassion.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also affirm that the hiring rights of religious organizations must be maintained so that religious charities do not have to abandon their religious character in order to provide publicly funded services.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support the President's efforts to encourage volunteer service and civic involvement to strengthen our communities and our nation, and to help people in need.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Our nation is a land of opportunity for all, and our communities must represent the ideal of equality and justice for every citizen.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The Republican Party favors aggressive, proactive measures to ensure that no individual is discriminated against on the basis of race, national origin, gender, or other characteristics covered by our civil rights laws.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also favor recruitment and outreach policies that cast the widest possible net so that the best qualified individuals are encouraged to apply for jobs, contracts, and university admissions.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We believe in the principle of affirmative access - taking steps to ensure that disadvantaged individuals of all colors and ethnic backgrounds have the opportunity to compete economically and that no child is left behind educationally.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support a reasonable approach to Title IX that seeks to expand opportunities for women without adversely affecting men's athletics.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We praise President Bush for his strong record on civil rights enforcement, and for becoming the first President ever to ban racial profiling by the federal government.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Finally, because we are opposed to discrimination, we reject preferences, quotas, and set-asides based on skin color, ethnicity, or gender, which perpetuate divisions and can lead people to question the accomplishments of successful minorities and women.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The foundation of our democratic republic is our commitment to conducting free and fair elections.

text: Unfortunately, in November 2000, too many people believed they were denied the right to vote.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Our national commitment to a voting process that has integrity was underscored in 2002 when the Congress passed and the President signed the Help America Vote Act (HAVA).
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We will continue to do all we can to ensure that every lawful vote counts for all Americans.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support the New Freedom Initiative, President Bush's plan for fully integrating Americans with disabilities into all aspects of American life.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: These are strong efforts to help Americans with disabilities lead independent, fulfilling lives.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We applaud the President and Congress for increasing funding for the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA), which requires that eligible students with disabilities be provided a free, appropriate public education.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also endorse efforts to protect children and their parents from being coerced into administering a controlled substance in order to attend school.

text: •Private sector initiatives, rather than public assistance, can best improve material conditions in Indian communities.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: •High taxes and unreasonable regulations stifle new and expanded businesses and thwart the creation of job opportunities and prosperity.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We will strengthen Native American selfdetermination by respecting tribal sovereignty, encouraging economic development on Native lands, and working with them to reorganize the Bureau of Indian Affairs and the Indian Health Service.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We applaud President Bush for keeping his promise to eliminate within five years the maintenance and repairs backlog afflicting Indian schools.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support efforts to provide higher quality health care through the Indian Health Service.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We uphold the unique government-to-government relationship between the tribes and the United States and honor our nation's trust obligations to them.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support efforts to ensure equitable participation in federal programs by Native Americans, Native Alaskans, and Native Hawaiians and to preserve their cultures and languages.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In the federal courts, scores of judges with activist backgrounds in the hard-left now have lifetime tenure.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Recent events have made it clear that these judges threaten America's dearest institutions and our very way of life.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In some states, activist judges are redefining the institution of marriage.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The Pledge of Allegiance has already been invalidated by the courts once, and the Supreme Court's ruling has left the Pledge in danger of being struck down again - not because the American people have rejected it and the values that it embodies, but because a handful of activist judges threaten to overturn commonsense and tradition.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: And while the vast majority of Americans support a ban on partial birth abortion, this brutal and violent practice will likely continue by judicial fiat.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We believe that the self-proclaimed supremacy of these judicial activists is antithetical to the democratic ideals on which our nation was founded.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush has established a solid record of nominating only judges who have demonstrated respect for the Constitution and the democratic processes of our republic, and Republicans in the Senate have strongly supported those nominees.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We call upon obstructionist Democrats in the Senate to abandon their unprecedented and highly irresponsible filibuster of President Bush's highly qualified judicial nominees, and to allow the Republican Party to restore respect for the law to America's courts.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The sound principle of judicial review has turned into an intolerable presumption of judicial supremacy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: A Republican Congress, working with a Republican president, will restore the separation of powers and re-establish a government of law.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: There are different ways to achieve that goal, such as using Article III of the Constitution to limit federal court jurisdiction; for example, in instances where judges are abusing their power by banning the use of "under God" in the Pledge of Allegiance or prohibiting depictions of the Ten Commandments, and potential actions invalidating the Defense of Marriage Act (DOMA).
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Additionally, we condemn judicial activists and their unwarranted and unconstitutional restrictions on the free exercise of religion in the public square.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: HIV/AIDS is one of the deadliest epidemics in human history.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: An estimated 38 million people worldwide are living with HIV/AIDS and more than 20 million people have died as a result of the disease.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: This disease has created an estimated 14 million HIV/AIDS orphans - children who have lost at least one parent to HIV/AIDS.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: , nearly one million Americans are believed to be infected with HIV.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We fully support the President's leadership in dramatically expanding resources to find an HIV/AIDS vaccine and in devoting at least $15 billion over five years towards global prevention, care, and treatment programs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Since taking office, President Bush has virtually tripled the United States' annual financial commitment to the global war on HIV/AIDS.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support the emphasis on prevention in the President's Emergency Plan for HIV/AIDS relief and endorse its embrace of the successful Ugandan model promoting the "ABC" approach to prevention that encourages abstinence and being faithful to one lifetime partner, along with other behavioral changes intended to eliminate or reduce exposure risk.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support the President's Advancing HIV Prevention Initiative that emphasizes routine testing, early diagnosis, ongoing monitoring, and elimination of HIV/AIDS in newborn babies and infants.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also support the President's efforts to double the amount spent on abstinence-only education and to promote healthy relationships.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We recognize the unique and special vulnerability of women and girls to HIV infection from abusive and coercive behavior beyond their control and encourage expanded efforts to address this problem through legal and cultural reform.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also support more efforts to eradicate sex trafficking and prostitution and their underlying causes.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support the expansion of programs providing support for those orphaned by HIV/AIDS.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We fully support the use of faith-based organizations as partners on the ground in HIV/AIDS relief efforts because they often have the most capability, credibility, and conviction for performing this important work in different communities, regions, and countries.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also believe treatment and prevention of drug abuse are essential components of HIV protection.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We commend the President for his support of the Ryan White CARE Act and call for its reauthorization.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We believe that ensuring access to treatment must be the priority of HIV/AIDS care programs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President's policy is to provide safe, effective, high quality HIV/AIDS drugs at the lowest possible cost.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: He has accelerated the FDA review process for HIV/AIDS drugs and therapies for use under the Emergency Plan for HIV/AIDS Relief.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: President Bush led the G-8 in endorsing the establishment of a Global HIV Vaccine Enterprise, a virtual consortium to accelerate HIV vaccine development.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President also announced plans to establish a second HIV Vaccine Research and Development Center in the U.S. , in addition to the one at the National Institutes of Health.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The new center will become a key component of the Global HIV Vaccine Enterprise.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We welcome greater participation in all aspects of the political process by Americans residing in Guam, the Virgin Islands, American Samoa, the Northern Marianas, and Puerto Rico.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Since no single approach can meet the needs of those diverse communities, we emphasize respect for their wishes regarding their relationship to the rest of the Union.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We affirm their right to seek the full extension of the Constitution, with all the rights and responsibilities it entails.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support the Native American Samoans' efforts to preserve their culture and land-tenure system, which fosters self-reliance and strong extended-family values.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support increased local self-government for the United States citizens of the Virgin Islands, and closer cooperation between the local and federal governments to promote private sector-led development and self-sufficiency.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We recognize that Guam is a strategically vital U.S. territory in the far western Pacific, an American fortress in the Asian region.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We affirm our support for the patriotic U.S. citizens of Guam to achieve greater local self-government, an improved federal-territorial relationship, new economic development strategies, and continued self-determination as desired with respect to political status.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support the right of the United States citizens of Puerto Rico to be admitted to the Union as a fully sovereign state after they freely so determine.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We recognize that Congress has the final authority to define the Constitutionally valid options for Puerto Rico to achieve a permanent non-territorial status with government by consent and full enfranchisement.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: As long as Puerto Rico is not a state, however, the will of its people regarding their political status should be ascertained by means of a general right of referendum or specific referenda sponsored by the United States government.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The Republican Party supports reforming the immigration system to ensure that it is legal, safe, orderly and humane.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: It also supports measures to ensure that the immigration system is structured to address the needs of national security.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: America is a stronger and better nation because of the hard work and entrepreneurial spirit of immigrants, and the Republican Party honors them.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: A growing economy requires a growing number of workers, and President Bush has proposed a new temporary worker program that applies when no Americans can be found to fill the jobs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: This new program would allow workers who currently hold jobs to come out of the shadows and to participate legally in America's economy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: It would allow men and women who enter the program to apply for citizenship in the same manner as those who apply from outside the United States.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: There must be strong workplace enforcement with tough penalties against employees and employers who violate immigration laws.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We oppose amnesty because it would have the effect of encouraging illegal immigration and would give an unfair advantage to those who have broken our laws.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: To better ensure that immigrants enter the United States only through legal means that allow for verification of their identity, reconnaissance cameras, border patrol agents, and unmanned aerial flights have all been increased at the border.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In addition, Border Patrol agents now have sweeping new powers to deport illegal aliens without having first to go through the cumbersome process of allowing the illegal alien to have a hearing before an immigration judge.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support these efforts to enforce the law while welcoming immigrants who enter America through legal avenues.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: "We are living in a time of great change - in our world, in our economy, in science and medicine.

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The values we try to live by never change.

text: And they are instilled in us by fundamental institutions, such as families and schools and religious congregations.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: These institutions, these unseen pillars of civilization, must remain strong in America, and we will defend them.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Families are the cornerstone of our culture - the building blocks of a strong society.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In families, children learn values and ideals, as well as the basic lessons that get them started on a lifelong path of education.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We believe that every child deserves the chance to be born and grow up in a loving family.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also believe that while families exist in many different forms, there are ideals to strive for.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Evidence shows us that children have the best chance at success when raised by a mother and a father who love and respect each other as well as their children.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also know that family breakdown makes America less stable.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: To create a sturdy foundation for the strength and success of our citizens and our nation, Republicans support policies that promote strong families.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We also support a government that makes it easier for parents to raise their children in a world that offers unprecedented opportunities and new challenges.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We offer an approach based on our common values and our common hopes.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: It will lead to a better America, one family at a time.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: In 1996, the Republican Congress made history by passing welfare reform that revolutionized the way the government helps people build better lives for themselves.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The federal government gave states the flexibility to manage the Temporary Assistance for Needy Families program, and both states and federal authorities began treating welfare as a step up rather than a way of life.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Since the 1996 Republican-led law, welfare caseloads have declined by half, and nearly three million Americans have been lifted out of poverty.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: But there is more work to do.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We need to build on the results of the 1996 reforms and continue to move welfare recipients into jobs and off the welfare rolls.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: This is especially important for single women and mothers, who continue to rely on welfare and fear that they cannot find a job or enter a training program because they need to care for their children.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We endorse President Bush's plan to extend the benefits of welfare reform by strengthening work requirements and promoting healthy marriages, and offering training, transportation, and child care services to help people become self-sufficient.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Every American deserves a chance to know the pride of earning a paycheck and providing for his or her family.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support the President's welfare reform proposals that promote child wellbeing and stronger marriages.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We recognize the importance of having in the home a father and a mother who are married.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The two-parent family still provides the best environment of stability, discipline, responsibility, and character.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We recognize that fathers play a critical role in providing stability for their children.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Studies show that children are much more likely to do well in school and avoid crime and drugs when they have a responsible father in their lives.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Promoting responsible fatherhood will have longlasting benefits for families and for communities.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support President Bush's initiatives to reaffirm the important role fathers play in their children's lives and to help men meet the responsibilities of fatherhood.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support the President's strong efforts to promote adoption through increased tax incentives and bonuses to states that place older children in permanent family homes, as well as his efforts to promote foster care by increasing the allocation of funds for preventive and family services.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Children's health remains a top priority for every family and for our country.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Despite advances in medicine, environmental progress, and increased efforts to keep children safe at home and in communities, alarming trends in overweight children and childhood obesity jeopardize the health of millions of children.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Too many of America's youth do not exercise, are overweight, and have poor dietary habits.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: This leads to complications in childhood and as adults.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Five chronic diseases associated with obesity - heart disease, cancer, stroke, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (such as bronchitis, emphysema, and asthma), and diabetes - account for more than two-thirds of all deaths in the United States.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Extensive research, much of it conducted or funded by the federal government, has shown that improving overall health, and thus preventing disease and premature death, is as easy as making small adjustments and improvements in the activities of daily life.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We applaud the President's effort to increase public awareness about the benefits of physical fitness through programs like "HealthierUS," which focuses on physical activity; a nutritious diet; medical screenings; and healthy choices - and "VERB," which encourages young people to be physically active every day.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Each year more than three million American teenagers contract sexually transmitted diseases, causing emotional harm and serious health consequences, even death.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We support efforts to educate teens and parents about the health risks associated with early sexual activity and provide the tools needed to help teens make healthy choices.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Abstinence from sexual activity is the only protection that is 100 percent effective against out-of-wedlock pregnancies and sexually transmitted diseases, including sexually transmitted HIV/AIDS.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Therefore, we support doubling abstinence education funding.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We oppose school-based clinics that provide referrals, counseling, and related services for contraception and abortion.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: We oppose school-based mental health programs that include recommendations for the use of psychotropic drugs.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: The President and Republicans in Congress are working to provide private-sector workers the same flexible scheduling options that government employees already enjoy.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: Now that more families have both parents in the workforce, American workers need more control over their work schedules.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: More flexibility in the workplace will help Americans to better manage the demands of work and family.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

text: And that will make families stronger.
title: 2004 Republican Party Platform: A Safer World and a More Hopeful America

title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We will hold the VA accountable for tangible results and steady improvement of its services.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The VA must become more responsive and more efficient by eliminating its disability backlog and reducing waiting times for treatment.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: To ensure that the VA provides veterans with world class medical care, both at its own facilities and through partnerships with community providers, we must recruit the next generation of highly qualified medical professionals.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Where distance or crowding is an obstacle to traditional VA facility-based care, our veterans should be provided access to qualified out-of-network providers.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We call for greater attention by the VA to the special health care needs of women veterans, who will comprise an even larger percentage of VA patients in the future.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The VA's current disability compensation formulas need to be restructured and modernized.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Those who have borne the burden of war must have access to training, rehabilitation, and education.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Their families and caregivers deserve our concern and support.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We pledge special attention to combat stress injuries.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: There must be adequate counseling when veterans return home — for them and their families.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: They should have ongoing professional care, whether in a VA facility or closer to home, so that the natural and usually temporary responses to the horrors of war do not become permanent conditions.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We recognize the need for more mental health professionals who can give the highest quality treatment to our veterans.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We applaud the non-profit organizations which assist veterans and their families materially and in other ways.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: They represent the best of the American spirit and merit our support.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The military's partners are the men and women who work in the defense industry and civilian sector, supplying the Armed Forces with weapons and equipment vital to the success of their mission.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: To ensure that our troops receive the best material at the best value, we must reform the defense budgeting and acquisition process to control costs and ensure vigorous and fair competition.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We will not allow congressional pork to take the place of sound, sustained investment in the nation's security.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The Republican vision of peace through strength requires a sustained international effort, which complements our military activities, to develop and maintain alliances and relationships that will lead to greater peace and stability.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The international promotion of human rights reflects our heritage, our values, and our national interest.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Societies that enjoy political and economic freedom and the rule of law are not given to aggression or fanaticism.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: They become our natural allies.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Republican leadership has made religious liberty a central element of U.S. foreign policy.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Asserting religious freedom should be a priority in all America's international dealings.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We salute the work of the U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom and urge special training in religious liberty issues for all U.S. diplomatic personnel.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: To be successful international leaders, we must uphold international law, including the laws of war, and update them when necessary.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our moral standing requires that we respect what are essentially American principles of justice.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: In any war of ideas, our values will triumph.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Advancing America's values should be the core mission of every part of the federal government, including the Department of State.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: America's diplomatic establishment must energetically represent our country's agenda to the world.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We propose a thorough reform of its structure to ensure that promotions and appointments are based on performance in supporting the nation's agenda.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our diplomats must be the best our country has to offer, and America’s diplomatic abilities must be an integral part of America's national security system.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Throughout the Cold War, our international broadcasting of free and impartial information promoted American values to combat tyranny.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: It still does, through Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty and Radio/TV Marti, and it remains an important instrument in promoting a modernizing alternative to the culture of radical terror.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Getting America's message out to the world is a critical element in the struggle against extremism, and our government must wage a much more effective battle in the war of ideas.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Generations after the end of slavery in America, new forms of bondage have emerged to exploit men, women and children.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We salute those across the political spectrum who have come together to end the commerce in our fellow human beings.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We advocate the establishment of an Inter-Agency Task Force on Human Trafficking, reporting directly to the President,
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: and call for increased diplomatic efforts with foreign governments that have been negligent toward this evil.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The principle underlying our Megan's Law — publicizing the identities of known offenders — should be extended to international travel in order to protect innocent children everywhere.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The United States participates in various inter national organizations which can, at times, serve the cause of peace and prosperity, but those organizations must never serve as a substitute for principled American leadership.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Nor should our participation in them prevent our joining with other democracies to protect our vital national interests.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: At the United Nations, our country will pay a fair, but not disproportionate, share of dues, but we will never support a UN-imposed tax.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The UN must reform its scandal-ridden and corrupt management and become more accountable and transparent in its operations and expenses.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: As a matter of U.S. sovereignty, American forces must remain under American command.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Discrimination against Israel at the UN is unacceptable.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We welcome Israel's membership in the Western European and Others Group at the UN headquarters and demand its full acceptance and participation at all UN venues.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We likewise oppose the ideological campaign against Vatican participation in UN conferences and other activities.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Because the UN has no mandate to promote radical social engineering, any effort to address global social problems must respect the fundamental institutions of marriage and family.
