title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We assert the rights of families in all international programs and will not fund organizations involved in abortion.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We strongly support the long-held policy of the Republican Party known as the "Mexico City policy,~ which prohibits federal monies from being given to non-governmental organizations that provide abortions or actively promote abortion as a method of  family planning in other countries.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We reject any treaty or agreement that would violate those values.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: That includes the UN convention on women's rights, signed in the last months of the Carter Administration, and the UN convention on the rights of the child.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: For several reasons, particularly our concern for US sovereignty
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: and America's long-term energy needs,
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: we have deep reservations about the regulatory, legal, and tax regimes inherent in the Law of the Sea Treaty.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: To shield the members of our Armed Forces and others in service to America from ideological prosecutions, the Republican Party does not accept the jurisdiction of the International Criminal Court over Americans.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support the American Servicemembers Protection Act, to shield U.S. personnel and officials as they act abroad to meet global security requirements.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Americans are the most generous people in the world.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: No nation spends more in combined public and private efforts to combat disease and poverty around the world, and no nation works harder to ensure the continued vitality of the global economy.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our reasons for doing so are both moral and practical, for a world where half of the human race lives on a few dollars a day is neither just nor stable.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Including the world's poor in an expanding circle of development is part and parcel of the Republican approach to world trade through open markets and fair competition.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: It must also be a top priority of our foreign policy.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Decades of massive aid have failed to spur economic growth in the poorest countries, where it has often propped up failed policies and corrupt rulers.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We will target foreign assistance to high-impact goals:
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: fostering the rule of law through democratic government;
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: emphasizing literacy and learning; and, concentrating on the foundations for economic development — clean water, agricultural improvement, and microcredit funding for small enterprises.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Maternal and child health, especially safer childbirthing and nutrition, must be priorities, especially in countries affected by epidemics of HIV/AIDS, malaria, and tuberculosis.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Further, we call for the development of a strategy for foreign assistance that serves our national interest.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Specifically we call for a review and improvement of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 oriented toward: alignment of foreign assistance policies, operations, budgets and statutory authorities; development of a consensus on what needs to be done to strengthen the non-military tools to further our national security goals; greater attention to core development programs — education, child survival, and agricultural development; and greater accountability by recipient countries so as to ensure against malfeasance, self-dealing, and corruption, and to ensure continued assistance is conditioned on performance.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Faith and family, culture and commerce, are enduring bonds among all the peoples of the Americas.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Republicans envision a western hemisphere of sovereign nations with secure borders, working together to advance liberty and mutually-beneficial trade based on sound and proven free enterprise principles.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our relations with our immediate neighbors, Canada and Mexico, are grounded on our shared values and common purpose, as well as our steadily increasing trade.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We pledge to continue this close association and to advance mutually beneficial trade agreements throughout Latin America, promoting economic development and social stability there while opening markets to our goods and services.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our strong ties with Canada and Mexico should not lead to a North American union or a unified currency.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Two factors distort this hemispheric progress.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: One is narco-terrorism, with its ability to destabilize societies and corrupt the political process.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: In an era of porous borders, the war on drugs and the war on terror have become a single enterprise.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We salute our allies in the fight against this evil, especially the people of Mexico and Colombia, who have set an example for their neighbors.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support approval of the free trade agreement with Colombia, currently blocked by Capitol Hill Democrats and their union boss supporters, as an overdue gesture of solidarity for this courageous ally of the United States.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The other malignant element in hemispheric affairs is the anachronistic regime in Havana, a mummified relic from the age of totalitarianism, and its buffoonish imitators.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We call on the nations of Latin America and the Caribbean to join us in laying the groundwork for a democratic Cuba.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Looking to the inevitable day of liberation, we support restrictions on trade with, and travel to, Cuba as a measure of solidarity with the political prisoners and all the oppressed Cuban people.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We call for a dedicated platform for transmission of Radio and Television Marti into Cuba and, to prepare for the day when Cuba is free, we support the work of the Commission for Assistance to a Free Cuba.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We affirm the principles of the Cuban Adjustment Act of 1966, recognizing the rights of Cubans fleeing Communist tyranny, and support efforts to admit more of them through a safe, legal, orderly process.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Republicans have faced up to each of those challenges because, in addition to humanitarian concerns, the U.S. has important security interests in the stability and progress of African nations.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The devastating toll of HIV/AIDS threatens to destabilize entire societies through large numbers of orphaned youths.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: In response, the U.S. has become the unrivaled leader in fighting the diseases that are the scourge of much of the continent.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Republican-sponsored legislation has brought jobs and investment to sub-Saharan Africa.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: To continue that progress, we advocate continued expansion of trade with African nations.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Genocide must end.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The horrendous suffering of the people in the Darfur region of Sudan, as well as less publicized human tragedies elsewhere, calls for a far more energetic and determined response from Africa's elected leaders.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The United States stands ready to assist them with materiel, transportation, and humanitarian supplies.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We will continue America’s diplomatic efforts to secure a comprehensive and humane settlement for the people of the southern and western Sudan.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The promise of democracy and freedom in Africa is diminished by the government of Zimbabwe, which has seized lands without compensation, debased the currency, murdered and tortured its people, and so intimidated voters that free and fair elections are impossible.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support sanctions against this government, free elections, and the restoration of civil government in Zimbabwe.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The U.S. is a Pacific nation, and our historic ties to Asia will grow stronger in the years ahead.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Australia has stood shoulder to shoulder with us in every major conflict.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The ties between our peoples, our economies, and our governments are extraordinary.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We cherish our bonds with our Freely Associated States in the Pacific Islands.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our longstanding alliance with Japan has been the foundation for peace and prosperity in Asia, and we look for Japan to forge a leadership role in regional and global affairs.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Another valued ally, the Republic of Korea remains vigilant with us against the tyranny and international ambitions of the maniacal state on its border.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The U.S. will not waver in its demand for the complete, verifiable, and irreversible dismantlement of North Korea’s nuclear weapons programs, with a full accounting of its proliferation activities.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We look toward the restoration of human rights to the suffering people of North Korea and the fulfilment of the wish of the Korean people to be one in peace and freedom.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We welcome America’s new relationship with India, including the U.S.-India Civil Nuclear Accord.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our common security concerns and shared commitment to political freedom and representative government can be the foundation for an enduring partnership.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We must expand our ties with the government and the people of Pakistan.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support their efforts to improve democratic governance and strengthen civil society, and we appreciate the difficult but essential role Pakistan plays in the fight against terror.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our policy toward Taiwan, a sound democracy and economic model for mainland China, must continue to be based upon the provisions of the Taiwan Relations Act.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We oppose any unilateral steps by either side to alter the status quo in the Taiwan straits on the principle that all issues regarding the island's future must be resolved peacefully, through dialogue, and be agreeable to the people of Taiwan.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: If China were to violate these principles, the U.S., in accord with the Taiwan Relations Act, will help Taiwan defend itself.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: As a loyal friend of America, the democracy of Taiwan has merited our strong support, including the timely sale of defensive arms and full participation in the World Health Organization and other multilateral institutions.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We will welcome the emergence of a peaceful and prosperous China, and we will welcome even more the development of a democratic China.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Its rulers have already discovered that economic freedom leads to national wealth; the next lesson is that political and religious freedom leads to national greatness.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: That is not likely to be learned while the government in Beijing pursues advanced military capabilities without any apparent need, imposes a "one-child" policy on its people, suppresses basic human rights in Tibet and elsewhere, and erodes democracy in Hong Kong.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: China must honor its obligations regarding free speech and a free press as announced prior to the Olympics.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our bilateral trade with China has created export opportunities for American farmers and workers, while both the requirements of the World Trade Organization and the realities of the marketplace have increased openness and the rule of law in China.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We must yet ensure that China fulfils its WTO obligations, especially those related to protecting intellectual property rights, elimination of subsidies, and repeal of import restrictions. China's full integration into the global economy requires that it adopt a flexible monetary exchange rate and allow free movement of capital.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: China's economic growth brings with it the responsibility for environmental improvement, both for its own people and for the world community.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our relations with Vietnam have improved, but two grave matters remain.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The first is the need for unceasing efforts to obtain an accounting for, and repatriation of the remains of, Americans who gave their lives in the cause of freedom.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The second is continued repression of human rights and religious freedom, and the retribution by the government of Vietnam against its ethnic minorities and others who assisted U.S. forces there.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We owe them a debt of honor and will do all we can to relieve their suffering.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We urge all the nations of East Asia to join the worldwide effort to restore the suffering people of Burma to the democratic family of nations.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The military dictatorship in Burma is among the worst on the planet.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Its savagery demands a strong response from the world community, including economic and financial sanctions and isolation of the illegitimate regime.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our country's ties to the peoples of Europe are based on shared culture and values, common interests and goals.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We particularly appreciate our close friendship with the United Kingdom, a relationship that has led the forces of freedom for generations.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The enduring truth — that America's security is inseparable from Europe's — was reaffirmed by our European allies after September 11, 2001.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: NATO, the most successful military alliance in history, has been greatly strengthened by the addition of new members in Central and Eastern Europe.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We believe the door to NATO membership should remain open to all democratic nations who share our values and meet the requirements for NATO membership.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We strongly support NATO-endorsed efforts to deploy missile defenses to protect our European allies from the threat of Iranian missiles, and we appreciate the willingness of the governments of Poland and the Czech Republic to host these needed defensive systems.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We condemn the Russian Federation's attempts to intimidate states, formerly under Soviet domination, in order to prevent their deploying missile defenses.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The decision on this question is for each sovereign nation to decide.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support the ongoing reconciliation efforts in Cyprus and Northern Ireland, including the appointment of a U.S. Special Envoy for Northern Ireland.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We condemn the escalation of anti-Semitic violence, arson, and desecration in Europe and other areas of the world.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Americans and the Russian people have common imperatives: ending terrorism, combating nuclear proliferation, promoting bilateral trade, and more.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: But matters of serious concern remain particularly the Russian government's treatment of the press, opposition parties, and institutions of civil society.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: It continues its aggressive confrontations with its neighbors, from economic intimidation to outright warfare, and has aligned with dangerous anti-democratic forces in the Middle East.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: As a condition for its continued acceptance in world organizations, Russia must respect the independence and territorial integrity of all the nations of the former Soviet Union, beginning with the republic of Georgia, and move toward a free and democratic society.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The momentum of change in the Middle East has been in the right direction.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: From Morocco to the Gulf States, the overall trend has been toward cooperation and social and economic development, especially with regard to the rights of women.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We acknowledge the substantial assistance the U.S. has received from most governments in the region in the war on terror.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Those countries that have made peace with Israel, whether officially or in fact, deserve our appreciation and assistance.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We urge the continued isolation of groups like Hamas and Hezbollah because they do not meet the standards of the international community.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We call for the restoration of Lebanon's independence and sovereignty and the full implementation of all UN resolutions concerning that country.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The struggle in which we are engaged is ideological, not ethnic or religious.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The extremists we face are abusers of faith, not its champions.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We appreciate the loyalty of all Americans whose family roots lie in the Middle East, and we gratefully acknowledge the contributions of American Arabs and Muslims, especially those in the Armed Forces and the intelligence community.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Israel is a vigorous democracy, unique in the Middle East.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We reaffirm America's commitment to Israel's security and will ensure that Israel maintains a qualitative edge in military technology over any potential adversaries. Israel must have secure, defensible borders and we support its right to exist as a Jewish state able to defend itself against homicide bombings, rocket and mortar fire, and other attacks against its people.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support the vision of two democratic states living in peace and security: Israel, with Jerusalem as its capital, and Palestine.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: For that to become a reality, the Palestinian people must support leaders who reject terror, embrace the institutions and ethos of democracy, and respect the rule of law.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We call on Arab governments throughout the region to help advance that goal.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support Jerusalem as the undivided capital of Israel and moving the American embassy to that undivided capital of Israel.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The U.S. seeks a comprehensive and lasting peace in the Middle East, negotiated between the parties themselves, without the imposition of an artificial timetable, and without the demand that Israel deal with entities which continue to pledge her destruction.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: At the heart of any peace process must be a mutual commitment to resolve all issues through negotiation.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Part of that process must be a just, fair, and realistic framework for dealing with the Palestinian refugee issue.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Like all other elements in a meaningful agreement, this matter can be settled only on the basis of mutually agreed changes that reflect today's realities as well as tomorrow's hopes.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: A stable, unified, and democratic Iraqi nation is within reach.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our success in Iraq will deny al Qaeda a safe haven, limit Iranian influence in the Middle East, strengthen moderate forces there, and give us a strategic ally in the struggle against extremism.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: To those who have sacrificed so much, we owe the commitment that American forces will leave that country in victory and with honor.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: That outcome is too critical to our own national security to be jeopardized by artificial or politically inspired timetables that neither reflect conditions on the ground nor respect the essential advice of our military commanders.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: As the people of Iraq assume their rightful place in the ranks of free and open societies, we offer them a continuing partnership.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: In the seven years since U.S. troops helped topple the Taliban, there has been great progress — but much remains to be done.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We must prevail in Afghanistan to prevent the re-emergence of the Taliban or an al Qaeda sanctuary in that country.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: A nationwide counterinsurgency strategy led by a unified commander is an essential prerequisite to success.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Additional forces are also necessary, both from NATO countries and through a doubling in size of the Afghan army.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The international community must work with the Afghan government to better address the problems of illegal drugs, governance, and corruption.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We flatly reject the Democratic Party’s idea that America can succeed in Afghanistan only by failure in Iraq.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We express our respect for the people of Iran who seek peace and aspire to freedom.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Their current regime, aggressive and repressive, is unworthy of them.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The Iranian people, many of whom risk persecution to speak out for democracy, have a right to choose their own government.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: As a rogue state, Iran’s leadership supports terror, threatens its neighbors, and provides weapons that are killing our troops in Iraq.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We affirm, in the plainest words we can use, that the U.S. government, in solidarity with the international community, will not allow the current regime in Tehran to develop nuclear weapons.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We call for a significant increase in political, economic, and diplomatic pressure to persuade Iran's rulers to halt their drive for a nuclear weapons capability, and we support tighter sanctions against Iran and the companies with business operations in or with Iran.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We oppose entering into a presidential-level, unconditional dialogue with the regime in Iran until it takes steps to improve its behavior, particularly with respect to support of terrorism and suspension of its efforts to enrich uranium.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: At the same time, the U.S. must retain all options in dealing with a situation that gravely threatens our security, our interests, and the safety of our friends
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The American people believe Washington is broken ... and for good reason.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Short-term politics overshadow the long-term interests of the nation.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our national legislature uses a budget process devised long before the Internet and seems unable to deal in realistic ways with the most pressing problems of families, businesses, and communities.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Members of Congress have been indicted for violating the public trust.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Public disgust with Washington is entirely warranted.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Republicans will uphold and defend our party's core principles:
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Constrain the federal government to its legitimate constitutional functions.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Let it empower people, while limiting its reach into their lives.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Spend only what is necessary, and tax only to raise revenue for essential government functions.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Unleash the power of enterprise, innovation, civic energy, and the American spirit — and never pretend that government is a substitute for family or community.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The other party wants more government control over people's lives and earnings; Republicans do not.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The other party wants to continue pork barrel politics; we are disgusted by it, no matter who practices it.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The other party wants to ignore fiscal problems while squandering billions on ineffective programs; we are determined to end that waste.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The entrenched culture of official Washington — an intrusive tax-and-spend liberalism — remains a formidable foe, but we will confront and ultimately defeat it.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The federal government collects $2.7 trillion a year from American families and businesses.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: That's $7.4 billion a day.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Even worse, it spends over $3 trillion a year: $8.2 billion a day.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Why? Largely because those who created this bloated government will not admit a single mistake or abolish a single program.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Here are some staggering examples of the overall problem: * Recent audits show that 22% of all federal programs are ineffective or incapable of demonstrating results. * 69 separate programs, administered by 10 different agencies, provide education or care to children under the age of 5. * Nine separate agencies administer 44 different programs for job training.   • 23 separate programs, each with its own overhead, provide housing assistance to the elderly.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: With so many redundant, inefficient, and ineffective federal programs, it is no wonder that the American people have so little confidence in Washington to act effectively when federal action is really needed.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: For more than three decades — since enactment of the Budget Act of 1974 by a Democrat-controlled Congress — the federal government has operated within a rigged system notable for its lack of transparency.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The earlier approach — annual passage of the appropriation bills, amended and voted up or down, with the numbers there for all to see — had its flaws and generated much red ink.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: But its replacement, the current budget process, only worsened the money flow and came to rely on monstrous omnibus spending bills.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The results are adverse to all seeking to limit government's growth.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: For example: * The budget process assumes every spending project will be on the books forever, even if the law says the spending will expire — but it assumes tax relief will be temporary. * It treats well-deserved tax cuts as a kind of spending, so that letting Americans keep more of their earnings is considered the same as more spending on pork projects. * It fails to recognize the positive impact that lowering tax rates has on economic growth. * In its deceptive and irresponsible accounting, an increase in a program's funding is actually a decrease if it is less than the rate of inflation. * Once a budget is produced under that sys tem, the budget law itself limits the time Congress can consider it before voting.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Moreover, the budget's review process is a sham.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Of the $3 trillion spent annually, only one-third is reviewed each year during the budget and appropriations process. The remaining $2 trillion automatically goes to interest on the national debt or entitlements.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: And because the budget process assumes an automatic increase in spending, the debate on the remaining one-third is only over how much more spending to approve.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Finally, while government requires corporations to budget for future pension and health care costs, our government ignores those requirements.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: No family or private sector business could keep its books the way Washington keeps ours.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Republicans will attack wasteful Washington spending immediately.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Current procedures should be replaced with simplicity and transparency.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: For example: * We favor adoption of the Balanced Budget Amendment to require a balanced federal budget except in time of war.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Earmarking must stop.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: To eliminate wasteful projects and pay-offs to special interests, we will impose an immediate moratorium on the earmarking system and reform the appropriations process through full transparency.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Tax dollars must be distributed on the basis of clear national priorities, not a politician's seniority or party position.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * Government waste must be taken off autopilot.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We call for a one-year pause in nondefense, non-veterans discretionary spend   ing to force a critical, cost-benefit review of all current programs.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * We call for a constitutionally sound presidential line-item veto.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * If billions are worth spending, they should be spent in the light of day.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We will insist that, before either the House or Senate considers a spending bill, every item in it should be presented in advance to the taxpayers on the Internet.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * Because the problem is too much spending, not too few taxes, we support a supermajority requirement in both the House and Senate to guard against tax hikes.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * New authorizations should be offset by reducing another program, and no appropriation should be permitted without a current authorization.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * Congressional ethics rules governing special interests should apply across the board, without the special exemptions now granted to favored institutions.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * We support the Government Shutdown Protection Act to ensure the continuance of essential federal functions when advocates of pork threaten to shut down the government unless their wasteful spending is accepted.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * We will insist that the budget reasonably plan for the long-term costs of pension and health care programs and urge the conversion of such programs to defined contribution programs.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The long term solution for many of Washington's problems is structural.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Congress must respect the limits imposed upon it by the Tenth Amendment: "The powers not delegated to the United States by the Constitution, nor prohibited by it to the States, are reserved to the States respectively, or to the people."
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We look to the model of Republican welfare reform, which, since its enactment in 1996, has accomplished a major transfer of resources and responsibility from the federal government back to the states — with an accompanying improvement in the program itself.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Applying that approach to other programs will steer Congress back into line with the Constitution, reversing both its intrusion into state matters and its neglect of its central duties.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: To aid in the fulfillment of those duties, we propose a National Sunset Commission to review all federal programs and recommend which of them should be terminated due to redundancy, waste, or intrusion into the American family.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The Congress would then be required by law to schedule one yea or nay vote on the entire sunset list with no amendments.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Additionally, as important as returning power to the states is returning power to the people.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: As the Declaration of Independence states, our rights are endowed to us by our Creator and are inalienable: rights to life, liberty, and property.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Government does not confer these rights but is instituted by men to protect the rights that man already possesses.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The Republican Party strongly affirms these rights and demands that government respect them.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Congress has a fundamental duty to conduct meaningful oversight on the effectiveness of government programs, not use every hearing as an opportunity for political grandstanding.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: To that end:  • We urge every congressional committee to reserve at least one week every month to conduct oversight of the nearly 1,700 separate grant and loan programs of the federal government.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * To prevent conflicts of interest, a Truth in Testimony mandate should require all committee witnesses to detail the amount of federal funding they and their employer currently receive and, in the case of associations, how much federal money their members would receive from the proposed legislation.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * Because official Washington does not even know how much land it owns, we call for a national audit of all federally-owned properties as a first step toward returning unnecessary properties to the American people or to state and local government for public use.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Modern management of the federal government is long overdue.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The expected retirement over the next ten years of more than 40 percent of the federal workforce, and 60 percent of its managers, presents a rare opportunity: a chance to gradually shrink the size of government while using technology to increase its effectiveness and reshape the way agencies do business.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Each agency must be able to pass a financial audit and set annual targets for improving efficiency with fewer resources.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Civil service managers should be given incentives for more effective leadership, including protection against the current guilty-until-proven-innocent grievance procedures which disgruntled employees use against them to thwart reform.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Due process cannot excuse bad behavior.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We will provide Internet transparency in all federal contracting as a necessary step in combating cost overruns.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We will draw on the expertise of today's successful managers and entrepreneurs in the private sector, like the "dollar-a-year" businesspeople who answered their country's call during the Second World War, to build real-world competence and accountability into government procurement and operations.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Americans hit by disaster must never again feel abandoned by their government.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The Katrina disaster taught a painful lesson: The federal government's system for responding to a natural calamity needs a radical overhaul.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We recognize the need for a natural disaster insurance policy.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: State and local cooperation is crucial, as are private relief efforts, but Washington must take the lead in forging a partnership with America's best run businesses to ensure that FEMA's Emergency Operations Centers run as well as any Fortune 500 Company.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We must make it easier for both businesses and non-profits to act as force-multipliers in relief situations.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We believe it is critical to support those impacted by natural disasters and to complete the rebuilding of devastated areas, including the Gulf Coast.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The American people can have safer roads and bridges, better airports and more efficient harbors, as long as we straighten out the government's spending priorities.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The politics of pork distorts the allocation of resources for modernizing the nation's infrastructure.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: That can leave entire communities vulnerable to natural disasters and deprive others of the improvements necessary for economic growth and  job creation.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We pledge a business-like, cost-effective approach for infrastructure spending, always mindful of the special needs of both rural and urban communities.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support a level of investment in the nation's transportation system that will promote a healthy economy, sustain jobs, and keep America globally competitive.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We need to improve the system's performance and capacity to deal with congestion, move a massive amount of freight, reduce traffic fatalities, and ensure mobility across both rural and urban areas.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We urgently need to preserve the highway, transit, and air facilities built over the last century so they can serve generations to come.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: At the same time, we are committed to minimizing transportation's impact on climate change, our local environments, and the nation's energy use.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Careful reforms of environmental reviews and the permitting process should speed projects to completion.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Safeguarding our transportation infrastructure is critical to our homeland security.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: An integrated, flexible system — developed and sustained in partnership between state and local governments and the federal government — must also share responsibilities with the private sector.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We call for more prudent stewardship of the nation's Highway Trust Fund to restore the program's purchasing power and ensure that it will meet the changing needs of a mobile nation.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The job of modernizing Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid calls for bipartisanship, not political posturing.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Through the last four presidential terms, we have sought that cooperation, but it has not been forthcoming.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The public demands constructive action, and we will provide it.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We are committed to putting Social Security on a sound fiscal basis.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our society faces a profound demographic shift over the next twenty-five years, from today's ratio of 3.3 workers for every retiree to only 2.1 workers by 2034.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Under the current system, younger workers will not be able to depend on Social Security as part of their retirement plan.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We believe the solution should give workers control over, and a fair return on, their contributions.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: No changes in the system should adversely affect any current or near-retiree.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Comprehensive reform should include the opportunity to freely choose to create your own personal investment accounts which are distinct from and supplemental to the overall Social Security system.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: As discussed in the health care section of this document, we commit to revive Medicare by rewarding quality care, promoting competition, eliminating waste, fraud, and abuse, and giving patients and providers control over treatment options.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We envision a new Medicaid partnership with the states, improving public health through flexibility and innovation.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Judicial activism is a grave threat to the rule of law because unaccountable federal judges are usurping democracy, ignoring the Constitution and its separation of powers, and imposing their personal opinions upon the public.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: This must stop.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We condemn the Supreme Court's disregard of homeowners' property rights in its Kelo decision and deplore the Court's arbitrary extension of Americans' habeas corpus rights to enemy combatants held abroad.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We object to the Court's unwarranted interference in the administration of the death penalty in this country for the benefit of savage criminals whose guilt is not at issue.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We lament that judges have denied the people their right to set abortion policies in the states and are undermining traditional marriage laws from coast to coast.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We are astounded that four justices of the Supreme Court believe that individual Americans have no individual right to bear arms to protect themselves and their families.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Republicans will insist on the appointment of constitutionalist judges, men and women who will not distort our founding documents to deny the people's right to self-government sanction federal powers that violate our liberties, or inject foreign law into American jurisprudence.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We oppose stealth nominations to the federal bench, and especially to the Supreme Court, whose lack of a clear and distinguished record leaves doubt about their respect for the Constitution or their intellectual fortitude.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Nominees must have a record of fidelity to the U.S. Constitution and the rule of law.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We reject the Democrats' view that judicial nominees should guarantee particular results even before the case is filed.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Judges should not be politicians.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Jurists nominated by a Republican president will be thoughtful and open-minded, always prepared to view past error in light of stare decisis, including judicial fiats that disenfranchised the American people.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: No qualified person should be denied the opportunity to serve on the federal bench due to race, ethnicity, religion or sex.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: In affirming Article VI of the Constitution — that no religious test shall ever be required for any office — we insist that the Senate should never inquire into a nominee's religious convictions and we condemn the opposition, by some members of the Democratic Party, to recent judicial nominees because of their ethnicity or religion.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Many members of the Armed Services will find it difficult to participate in this year's elections because of the government's reliance on outdated and inadequate voting, notification, and ballot delivery systems.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The mishandling and delaying of registration forms and absentee ballots disenfranchises thousands of our servicemen and servicewomen.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The Commander-in-Chief, the Department of Defense, and state and local election officials must do more to protect the voting rights of those on the front lines of freedom.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: That means using expedited mail delivery to bring ballots to and from our troops abroad, including those serving in areas of conflict, while completing work on an electronic ballot delivery system that will enable our military personnel to receive and cast their ballots in a secure and convenient manner.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We oppose attempts to distort the electoral process by wholesale restoration of the franchise to convicted felons, by makeshift or hurried naturalization procedures, or by discretionary ballot-reading by election boards.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Preventing voting fraud is a civil rights issue.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support the right of states to require an official government-issued photo identification for voting and call upon the Department of Justice to deploy its resources to prevent ballot tampering in the November elections.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support efforts by state and local election officials to ensure integrity in the voting process and to prevent voter fraud and abuse, particularly as it relates to voter registration and absentee ballots.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The rights of citizenship do not stop at the ballot box.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: They include the free-speech right to devote one’s resources to whatever cause or candidate one supports.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We oppose any restrictions or conditions upon those activities that would discourage Americans from exercising their constitutional right to enter the political fray or limit their commitment to their ideals.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The integrity of the 2010 census, proportioning congressional representation among the states, must be preserved.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The census should count every person legally abiding in the United States in an actual enumeration.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We urge all who are legally eligible to participate in the census count to do so; at the same time, we urge Congress to specify — and to constitutionally justify — which census questions require a response.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We appreciate the extraordinary sacrifices the men and women of the territories are making to protect our freedom through their service in the U.S. Armed Forces.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We welcome greater participation in all aspects of the political process by Americans residing in Guam, the Virgin Islands, American Samoa, the Northern Marianas, and Puerto Rico.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We affirm their right to seek the full extension of the Constitution, with all the political rights and responsibilities it entails.     We recognize the valuable contributions made by the people of the United States Virgin Islands to the common welfare of the nation, including national defense, and their contributions to the federal treasury in the form of federal excise taxes paid on products produced in the territory.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support the Native American Samoans~ efforts to protect their right to self-government and to preserve their culture and land-tenure system, which fosters self-reliance and strong extended-family values.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support increased local self-government for the United States citizens of the Virgin Islands, and closer cooperation between the local and federal governments to promote private sector-led development and self-sufficiency.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We recognize that Guam is a strategically vital U.S. territory, an American fortress in the western Pacific.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We affirm our support for the patriotic U.S. citizens of Guam and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands to achieve greater self-government, an improved federal territorial relationship, new economic development strategies, a strong health care system that meets their needs, and continued political self-determination.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support a review to determine the appropriate eligibility of territories as well as states for Supplemental Security Income and other federal programs.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support the right of the United States citizens of Puerto Rico to be admitted to the Union as a fully sovereign state after they freely so determine.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We recognize that Congress has the final authority to define the constitutionally valid options for Puerto Rico to achieve a permanent non-territorial status with government by consent and full enfranchisement.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: As long as Puerto Rico is not a state, however, the will of its people regarding their political status should be ascertained by means of a general right of referendum or specific referenda sponsored by the U.S. government.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The nation's capital is a special responsibility of the federal government.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Yet some of the worst performing schools in the country are mere blocks from the Department of Education, and some of the most crime-ridden neighborhoods in the country are blocks from the Department of Justice.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Washington should be made a model city.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Two major Republican initiatives — a first-time D.C. homebuyers credit and a landmark school choice initiative — have pointed the way toward a civic resurgence, and a third piece of GOP legislation now guarantees young D.C. residents significant assistance in affording higher education.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Because Washington's buildings and monuments may be top targets of terrorist groups, the federal government must work closely with local officials to improve security without burdening local residents.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We call on the District of Columbia city council to pass laws consistent with the Supreme Court's decision in the Heller case.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We honor the contributions of the residents of the District of Columbia, especially those who are serving honorably, or have served, in our Armed Forces.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: America's free economy has given our country the world's highest standard of living and allows us to share our prosperity with the rest of humanity.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: It is an engine of charity, empowering everything from Sabbath collection plate to great endowments.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: It creates opportunity, rewards self-reliance and hard work, and unleashes productive energies that other societies can only imagine.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Today, our economy faces challenges due to high energy costs.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our task is to strengthen our economy and build a greater degree of security — in availability of jobs, in accessibility of health care, in portability of pensions, and in affordability of energy.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: That is an urgent task because economic freedom — and the prosperity it makes possible — are not ends in themselves.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: They are means by which families and individuals can maintain their independence from government, raise their children by their own values, and build communities of self-reliant neighbors.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Economic freedom expands the prosperity pie; government can only divide it up.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: That is why Republicans advocate lower taxes, reasonable regulation, and smaller, smarter government.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: That agenda translates to more opportunity for more people.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: It represents the economics of inclusion, the path by which hopes become achievements.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: It is the way we will reach our goal of enabling everyone to have a chance to own, invest, and build.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The most important distinction between Republicans and the leadership of today's Democratic Party concerning taxes is not just that we believe you should keep more of what you earn.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: That's true, but there is a more fundamental distinction.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: It concerns the purpose of taxation.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We believe government should tax only to raise money for its essential functions.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Today's Democratic Party views the tax code as a tool for social engineering.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: They use it to control our behavior, steer our choices, and change the way we live our lives.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The Republican Party will put a stop to both social engineering and corporate handouts by simplifying tax policy, eliminating special deals, and putting those saved dollars back into the taxpayers' pockets.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Sound tax policy alone may not ensure economic success, but terrible tax policy does guarantee economic failure.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Along with making the 2001 and 2003 tax cuts permanent so American families will not face a large tax hike, Republicans will advance tax policies to support American families, promote savings and innovation, and put us on a path to fundamental tax reform.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: American families with children are the hardest hit during any economic downturn.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Republicans will lower their tax burden by doubling the exemption for dependents.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * New technology should not occasion more taxation.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We will permanently ban internet access taxes and stop all new cell phone taxes.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * For the sake of family farms and small businesses, we will continue our fight against the federal death tax.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * The Alternative Minimum Tax, a stealth levy on the middle-class that unduly targets large families, must be repealed.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * Republicans support tax credits for health care and medical expenses.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: America’s producers can compete successfully in the international arena — as long as they have a level playing field.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Today's tax code is tilted against them, with one of the highest corporate tax rates of all developed countries.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: That not only hurts American investors, managers, and the U.S. balance of trade; it also sends American jobs overseas.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support a major reduction in the corporate tax rate so that American companies stay competitive with their foreign counterparts and American jobs can remain in this country.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support a tax code that encourages personal savings.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: High tax rates discourage thrift by penalizing the return on savings and should be replaced with incentives to save.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support a plan to encourage employers to offer automatic enrollment in tax-deferred savings programs.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The current limits on tax-free savings accounts should be removed.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Over the long run, the mammoth IRS tax code must be replaced with a system that is simple, transparent, and fair while maximizing economic growth and job creation.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: As a transition, we support giving all taxpayers the option of filing under current rules or under a two-rate flat tax with generous deductions for families.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: This gradual approach is the taxpayers~ best hope of overcoming the lobbyist legions that have thwarted past simplification efforts.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: As a matter of principle, we oppose retroactive taxation, and we condemn attempts by judges, at any level of government, to seize the power of the purse by ordering higher taxes.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Because of the vital role of religious organizations, charities and fraternal benevolent societies in fostering charity and patriotism, they should not be subject to taxation.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: In any fundamental restructuring of federal taxation, to guard against the possibility of hypertaxation of the American people, any value added tax or national sales tax must be tied to simultaneous repeal of the Sixteenth Amendment, which established the federal income tax.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The last thing Americans need right now is tax hikes.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: On the federal level, Republicans lowered taxes in 2001 and 2003 in order to encourage economic growth, put more money in the pockets of every taxpayer, and make the system fairer.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: It worked.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: If Congress had then controlled its spending, we could have done even more.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Ever since those tax cuts were enacted, the Democratic Party has been clear about its goals: It wants to raise taxes by eliminating those Republican tax reductions.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The impact on American families would be disastrous:
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Marginal tax rates would rise.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: This is in addition to their proposal to target millions of taxpayers with even higher rates.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * The "marriage penalty" would return for two-earner couples.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * The child tax credit would fall to half its current value.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * Small businesses would lose their tax relief.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * The federal death tax would be enormously increased.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * Investment income — the seed money for new jobs — would be eaten away by higher rates for dividend and capital gain income.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: All that and more would amount to an annual tax hike upwards of $250 billion — almost $700 per taxpayer every year, for a total of $1.1 trillion in additional taxes over the next decade.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: That is what today's Democratic Party calls "tax fairness."
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We call it an unconscionable assault on the paychecks and pocketbooks of every hard-working American household.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Their promises to aim their tax hikes at families with high incomes is a smokescreen; history shows that when Democrats want more money, they raise taxes on everyone.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We proudly call ourselves the party of small business because small businesses are where national prosperity begins.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Small businesses such as Main Street retailers, entrepreneurs, independent contractors, and direct sellers create most of the country's new jobs and have been the primary means of economic advancement by women and minorities.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Eight years ago, when Democrats controlled the Executive Branch, small business faced a hostile regulatory agenda, from OSHA's ergonomics standards and attempts to intrude into the homes of telecom-muting employees to IRS discrimination against independent contractors.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Republicans turned back those threats, along with much of the onerous taxation that limited the growth of small businesses.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We reduced their marginal tax rates, quadrupled the limit on their expensing of investments, and phased out the death tax on family owned small businesses and family farms.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We enacted Health Savings Accounts to help small business owners secure health insurance for themselves and their employees.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: All those gains are jeopardized if Democrats gain unfettered power once again.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Republicans will advance a multi-pronged plan to support small business and grow good-paying jobs:
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * Through the energy agenda laid out elsewhere in this platform, we will attack the rise in energy costs that is making it so difficult for entrepreneurs to compete.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * Our tax reduction and tax simplification agenda will allow businesses to focus on producing and selling their products and services — not on paying taxes.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * Our plan to return control of health care to patients and providers will benefit small   business employers and employees alike.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * Our determination to vigorously open foreign markets to American products is an opportunity for many small businesses to grow larger in the global economy.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * Our approach to regulation — basing it on sound science to achieve goals that are technically feasible — will protect against job-killing intrusions into small businesses.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * Our commitment to legal reform means protecting small businesses from the effects of frivolous lawsuits.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Using history as our guide, we look to innovative entrepreneurs for the ingenuity and daring that can give us the next generation of technological progress.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The advances our country needs, in everything from health care to energy to environmental protection, are most likely to come from the men and women of small business.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: American innovation has twin engines: technology and small business, employing over half the private-sector work force.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The synergy of our technology and small business drove a world-wide economic transformation of the last quarter-century.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: To maintain our global leadership, we need to encourage innovators by reforming and making permanent the Research and Development Tax Credit as part of the overall agenda outlined in this platform.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Innovation is our future — in our approach to energy, to education, to health care, and especially to government.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: As a symbol of that commitment, we share the vision of returning Americans to the moon as a step toward a mission to Mars.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: In advancing our country's space and aeronautics program, NASA will remain one of the world's most important pioneers in technology, and from its explorations can come tremendous benefits for mankind.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: To master the global economy, our work force must be creative, independent, and able to adapt to rapid change.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: That challenge calls for better education and training and new approaches to employer-employee relations.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: It means investing in people, not institutions.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The Democrats' approach to employment policy is a retreat to failed models of the past: new regulatory burdens on employers that make it more difficult for businesses, big and small, to hire and keep employees.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: That failed model empowers union bosses at the expense of their members, trial lawyers at the expense of small businesses, and government bureaucrats at the expense of employer-employee partnerships.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Its goal is not to create jobs but to control the workplace and the work force.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Republicans believe that the employer-employee relationship of the future will be built upon employee empowerment and workplace flexibility.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The Industrial Revolution treated people like machines; today's economy must treat them as individuals.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We recognize that work schedules should be more flexible when employers and employees are not negatively affected such as removing outdated distinctions between full time and part time, clock-punching and overtime.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The federal government should set an example in that regard.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: • The workplace must catch up with the way Americans live now.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: For increasing numbers of workers, especially those with children, the choice of working from home will be good for families, profitable for business, and energy efficient.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * All workers should have portability in their pension plans and their health insurance, giving them greater job mobility, financial independence, and security.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: * Global competitiveness will increasingly require an entrepreneurial culture of cooperation and team work.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Making the best talent part of our team is the rationale for the H-1B visa program, which needs updating to reflect our need for more leaders in science and technology while we take the necessary steps to create more of them in our own school systems.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: By complementing the U.S. work force with needed specialists from abroad, we can make sure American companies and their jobs remain here at home.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Businesses and employees, working together, are best suited to addressing the challenges ahead.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Empowering official Washington and the trial bar, as Democrats prefer, will only lead to more antagonistic relations.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Government can play an important role in addressing economic dislocations by modernizing its re-training and unemployment assistance programs.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We must make these programs actually anticipate dislocations so that affected workers can get new skills quickly and return to the workforce.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We advocate a seamless approach to helping employees stay on the job and advance through education.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Workers should be able to direct a portion of their unemployment insurance into a tax free Lost Earnings Buffer Account that could be used for retraining or relocation.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: With financial incentives to return to work as soon as possible, this approach will also require strengthening community colleges and making them more accessible through Flexible Training Accounts.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We affirm both the right of individuals to voluntarily participate in labor organizations and bargain collectively and the right of states to enact Right-to Work laws.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: But the nation`s labor laws, to a large extent formed out of conflicts several generations ago, should be modernized to make it easier for employers and employees to plan, execute, and profit together.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: To protect workers from misuse of their funds, we will conscientiously enforce federal law requiring financial reporting and transparency by labor unions.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We advocate paycheck protection laws to guard the integrity of the political process and the security of workers' earnings.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The recent attempt by congressional Democrats to deny workers a secret ballot in union referenda is an assault, not only against a fundamental principle of labor law, but even more against the dignity and honor of the American work force.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We oppose "card check" legislation, which deprives workers of their privacy and their right to vote, because it exposes workers to intimidation by union organizers.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Homeownership remains key to creating an opportunity society.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support timely and carefully targeted aid to those hurt by the housing crisis so that affected individuals can have a chance to trade a burdensome mortgage for a manageable loan that reflects their home's market value.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: At the same time, government action must not implicitly encourage anyone to borrow more than they can afford to repay.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support energetic federal investigation and, where appropriate, prosecution of criminal wrongdoing in the mortgage industry and investment sector.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We do not support government bailouts of private institutions.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Government interference in the markets exacerbates problems in the marketplace and causes the free market to take longer to correct itself.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We believe in the free market as the best tool to sustained prosperity and opportunity for all.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We encourage potential buyers to work in concert with the lending community to educate themselves about the responsibilities of purchasing a home, condo, or land.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Republican policy aims to make owning a home more accessible through enforcement of open housing laws, voucher programs, urban homesteading and — what is most important — a strong economy with low interest rates.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Because affordable housing is in the national interest, any simplified tax system should continue to encourage homeownership, recognizing the tremendous social value that the home mortgage interest deduction has had for decades.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: In addition, sound housing policy should recognize the needs of renters so that apartments and multi-family homes remain important components of the housing stock.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The rule of law demands that injured parties have access to the forums to vindicate their rights, but the rule of law does not mean the rule of lawyers — especially trial lawyers who manipulate the system to enrich themselves rather than protecting consumers, workers, or taxpayers.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: While no one should be denied access to the courts, the rule of lawyers threatens our global competitiveness, denies Americans access to the quality of justice they deserve, and puts every small business one lawsuit away from bankruptcy.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The Republican approach to eliminate frivolous lawsuits has advanced in Congress through efforts like the Class Action Fairness Act and in many states through the adoption of medical liability reforms, which we will continue to pursue on the federal and state level.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: But because their Democratic donees currently control Congress, the trial lawyers are on the offensive.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: They are trying to undermine federal health and safety regulations by allowing trial lawyers at the state level to preempt the reasoned judgments of independent experts.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: They seek to weaken lower-cost dispute resolution alternatives such as mediation and arbitration in order to put more cases into court.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: In bill after bill, their congressional allies insert new private causes of action — trial lawyer ear-marks — designed to drag more Americans into court.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our repeated warnings about the corruption at the heart of the trial bar have been vindicated by high-profile criminal convictions and prison terms for some of the nation's leading class action and personal injury trial lawyers.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: All plaintiffs, especially those who must hire personal injury lawyers on a contingency basis, should be protected against abuse by their attorneys, and the attorney-client privilege should be defended as a bulwark in the defense of liberty.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Greater international trade, aggressively advanced on a truly level playing field, will mean more American jobs, higher wages, and a better standard of living.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: It is also a matter of national security and an instrument to promote democracy and civil society in developing nations.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: With 95 percent of the world's customers outside our borders, we need to be at the table when trade rules are written to make sure that free trade is indeed a two-way street.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We encourage multilateral, regional, and bilateral agreements to reduce trade barriers that limit market access for U.S. products, commodities and services.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: To achieve that goal, Congress should reinstate the trade promotion authority every president should have in dealing with foreign governments.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Trade agreements that have already been signed and are pending before Congress should be debated and voted on immediately.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: An aggressive trade strategy is especially important with regard to agriculture.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our farm economy produces for the world; its prosperity depends, more than ever before, on open markets.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: U.S. agricultural exports will top $100 billion this year.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We will contest any restrictions upon our farm products within the World Trade Organization and will work to make the WTO's decision-making process more receptive to the arguments of American producers.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We pledge stronger action to protect intellectual property rights against pirating and will aggressively oppose the direct and indirect subsidies by which some governments tilt the world playing field against American producers.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: To protect American consumers, we call for greater vigilance and more resources to guard against the importation of tainted food, poisonous products, and dangerous toys.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Additionally, we recognize the need to support our growth in trade through appropriate development and support of our ports in order to ensure safe, efficient and timely handling of all goods.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Farming communities have been hard hit this year by flood and violent weather, as well as the escalation of fuel costs.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Especially under those circumstances, federal agricultural aid should go to those who need it most as part of a sensible economic safety-net for farmers.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We advocate the creation of Farm Savings Accounts to help growers manage risks brought on by turbulence in global markets and nature itself.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Mindful that 98 percent of the 2 million farms in this country are owned by individuals or family farming partnerships, we affirm our fight against the death tax.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Those who live on and work the land are our finest environmental stewards.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: They understand, better than most, the need for safe water, clean air, and conservation of open space.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We oppose attempts to hamper agricultural production with heavy-hand  ed mandates, including any expansion of the Clean Water Act to regulate ditches, culverts, converted cropland, and farm and stock ponds.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We reaffirm traditional state supremacy over water allocations and will continue to make available renewable rangeland under sound environmental conditions.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: We support greater investment in conservation incentive programs to help rural communities improve and sustain environmental quality.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Agricultural policy should be formulated by giving careful consideration to the expert opinions of those most knowledgeable on the topic — the farmers and ranchers.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: To meet surging global demand for food and biofuel, farmers must have the technology to grow higher yields using fewer inputs.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The USDA must remain the international leader in agricultural research to ensure that America and the world will never have to choose between food and fuel.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: The U.S. government should end mandates for ethanol and let the free market work.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: All Americans are acutely aware of the energy crisis our nation faces.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Energy costs are spiraling upward, food prices continue to rise, and as a result, our entire economy suffers.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: This winter, families will spend for heat what they could have saved for college, and small businesses will spend for fuel what could have covered employee health insurance.
title: 2008 Republican Platform

text: Our current dependence on foreign fossil fuels threatens both our national security and our economy and could also force drastic changes in the way we live.
title: 2008 Republican Platform
