title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: As long as Puerto Rico is not a State, however, the will of its people regarding their political status should be ascertained by means of a general right of referendum or specific referenda sponsored by the U.S. government.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We are the party of independent individuals and the institutions they create—families, schools, congregations, neighborhoods—to advance their ideals and make real their dreams.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Foremost among those institutions is the American family.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: It is the foundation of our society and the first level of selfgovernment.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Its daily lessons–cooperation, patience, mutual respect, responsibility, selfreliance – are fundamental to the order and progress of our Republic.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Government can never replace the family.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: That is why we insist that public policy, from taxation to education, from healthcare to welfare, be formulated with attention to the needs and strengths of the family.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: The institution of marriage is the foundation of civil society.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Its success as an institution will determine our success as a nation.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: It has been proven by both experience and endless social science studies that traditional marriage is best for children.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Children raised in intact married families are more likely to attend college, are physically and emotionally healthier, are less likely to use drugs or alcohol, engage in crime, or get pregnant outside of marriage.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: The success of marriage directly impacts the economic wellbeing of individuals.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Furthermore, the future of marriage affects freedom.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: The lack of family formation not only leads to more government costs,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: but also to more government control over the lives of its citizens in all aspects.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We recognize and honor the courageous efforts of those who bear the many burdens of parenting alone, even as we believe that marriage, the union of one man and one woman must be upheld as the national standard, a goal to stand for, encourage, and promote through laws governing marriage.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We embrace the principle that all Americans should be treated with respect and dignity.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: The Republicanled welfare reforms enacted in 1996 marked a revolution in government’s approach to poverty.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: They changed the standard for policy success from the amount of income transferred to the poor to the number of poor who moved from welfare to economic independence.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We took the belief of most Americans—that welfare should be a hand up, not a hand out—and made it law.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Work requirements, though modest, were at the heart of this success.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: That is why so many are now outraged by the current Administration’s recent decision to permit waivers for work requirements for welfare benefits,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: in other words, to administratively repeal the most successful antipoverty policy in memory.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Instead of undermining the expectation that lowincome parents and individuals should strive to support themselves, benefit programs like food stamps must ensure that those benefits are better targeted to those who need help the most.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: For the sake of lowincome families as well as the taxpayers, the federal government’s entire system of public assistance should be reformed to ensure that it promotes work.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Each year, this system dispenses nearly $1 trillion in taxpayer funds across a maze of approximately 80 programs that are neither coordinated nor effective in solving poverty and lifting up families.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: For many individuals collecting benefits from multiple categorical programs, efforts to work or earn more actually result in less money in their pocket through the resulting loss of benefits.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: This poverty trap would ensnare even more Americans if Obamacare were implemented.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Taking a part time job, working an extra shift, or even just marrying someone who works, would result in a loss of benefits, thereby discouraging the very acts necessary to achieve the American Dream.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Families formed or enlarged by adoption strengthen our communities and ennoble our nation.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We applaud the Republican legislative initiatives that led to a significant increase in adoptions in recent years,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and we call upon the private sector to consider the needs of adoptive families on a par with others.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Any restructuring of the federal tax code should recognize the financial impact of the adoption process and the commitment made by adoptive families.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: The nation’s foster care system remains a necessary fallback for youngsters from troubled families.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Because of reforms initiated by many States, the number of foster children has declined to just over 400,000.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: A major problem of the system is its lack of support, financial and otherwise, for teens who age out of foster care and into a world in which many are not prepared to go it alone.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We urge States to work with the faithbased and other community groups which reach out to these young people in need.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Millions of Americans suffer from problem or pathological gambling that can destroy families.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We support the prohibition of gambling over the Internet and call for reversal of the Justice Department’s decision distorting the formerly accepted meaning of the Wire Act that could open the door to Internet betting.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: The Internet must be made safe for children.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We call on service providers to exercise due care to ensure that the Internet cannot become a safe haven for predators
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: while respecting First Amendment rights.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We urge active prosecution against child pornography, which is closely linked to the horrors of human trafficking.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Current laws on all forms of pornography and obscenity need to be vigorously enforced.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We renew our commitment to the inclusion of Americans with disabilities in all aspects of our national life.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: In keeping with that commitment, we oppose the nonconsensual withholding of care or treatment from people with disabilities,  including newborns, as well as the elderly and infirm,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: just as we oppose euthanasia and assisted suicide,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: which endanger especially those on the margins of society.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Because government should set a positive standard in hiring and contracting for the services of persons with disabilities, we need to update the statutory authority for the Ability One program, a major avenue by which those productive members of our society can offer high quality services.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: The Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA) has opened up unprecedented opportunities for many students,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and we reaffirm our support for its goal of minimizing the separation of children with disabilities from their peers.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We urge preventive efforts in early childhood,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: especially assistance in gaining prereading skills, to help many students move beyond the need for IDEA’s protections.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We endorse the program of Employment First, developed by major disability rights groups, to replace dependency with jobs in the mainstream of the American workforce.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: The Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act—Obamacare—was never really about healthcare, though its impact upon the nation’s health is disastrous.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: From its start, it was about power, the expansion of government control over one sixth of our economy,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and resulted in an attack on our Constitution, by requiring that U.S. citizens purchase health insurance.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: It was the highwater mark of an outdated liberalism
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Obamacare has been struck down in the court of public opinion and is falling by the weight of its own confusing, unworkable, budgetbusting, and conflicting provisions.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: It would tremendously expand Medicaid without significant reform,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: leaving the States to assume unsustainable financial burdens.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: If fully implemented, it could not function;
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and Republican victories in the November elections will guarantee that it is never implemented.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Congressional Republicans are committed to its repeal;
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and a Republican President, on the first day in office, will use his legitimate waiver authority under that law to halt its progress and then will sign its repeal.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Then the American people, through the free market, can advance affordable and responsible healthcare reform that meets the needs and concerns of patients and providers.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Through Obamacare, the current Administration has promoted the notion of abortion as healthcare.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We, however, affirm the dignity of women by protecting the sanctity of human life.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Numerous studies have shown that abortion endangers the health and wellbeing of women, and we stand firmly against it.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We believe that taking care of one’s health is an individual responsibility.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Chronic diseases, many of them related to lifestyle, drive healthcare costs, accounting for more than 75 percent of the nation’s medical spending.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: To reduce demand, and thereby lower costs, we must foster personal responsibility while increasing preventive services to promote healthy lifestyles.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We believe that all Americans should have improved access to affordable, coordinated, quality healthcare,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: including individuals struggling with mental illness.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Our goal is to encourage the development of a healthcare system that provides higher quality care at a lower cost to all Americans
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: while protecting the patientphysician relationship based on mutual trust, informed consent, and privileged patient confidentiality.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We  seek  to  increase  healthcare  choice  and  options,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: contain  costs  and  reduce  mandates,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: simplify the  system  for  patients  and  providers,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and  equalize  the  tax  treatment  of group  and  individual  health  insurance  plans.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: For most  Americans,  those  who  are  insured  now  or  who seek  insurance  in  the  future,  our  practical,  nonintrusive  reforms  will  promote  flexibility  in  State  leadership  in  healthcare  reform,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: promote  a  freemarket based  system,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and  empower  consumer  choice.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: All  of which  will  return  direction  of  the  nation’s  healthcare to  the  people  and  away  from  the  federal  government.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: To return the States to their proper role of regulating  local  insurance  markets  and  caring  for  the needy,  we  propose  to  block  grant  Medicaid  and  other payments  to  the  States;
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: limit  federal  requirements  on both  private  insurance  and  Medicaid;
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: assist  all  patients,  including  those  with  preexisting  conditions, through  reinsurance  and  risk  adjustment;
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and  promote  nonlitigation  alternatives  for  dispute  resolution.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We  call  on  State  officials  to  carefully  consider the  increased  costs  of  medical  mandates,  imposed under  their  laws,  which  may  price  many  lowincome families  out  of  the  insurance  market.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We  call  on  the government  to  permanently  ban  all  federal  funding and  subsidies  for  abortion  and  healthcare  plans  that include  abortion  coverage.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: To  achieve  a  free  market  in  healthcare  and  ensure competition,  we  will  promote  price  transparency  so that  consumers  will  know  the  actual  cost  of  treatments  before  they  undergo  them.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: When  patients  are aware  of  costs,  they  are  less  likely  to  overutilize  services.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We support legislation to cap noneconomic damages in medical malpractice lawsuits,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: thereby relieving conscientious providers of burdens that are not rightly theirs and addressing a serious cause of escalating medical bills.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We will empower individuals and small businesses to form purchasing pools in order to expand coverage to the uninsured.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Individuals with preexisting conditions who maintain continuous insurance coverage should be protected from discrimination.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We  support  technology  enhancements  for  medical  health  records  and  data  systems
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: while  affirming  patient  privacy  and  ownership  of health  information.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Consumer choice is the most powerful factor in healthcare reform.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Today’s highly mobile work force requires portability of insurance coverage that can go with them from job to job.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: The need to maintain coverage should not dictate where families have to live and work.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Putting the patient at the center of policy decisions will increase choice and reduce costs while ensuring that services provide what Americans actually want.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We must end tax discrimination against the individual purchase of insurance and allow consumers to purchase insurance across State lines.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: While promoting “coinsurance” products and alternatives to “fee for service,” government must promote Health Savings Accounts and Health Reimbursement Accounts to be used for insurance premiums
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and should encourage the private sector to rate competing insurance plans.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We will ensure that America’s aging population has access to safe and affordable care.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Because seniors overwhelmingly desire to age at home, we will make home care a priority in public policy.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We will champion the right of individual choice in senior care.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We will aggressively implement programs to protect against elder abuse,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and we will work to ensure that quality care is provided across the care continuum from home to nursing home to hospice.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We support federal investment in healthcare delivery systems and solutions creating innovative means to provide greater, more costeffective access to high quality healthcare.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We also support federal investment in basic and applied biomedical research, especially the neuroscience research that may hold great potential for dealing with diseases and disorders such as Autism, Alzheimer’s, and Parkinson’s.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: If we are to make significant headway against breast and prostate cancer, diabetes, and other killers, research must consider the special needs of formerly neglected groups.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We call for expanded support for the stemcell research that now offers the greatest hope for many afflictions–
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: with adult stem cells, umbilical cord blood, and cells reprogrammed into pluripotent stem cells–without the destruction of embryonic human life.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We urge a ban on human cloning and on the creation of or experimentation on human embryos.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We support restoring the Drug Enforcement Administration ban on the use of controlled substances for physicianassisted suicide.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We oppose the FDA approval of Mifeprex, formerly known as RU486, and similar drugs that terminate innocent human life after conception.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: No healthcare professional or organization should ever be required to perform, provide for, withhold, or refer for a medical service against their conscience.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: This is especially true of the religious organizations which deliver a major portion of America’s healthcare, a service rooted in the charity of faith communities.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We do not believe, however, that healthcare providers should be allowed to withhold services because the healthcare provider believes the patient’s life is not worth living.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We support the ability of all organizations to provide, purchase, or enroll in healthcare coverage consistent with their religious, moral or ethical convictions without discrimination or penalty.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We likewise support the right of parents to consent to medical treatment for their children, including mental health treatment, drug treatment, and treatment involving pregnancy, contraceptives and abortion.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We urge enactment of pending legislation that would require parental consent to transport girls across state lines for abortions.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: America’s leadership in life sciences R&D and medical innovation is being threatened.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: As a country, we must work together now or lose our leadership position in medical innovation, U.S. job creation, and access to lifesaving treatments for U.S. patients.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: The United States has led the global medical device and pharmaceutical industries for decades.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: This leadership has made the U.S. the medical innovation capital of the world,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: bringing millions of highpaying jobs to our country
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and lifesaving devices and drugs to our nation’s patients.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: But that leadership position is at risk;
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: patients, innovators, and job creators point to the lack of predictability, consistency, transparency and efficiency at the Food and Drug Administration that is driving innovation overseas, benefiting foreign, not U.S., patients.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We pledge to reform the FDA so we can ensure that the U.S. remains the world leader in medical innovation,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: that device and drug jobs stay in the U.S.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: that U.S. patients benefit first from new devices and drugs,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and that the FDA no longer wastes U.S. taxpayer and innovators’ resources because of bureaucratic red tape and legal uncertainty.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Frivolous medical malpractice lawsuits have ballooned the cost of healthcare for the average American.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Physicians are increasingly practicing defensive medicine because of the looming threat of malpractice liability.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Moreover, some medical practitioners are avoiding patients with complex and highrisk medical problems because of the high costs of medical malpractice lawsuits.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Rural America is hurt especially hard as obstetricians, surgeons, and other healthcare providers are moving to urban settings or retiring,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: causing a significant healthcare workforce shortage
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and subsequently decreasing access to care for all patients.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We are committed to aggressively pursuing tort reform legislation to help avoid the practice of defensive medicine,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: to keep healthcare costs low,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and improve healthcare quality.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Parents are responsible for the education of their children.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We do not believe in a one size fits all approach to education
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and support providing broad education choices to parents and children at the State and local level.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Maintaining American preeminence requires a worldclass system of education, with high standards, in which all students can reach their potential.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Today’s education reform movement calls for accountability at every stage of schooling.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: It affirms higher expectations for all students and rejects the crippling bigotry of low expectations.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: It recognizes the wisdom of State and local control of our schools
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: , and it wisely sees consumer rights in education—choice— as the most important driving force for renewing our schools.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Education is much more than schooling.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: It is the whole range of activities by which families and communities transmit to a younger generation
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: , not just knowledge and skills, but ethical and behavioral norms and traditions.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: It is the handing over of a personal and cultural identity.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: That is why education choice has expanded so vigorously.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: as centralizing forces outside the family and community have sought to remake education in order to remake America.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: They have not succeeded, but they have done immense damage.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Since 1965 the federal government has spent $2 trillion on elementary and secondary education with no substantial improvement in academic achievement or high school graduation rates (which currently are 59 percent for AfricanAmerican students and 63 percent for Hispanics).
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: The U.S. spends an average of more than $10,000 per pupil per year in public schools, for a total of more than $550 billion.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: That represents more than 4 percent of GDP devoted to K12 education in 2010.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Of that amount, federal spending was more than $47 billion.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Clearly, if money were the solution, our schools would be problemfree.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: More money alone does not necessarily equal better performance.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: After years of trial and error, we know what does work, what has actually made a difference in student advancement, and what is powering education reform at the local level all across America: accountability on the part of administrators, parents and teachers;
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: higher academic standards;
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: programs that support the development of character and financial literacy;
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: periodic rigorous assessments on the fundamentals, especially math, science, reading, history, and geography;
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: renewed focus on the Constitution and the writings of the Founding Fathers,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and an accurate account of American history that celebrates the birth of this great nation;
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: transparency, so parents and the public can discover which schools best serve their pupils;
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: flexibility and freedom to innovate, so schools can adapt to the special needs of their students and hold teachers and administrators responsible for student performance.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We support the innovations in education reform occurring at the State level based upon proven results.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Republican Governors have led in the effort to reform our country’s underperforming education system, and we applaud these advancements.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We advocate the policies and methods that have proven effective: building on the basics, especially STEM subjects (science, technology, engineering, and math) and phonics;
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: ending social promotions;
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: merit pay for good teachers;
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: classroom discipline;
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: parental involvement;
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and strong leadership by principals, superintendents, and locally elected school boards.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Because technology has become an essential tool of learning, proper implementation of technology is a key factor in providing every child equal access and opportunity.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: The Republican Party is the party of fresh and innovative ideas in education.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We support options for learning, including home schooling and local innovations like singlesex classes, fullday school hours, and yearround schools.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: School choice—whether through charter schools, open enrollment requests, college lab schools, virtual schools, career and technical education programs, vouchers, or tax credits—is important for all children,
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: especially for families with children trapped in failing schools.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Getting those youngsters into decent learning environments
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and helping them to realize their full potential is the greatest civil rights challenge of our time.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We support the promotion of local career and technical educational programs and entrepreneurial programs that have been supported by leaders in industry and will retrain and retool the American workforce, which is the best in the world.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: A young person’s ability to achieve in school must be based on his or her Godgiven talent and motivation, not an address, zip code, or economic status.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: In sum, on the one hand enormous amounts of money are being spent for K12 public education with overall results that do not justify that spending.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: On the other hand, the common experience of families, teachers, and administrators forms the basis of what does work in education.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and Congressional Republicans are pointing a new way forward with major reform legislation.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We support its concept of block grants and the repeal of numerous federal regulations which interfere with State and local control of public schools.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: The bulk of the federal money through Title I for lowincome children and through IDEA for disabled youngsters should follow the students to whatever school they choose so that eligible pupils, through open enrollment, can bring their share of the funding with them.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: The Republicanfounded D.C. Opportunity Scholarship Program should be expanded as a model for the rest of the country.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We deplore the efforts by Congressional Democrats and the current President to kill this successful program for disadvantaged students in order to placate the leaders of the teachers’ unions.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We support putting the needs of students before the special interests of unions when approaching elementary and secondary education reform.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Because parents are a child’s first teachers, we support family literacy programs, which improve the reading, language, and life skills of both parents and children from lowincome families.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: To ensure that all students have access to the mainstream of American life, we support the English First approach
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: and oppose divisive programs that limit students’ ability to advance in American society.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We renew our call for replacing “family planning” programs for teens with abstinence education which teaches abstinence until marriage as the responsible and respected standard of behavior.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Abstinence from sexual activity is the only protection that is 100 percent effective against outofwedlock pregnancies and sexuallytransmitted diseases including HIV/AIDS when transmitted sexually.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: It is effective, sciencebased, and empowers teens to achieve optimal health outcomes and avoid risks of sexual activity.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We oppose schoolbased clinics that provide referrals, counseling, and related services for abortion and contraception.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We support keeping federal funds from being used in mandatory or universal mental health, psychiatric, or socioemotional screening programs.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We applaud America’s great teachers, who should be protected against frivolous litigation and should be able to take reasonable actions to maintain discipline and order in the classroom.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We support legislation that will correct the current law provision which defines a “Highly Qualified Teacher” merely by his or her credentials, not results in the classroom.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: We urge school districts to make use of teaching talent in business, STEM fields, and in the military, especially among our returning veterans.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Rigid tenure systems based on the “last in, first out” policy should be replaced with a meritbased approach that can attract fresh talent and dedication to the classroom.
title: We believe in America. Republican Platform

text: Public services: investment and reform Renewal of our public services is at the centre of new Labour’s manifesto.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: A single aim drives our policy programme: to liberate people’s potential, by spreading power, wealth and opportunity more widely, breaking down the barriers that hold people back.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: But this is only possible on the continued foundation of economic stability: mortgages as low as possible, low inflation and sound public finances.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Here we set out some of the key measures for investment and reform that we believe give us a historic opportunity to modernise our schools, NHS, criminal justice system and welfare state.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: New Labour believes that Britain needs investment in schools and hospitals, not reckless tax cuts.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Before 1997 we promised and kept to two tough years on spending to get the public finances in shape.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Now, consistent with meeting our fiscal rules, we promise substantial rises for key public services.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: To help deliver our plans, our ten-year goal is the renewal of local government.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - increase education spending by more than five per cent in real terms each year for the next three years as we increase the share of national income for education in the next Parliament.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - increase health spending by an average of six per cent in real terms each year for the next three years.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - increase spending on our police – an extra £1.6 billion a year by 2003/04.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - increase spending on transport by 20 per cent for the next three years, on our way to a £180 billion investment of public and private money for transport over the next ten years.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - use a £400 million reward fund for local government in return for signing up to clear targets to improve local services.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: New Labour believes in renewing a public service ethic by giving frontline staff new freedoms to respond to public needs.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: For public services to be renewed, we will need more staff, properly rewarded.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: It is these frontline staff, operating in new ways, who will drive up standards in our key public services.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will decentralise power to make that possible.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - 20,000 more nurses who will be given new enhanced roles and more power for matrons and ward sisters with control over budgets.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - 10,000 more doctors, and access to a £500 million Performance Fund to spend on new patient services.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - 10,000 more teachers.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - Invest in further rapid promotion and rewards for classroom excellence, more classroom assistants and help with housing costs in high-cost areas.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - 6,000 extra police recruits, raising police numbers to their highest ever level, with strong local leadership and proper rewards for those on the frontline.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: New Labour believes that a stable economy is the platform for rising living standards and opportunity for all.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Our ten-year goals are for long-term economic stability and faster productivity growth than our main competitors.

text: - deliver economic stability with mortgages as low as possible, low inflation and sound public finances.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - reform further education, and help 750,000 adults achieve basic skills
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - expand the Children’s Tax Credit to offer up to £1,000 per year for parents of newborn children.

text: - create a new Child Trust Fund for every child at birth.

text: - develop the Small Business Service and cut red tape.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - give British people the final say in any referendum on the single currency.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: New Labour believes that schools need a step change in reform to make quality education open to all.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We plan a radical improvement in secondary schools, building on our success in primary schools.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Our aim is to develop fully the talents of each child.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Our ten-year goal is 50 per cent of young adults entering higher education.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - ensure every secondary school develops a distinctive mission including the expansion of specialist schools.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - diversify state schools with new City Academies and more church schools.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - direct more money to headteachers, more freedom for successful schools.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - reform provision for 11- to 14-year-olds to ensure higher standards in English, maths, science and information technology.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - introduce new vocational options from 14 onwards, with expanded apprenticeship opportunities
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - provide a good-quality nursery place for every three-year-old.

text: New Labour believes that the NHS needs radical reform to fulfil its founding principle of quality treatment based on need, not ability to pay.

text: The NHS needs radical reform if it is to be designed around the needs of patients.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Investment is vital but not enough.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Labour’s ten-year goal is a maximum waiting time of three months as we become a healthier nation with fast, high-quality treatment, free at the point of use.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - decentralise power to give local Primary Care Trusts control of 75 per cent of NHS funding, and cut by two thirds the number of health authorities.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - reform the appointments system so that by the end of 2005 every hospital appointment is booked for the convenience of the patient.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - cut maximum waiting times by the end of 2005 for outpatient appointments from six months to three months and inpatients, from 18 to six months.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - work with the private sector to use spare capacity, where it makes sense, for NHS patients.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - create a new type of hospital – specially built surgical units, managed by the NHS or the private sector – to guarantee shorter waiting times
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: New Labour believes that rights and responsibilities should be at the centre of reform of the welfare state– to lift children and pensioners out of poverty, and help parents balance work and family.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will continue to reform the tax and benefit system to reward work, not irresponsibility.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Our ten-year goals are to achieve full employment in every region, to halve child poverty and tackle pensioner poverty.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - create an integrated Child Credit of cash support for children, built on the foundation of universal child benefit.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - establish a new Pension Credit for lower- and middle-income pensioners.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - establish a new ‘Employment First’ interview for people entering the welfare system, and integrate the Benefits Agency and Employment Service through major reform.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - extend and increase paid maternity leave to £100 each week for six months.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - introduce paid paternity leave.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - expand childcare places to provide for 1.6 million children.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: New Labour believes that crime can only be cut by dealing with the causes of crime as well as being tough on criminals.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We plan the most comprehensive reform of the criminal justice system since the war – to catch, convict, punish and rehabilitate more of the 100,000 persistent offenders.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Our ten-year goal is a modernised criminal justice system with the burglary rate halved.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - overhaul sentencing so that persistent offending results in more severe punishment.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - reform custodial sentences so that every offender gets punishment and rehabilitation designed to minimise reoffending.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - reform rules of evidence to simplify trials and bring the guilty to justice.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - introduce specialist, late-sitting and review courts to reflect crime patterns and properly monitor offenders.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - establish a new Criminal Assets Recovery Agency to seize assets of crime barons and a register of dealers to tackle drugs.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - introduce a victims bill of rights providing legal rights to compensation, support and information.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Labour’s purpose is to help every family, not just a few, to raise their living standards and plan ahead with security.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We have a ten-year vision: higher living standards, affordable mortgages and fairer taxes combined with much greater investment in vital public services.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Economic stability is the foundation.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We know the price of boom and bust – it was paid in the 1980s and 1990s by millions of hard-working families.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Our reforms since 1997 have helped cut interest rates to nearly half the average under the Conservatives, saving mortgage payers on average £1,200 a year.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: By 2010, we want Britain to break away from the decades of boom and bust, as we stick to clear rules for spending and borrowing.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will take no risks with economic policy, make no compromise on fiscal responsibility.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Stability comes first.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: But stability is not enough.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We need to produce more, better and to a higher value to raise our earning power and to meet our ten-year goal of faster productivity growth than our main competitors.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We must make Britain the best place to do business in Europe – a dynamic economy, founded on skills and knowledge, developing the talent of all our people, and contributing to sustainable development.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: That means investment by private and public sectors in infrastructure and skills, and the right competitive framework to support enterprise, small and large, manufacturing and services.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Every extra trained, employed worker contributes to a fairer society, as well as a more prosperous one.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: With social failure, from school drop-outs to crime, comes economic failure.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Fairness and enterprise go together.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: It is up to government to do everything it can to help ensure that no individual and no community is left behind.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We know the risks of promises that cannot be paid for: the Conservatives led Britain into two deep recessions, double-digit inflation, record unemployment, 15 per cent interest rates and a doubling of the national debt.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Independence for the Bank of England and longterm fiscal rules have given the UK the most stable and transparent economic framework in Europe.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Britain now has the best combination of low interest rates, low inflation and low unemployment since the 1960s.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We are saving nearly £9 billion this year from debt and unemployment, so 84p of every extra pound of public spending goes on national priorities, compared to 58p under the Conservatives.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: So we will pursue a balanced approach on the economy with stability the foundation, more investment not less and, as affordable, targeted tax cuts on our priorities.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Our aim is to put more wealth in the hands of more people.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: That is why we will keep mortgage rates as low as possible, ensure competition keeps down household bills, support savings and share ownership, and create a new Child Trust Fund for every child at birth to invest for when they reach adulthood.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: But we showed during the Asian economic crisis how to steer a course of stability in turbulent times.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will continue to work at international level to minimise global economic turbulence, and to protect Britain if it occurs.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Fiscal responsibility and monetary stability are the foundation of our future plans.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: New Labour’s inflation target is 2.5 per cent.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will continue to meet our fiscal rules: over the economic cycle we will borrow only to invest, and keep net debt at a stable and prudent level.

text: We are pledged to raise health and education spending for the next three years at twice the rate of the Conservative years.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Labour will double net public investment.

text: And we are on track to save £1 billion in the costs of government purchasing by 2003.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Tax policy will be governed by the health of the public finances, the requirement for public investment, and the needs of families, business and the environment.

text: • set up a network of 6,000 IT learning centres around the country.

text: • dramatically improve the quality and quantity of prison education.

text: Further education colleges have a critical role to play in the future.

text: We now need to build on its success, extending it to more people across the country.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We also need to ensure that the barriers to work are pulled down by delivering on our obligation to tackle discrimination so that all people can make the most of their talents.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The benefits system we inherited was fragmented, complex and contradictory.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We are putting in place clear, consistent rules: those who can work should be in work or in contact with the labour market.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: As unemployment falls, we need further reform to help people into work.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Labour will introduce a new principle of ‘employment first’, with rights and responsibilities balanced at every stage.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The contract is simple: quality opportunities for real responsibility.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Labour is pledged to create a new Working Age Agency, JobCentre Plus, merging the old Employment Service and Benefits Agency, and focusing on the key skill needs of areas of the country and sectors of the economy.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Whoever you are, wherever you live, you will get the opportunities suited to your needs – from one office, one adviser, one system.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The New Deals for young people and older workers will focus on numeracy, literacy, IT skills and presentation.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Where people are homeless or suffer drug or mental health problems we will offer specialist support.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: More than 140,000 adults aged over 25 have been unemployed for over 18 months.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Labour will deliver more intensive and flexible help, with increased responsibilities for claimants.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will offer greater flexibility to personal advisers and encourage greater engagement of employers, with IT training for all New Dealers.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Employment Zones include funding geared to results and public-private partnership.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: On the basis of the evidence we will consider their extension to new areas and new claimant groups.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will build on the Action Teams for Jobs model, which is targeting 40 of the most severely disadvantaged areas, to tackle the employment gap for ethnic minorities, and devote £45 million to provide stepping stones into employment for the hardest to employ.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: All lone parents will be invited to employment interviews to help them seek employment opportunities.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will build on the lessons of the Choices programme, which offers help with learning, work and childcare.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Partners of unemployed people with children, like those without children, will also be asked to interviews to discuss their options.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Parents need good-quality and affordable childcare if they are to have real choice about work.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: For the first time, Britain has a National Childcare Strategy – covering cost, provision and quality.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We have already created 300,000 extra childcare places.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: By 2004 our target is to have childcare places for 1.6 million children.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Our vision is ambitious: safe and reliable childcare nationwide, allowing all parents to combine home and work, confident in the childcare they have chosen.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will help with the costs of childcare through the Childcare Tax Credit – and will look to extend it to people looking after children with disabilities, and shift workers.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will support the commitment of community and voluntary groups to build up a diverse range of childcare – from Early Excellence Centres to neighbourhood nurseries and informal care (see ‘World-class public services’).
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Many older workers now want to continue in work full- or part-time.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Yet one in three people between 50 and state pension age is not working.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: To help them we will build on the New Deal 50+.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: To help bridge the divide between work and retirement, we will examine ways to ensure that people will be able to draw on their occupational pension and continue to work parttime for the same employer, phasing their retirement without compromising their pension.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We are exploring how to facilitate the transition from work to positive voluntary activity.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Our ambition of full employment is part of a deal: if you put in a fair day’s work, the government will ensure you are able to support yourself and your family.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The minimum wage is the foundation.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: But we offer a guarantee of take-home pay too.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: For people with families, we promise to match your effort with support through the tax system.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: For those on low incomes without children we will create an Employment Tax Credit to boost their earnings, tackle poverty and improve work incentives.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Our ambition is to enable people with disabilities to play a full part in the community.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The Disability Rights Commission now ensures full civil rights for people with disabilities; we have legislated so those with special needs or disabilities have equal access to education.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We are now committed to extending basic rights and opportunities, as indicated in our response to the Disability Rights Taskforce.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We are requiring different kinds of public transport to be made accessible, and introducing concessionary bus fares for the first time, for people with disabilities.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The New Deal for Disabled People pioneers new ways of helping people with disabilities into jobs.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The opportunity to work is vital to civil rights; we are testing how best to offer help with rehabilitation and job retention.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will invest an additional £40 million to help people with disabilities into work, ensure that it is worthwhile to try out a job and stay in work if they have high care costs, and improve assessment for equipment and services as people move in and out of work.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will not use disability benefits to disguise unemployment – the Tory approach in the 1980s.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The number of people getting Incapacity Benefit (IB) has fallen by 11 per cent since 1997; but too many people are written off when in fact they could, with support, work.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will help break down the barriers that keep people with disabilities out of work.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will continue to modernise the operation of the benefits system so that, if people can work, we help them to do so, and stop them slipping from lack of work to inability to work.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Around 18 million working days are lost each year due to work-related illness – at a cost of over £17 billion.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Many people on Industrial Injuries Benefit are helped into work by combining support with effective services, and we want to help as many of the rest as possible.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: But if people cannot work society has a duty to provide security for them.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: For people unable to take up paid work, we are committed to offer security.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We have increased support for children with parents on income support by 80 per cent in real terms since 1997.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: There is now a minimum income guarantee of £142 per week for people with disabilities under 60.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Incapacity Benefit has been extended to people disabled from a young age.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Disability Living Allowance has been extended to three- and four-year-olds.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will continue to keep the system under review.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Our first priority has been to work with local authorities to drive up administrative standards and tackle fraud and error.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: But we must continue to reform it.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: So we will simplify housing benefit and its administration, distinguishing between people of working age and pensioners, reforming provision for private tenants, and examining the case for longer awards.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will spread best practice in administration.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: In the longer term, we will build on our restructuring of rents to ensure that for people of working age, housing benefit as well as the Working Families Tax Credit strengthen work incentives.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Strong and stable family life offers the best possible start to children.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: And marriage provides a strong foundation for stable relationships.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The government supports marriage.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: But it has to do more than that.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: It must support families, above all families with children.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Our vision of the tax and benefits system for families with children is to provide help for all families; to give most help at the time families need it most; and to give more help to those families most in need.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The Conservatives stacked the tax system against families: over four million children lived in poverty; one in five children were growing up in households without work; the average income of households with children had fallen to 30 per cent below the level for those without children.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Labour has started to turn this round.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We have raised child benefit for the first child by over a quarter.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The Working Families Tax Credit has meant a tax cut averaging £31 per week for 1.1 million families.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: In 2001-02, an average of nearly £500 above 1997-98 levels will be invested in every child in Britain.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Personal tax and benefit changes have made families with children an average of £1,000 a year better off.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We are pledged to go further – to eradicate child poverty in a generation and halve it by 2010.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: In the next Parliament we will make major changes.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The Children’s Tax Credit – the family tax cut – is worth up to £520 a year for five million families, with half a million families removed from paying tax altogether.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: It is paid until one parent earns more than £40,000 per year.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: From 2003, the Integrated Child Credit will bring together all existing income-related payments for children, providing most help to the neediest children, building on the foundation of universal child benefit.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: With the new system of child support, every family will receive at least £15 per week, and those most in need £50 per week – over £2,500 per year.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: For the first time, Britain will have a seamless system of child support, whether parents are in or out of work, paid to the main carer.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Our aim is to make the goal of ending child poverty in Britain a political litmus test for any political party running for office.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The task for the next Parliament is to help another million children out of poverty.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Our active welfare state has so far been based on work, finance and services.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: It is now time to add a fourth pillar to the welfare state – a programme to extend to all children the advantages that come from reaching adulthood backed by a financial nest-egg.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Nearly a third of individuals have no financial savings or assets at all.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: People without assets are much more likely to have lower earnings and higher unemployment, and are less likely to start a business or enter higher education.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The government already encourages people to save for a rainy day and save for a pension.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We are determined to extend the savings habit to more people.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: But we are pledged also to use saving to promote opportunity for the next generation.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: All newly born children will have an interestbearing Child Trust Fund set up in their name with an initial endowment from the government, with more for poorer children.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The endowment will be locked until the child reaches adulthood.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will provide incentives for extended family and friends as well as parents to contribute to the fund.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: All the next generation will have the backing of a real financial asset to invest in learning, buying a home or setting up a business.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Labour supports a national children’s rights director to act as a champion for children in need and we will consult on whether to develop and extend the director’s role.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The Criminal Records Bureau will help stop paedophiles and others who are a danger to children from working with them.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: From next year, all children’s homes will, for the first time, be subject to independent spot checks.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The level of educational attainment of children in care will be significantly increased.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Every child leaving care will be guaranteed access to a job, training or education.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: For many children in care, adoption offers the best chance of success in life.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will make adoption faster and fairer.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Children who need new families will be placed within 12 months by 2004.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We aim to ensure that at least 1,000 more children a year are adopted, with improved post-adoption support for parents.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: But we want to go further – with government funding to help parents devote more time to their children early in life.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We want government to promote choice because, without our help, many people are denied the choices that should be theirs.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: A flexible labour market must work to the benefit of both employers and employees.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Statutory maternity leave is currently 18 weeks; we propose to increase it to six months.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Statutory maternity pay is paid at a flat rate of £60 a week; we propose to increase it to £100 per week, as big an increase in the next two years as in the past 40 years.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Fathers currently have no legal right to paid time off on the birth of a child; we propose to introduce it for two weeks, also paid at £100 per week.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We need to do more to help parents balance work and family.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Many parents, especially mothers, want to work reduced hours when they do go back to work.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will work with business and employees to combine flexible working with the needs of business.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Some families break up.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Government’s role is to ensure that both parents retain responsibility for the financial support of their children where they are able to do so.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We have always supported the principle underlying the work of the Child Support Agency (CSA), but the Conservatives bungled its introduction.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: That is why we have already legislated to reform the CSA and these improvements will come on stream from 2002.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: A simple system will ensure a better deal for children, that fathers pay a fair share, that mothers benefit from their doing so, and that tougher action is taken against parents who do not comply.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: In 1997 Labour made a clear commitment to ensure pensioners share fairly in the rising prosperity of the nation.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: At this election, we repeat our commitment to pensioners – we honour your lifetime of work by ensuring that you share fairly in the nation’s rising prosperity, and are committed to tackling pensioner poverty.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will build a secure system on the foundation of the basic state pension.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: As a result of Labour’s policies, in this Parliament spending on pensioners will be £4.5 billion a year more in real terms than in 1997.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Of this, £2 billion is going to the poorest third of pensioners.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Our first priority was to help those on lowest incomes: we have lifted the incomes of the 1.7 million poorest pensioners by at least £800 a year, and for some couples by up to £1,400.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Pensioner households are on average £11 per week better off than they were in 1997; and over three million pensioner households benefit from free TV licences for those over-75s.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The pensioners tax allowance means six out of ten pensioners pay no tax.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We have halved the rate of tax they pay on savings income.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We have pledged to extend tax allowances further so that by 2003 no pensioner pays tax until their income reaches £127 per week.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We now need to go further.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: With Labour, the basic state pension will rise by 2003 to £77 a week for a single pensioner and £123 a week for a pensioner couple.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We guarantee that the Minimum Income Guarantee will be uprated each year in line with earnings, throughout the next Parliament.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: In 2003, this will mean no single pensioner will have an income below £100 per week and no pensioner couple an income below £154 per week.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Labour introduced the Winter Fuel Payment.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Last winter it was raised to £200.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: For next winter it will also be £200.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will also do more to reward pensioners who have saved.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Pensioners who work and save will find, for the first time ever, the government rewarding their saving.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Pensioner couples with an income up to £200 per week and single pensioners with income up to £135 per week will be rewarded for saving – the government adding up to 60p for each £1 of savings income up to a maximum of £23.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: In the process, we will abolish the weekly means test for pensioners, along with removing the unfair test of savings, which penalises pensioners who have modest savings and whose thrift should be recognised.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: It is also vital to have in place long-term pension reform.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We support a fair balance of public and private provision.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Occupational and personal pensions, properly regulated, will continue to offer security for middle and high earners.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will continue discussions on annuity reform to ensure tax rules do not unnecessarily restrict the development of annuity products and markets.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: For low- to middle-income earners, stakeholder pensions cap costs, guarantee value for money, offer flexibility, and drive down fees across the board.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: And for the lowest paid and carers, full-time parents and people with disabilities, the state second pension will top up their pension contributions to give a decent pension in retirement to 18 million people.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Labour’s NHS Plan offers £1. 4 billion of investment for older people to promote better health and support independence.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Pensioners also need simple, accessible services that treat them with dignity and promote independence.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will build on Care Direct to provide a better integration of health, housing, benefits and social care for older people.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: This will be an integrated ‘third age service’ to help older people and those who care for them.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Not only are the large majority of people who require care older, but also the majority of carers are older people.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Labour will tackle the problems faced by people requiring care and the problems of carers themselves.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The national carers strategy is the first step, with information, support and care for carers: Labour will spend £500 million over the next three years providing financial support for 300,000 carers through the benefits system, and £255 million for social care services for carers.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: More is being done for carers through income support; carers will be better able to combine work and care; and 75,000 more carers each year are now able to take a break from their caring responsibilites.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We are proud that, with Labour, care by qualified nurses will be made free to all, wherever it is received.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: One hundred and fifty thousand more older people will receive rehabilitation and convalescence through growing investment in the NHS and social services that the Tories refuse to match.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We want to see carers given access to the cash and services appropriate to their service to their relatives and the community.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The Carers and Disabled Children’s Act gives carers a right to an independent assessment of their needs.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We will examine the development of a fund to help local authorities produce tailored care packages to back up the results of these assessments.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Before 1997, social exclusion was ignored.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Now we have a new approach – improving the quality of mainstream services, preventing people falling between the cracks, and reintegrating them into society if things go wrong.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The number of people living on the streets is down by one third since 1997.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Labour’s target is to cut rough sleeping to two-thirds of its 1998 level by 2002.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Beyond then, we will maintain the drive to keep the number as low as possible.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Labour’s strategy tackles the causes of teenage pregnancy, provides mothers under 18 with access to supervised housing if they cannot live at home, and ensures that, if they do have children, teenagers get access to training, education or work.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: By 2004 we are pledged to reduce teenage pregnancy by 15 per cent.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Labour has a target of reducing truancy and exclusion by a third by 2002.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The police are conducting truancy sweeps; parents are now subject to fines of up to £2,500; funds are being targeted towards pupils at risk.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Nearly ten per cent of 16- to 18-year-olds are not in education, training or work.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The new Connexions service will bridge the gap, providing a single adviser to ensure all young people receive clear advice on the transition to work.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Over the next three years Labour is pledged to back reform, with £900 million of investment in deprived neighbourhoods.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We want local people to lead renewal – a coalition of public, private and voluntary organisations specifying priorities, engaging local effort.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Local Strategic Partnerships, which we have introduced to help coordinate public service improvement, will be properly inclusive of local people, involving them in decision-making.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: They will be backed by specific funds to engage the local community.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Nearly £100 million has been set aside for business start-ups, and we will create a new tax credit for community investment to create £1 billion of investment in disadvantaged areas.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Labour’s objective is to get the right benefit to the right people at the right time.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We want those entitled to benefits to take up their rights to claim them.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Fraud undermines confidence in the welfare system, so we are committed to reduce it.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We have been prepared to be tough – preventing fraud by tightening gateways, sharpening sanctions on fraudsters, and now with ‘two-strikes-and-you’re-out’.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We have saved £1 billion in fraud and error over the course of the Parliament by tightening up the way we administer income support.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: The introduction of Automated Credit Transfer will save a further £100 million per year.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Labour is committed to clear targets for fraud reduction for each benefit, including a commitment to halve the rate of fraud and error in income support and Job Seeker’s Allowance by 2006, and to incorporate fraud prevention into the design of new policies on benefits and tax credits.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: We are also committed to data sharing between government agencies and action to reduce to a minimum the number of ‘spare’ national insurance numbers that are a gateway to fraud.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Our welfare state is underpinned by clear values – we help you to help yourself, we invest in children, we support our pensioners, we insist that no community be written off, and we minimise fraud and error.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: Our reforms will build a strong and inclusive society.

title: Ambitions for Britain

text: by retaining the Winter Fuel Payment, and free TV licences for over-75s
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: by rewarding those who save with the Pension Credit

text: by raising the Minimum Income Guarantee to £100 each week (£154 for couples) in 2003

title: Ambitions for Britain

title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - Reformed local government with higher-quality services, as we decentralise power.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - An extra 6,000 police recruits raising police numbers to their highest ever level.
title: Ambitions for Britain

text: - Double the amount of assets seized from drug traffickers and other major criminals.
